**Data:** `data/lands/first-region.md` (`first_region`); `data/world/rocks.md` (`chalk`, `sandstone`, `granite`, `river_gravel`, `silt`); `data/world/soils.md` (`sand`, `loam`, `clay`, `silt`, `peat`, `ash`, `stony`, `thin`); `data/world/biomes.md` (`broadleaf_forest`, `grassland`, `marsh`, `shore`, `sea`, `barren`); `data/world/deposits.md` (`flint_in_chalk`, `river_gravel`); `data/tuning/world.md` (`world`); `data/tuning/render.md` (`render`: `stream_line_min_km2 = 100`).

**Tests:**
- `kd-core`: `geo::tests::indices_round_trip_at_corners`; `geo::tests::areas_nest_in_cells` (all 32 million areas, A3.7); `geo::tests::triangle_rule` (one million random triples: `dist(a, c) ≤ dist(a, b) + dist(b, c)` + 1 mm); `geo::tests::neighbours_wrap_both_seams`; `ids::tests::place_uid_fields`.
- `kd-data`: `units::tests::parses_every_form` and `units::tests::rejects_unknown_unit` (one case per unit, range and duration row).
- `kd-world` (`WLD-34`): `lands::tests::island_size` (land cells within 10% of 60 × 60 km, sea at least 45 km wide on every side, void beyond); `lands::tests::river_reaches_the_sea` (from its source, the river cells chain to a sea cell with entry and exit points agreeing on shared edges); `lands::tests::escarpment_and_caves` (6 caves and 4 shelters, at least 1.5 km apart, all on escarpment cells, one marked the first camp's); `lands::tests::flint_only_in_chalk` (`WLD-14`); `lands::tests::cover_sums_to_255`; `lands::tests::golden_hash` (x86, arm64); `drain::tests::all_land_drains_to_sea` (no closed basin left after the fill, as B11).
- Screens: golden `island-valley` and `island-coast`; smoke `landHash` equals the golden.

**On the phone:**
1. Open the app: you look down on a green-brown land from high up, with dark woods drawn as tiny crowns, a blue river winding through it, and a pale line of cliff crossing it.
2. Pinch in to the valley stop: the land becomes the flat map look, about 10 km across; drag south along the river to the coast and its dark blue sea; the river stays at least a pixel wide all the way. The note's map pictures show the whole island.
3. Pinch back out toward the cliff: close up the ground is still blocky (shaped every 32 m); α02b brings the detail.
4. Drag and twist anywhere over the island: it stays smooth.

**Not in this alpha:** areas with metre detail (α02b); cliffs and caves as faces (α02c); plants and stones drawn up close (α02d); the clock, day and night and the moving sun (α03a); settling the island before history (α03a); herds (α12b) and small game (α12c); rain (α13); routing and floods (α20c); bench lands (α07d); the world map and globe stops (α19b).

**Risks:**
- 132 MB of cells for a 60 km island looking wasteful: A5.6 keeps the full grid so every path is the real one; the web page's memory is checked in the smoke test (`performance.memory` where present) and reported.
- The river line crossing the escarpment awkwardly (a waterfall in the wrong place): the escarpment is broken for 1 km either side of the river line, so the valley cuts it cleanly.
- Coast noise making islets or lakes: keep the largest landmass only and fill closed depressions (B11's fill) before marking water.

### α02b The ground up close (about 5 hours)

**Goal:** zooming in anywhere on the island brings metre detail within about a second: areas made from their world cell, with the river and streams running through them, gravel bars and banks, and the escarpment as a sharp step, all exactly what people will find there later.

**Serves:** `WLD-12` (part: areas from their cell; areas for the picture near the camera), `WLD-13` (part: the picture saves and changes nothing), `PRE-03` (part: full detail in within about a second), `PRE-26` (part: rivers and streams up close), `PRE-02` (part), `TIM-16` (part: areas bit-identical), `PLT-04` (part: a new area within about a tenth of a second).

**Architecture:** `A5.3`, `A5.5`, `A5.12` (escarpment gaps), `A5.14`, `A11.5`, `A11.6`, `A11.11`.

**Needs:** α02a.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-world` (`area/skeleton.rs`, `area/ground.rs`, `area/mod.rs`, `area/picture.rs`), `kd-app` (`views/`), `kd-android` (builder thread pinning), `kd-render` (`ground`, `water/`, `shaders/water.*`), `data/models/surfaces.md`, `tests/golden/generator.toml`.

**Tasks:**

1. `T02b.1` **The area skeleton (`WLD-12`, A5.3 part 1).**
   `crates/kd-world/src/area/skeleton.rs`: `pub fn skeleton(cx: &AreaCtx, a: AreaId) -> Skeleton`, where `AreaCtx { seed, cat, cells: CellBlock (the area's cell and its 4 × 4 nearest), record: Option<&AreaRecord>, date }` (A5.3; `AreaRecord` is an empty shell until α04a gives it marks).
   It holds what crosses the area: river segments joining each river cell's fixed entry and exit points by a keyed meander about 10 widths long (keyed on the river cell's place uid, so both areas sharing an edge agree); stream crossings on the edge toward the `flow` neighbour, keyed on the pair of cells; sea shore lines from the cells' heights at level 0; the escarpment's edge line (B11's noisy line, generalised: its offset from the cell's line is a 4-octave `relief::fbm` of world x in metres, amplitude 150 m, keyed on the escarpment's feature uid, so neighbouring areas agree) with its gaps, at least one per cell at its lowest point, 20 m wide, where the step becomes a slope under 35° (A5.12); cave and shelter mouths from the cell's cave records, placed on the line (their chambers come in α02c); springs; exposures (river banks, the cliff foot, scree within 6 m below the face).
   Commit `T02b.1: area skeleton (WLD-12, A5.3)`.

2. `T02b.2` **The area ground and point reads (`WLD-12`, `WLD-13`, A5.3 part 2).**
   `crates/kd-world/src/area/ground.rs`: heights at 257 × 257 points in `u16` decimetres above the area's base: the bicubic blend of the 4 × 4 nearest cells' heights, plus B11's 7-octave detail (`relief::fbm` keyed `seed ^ 41`, period 256 m) × `max(2 m, rough × 2 m)`, plus the escarpment step (the cell's `cliff` height on the high side of the line, a 2 m transition as B11's `cliff_step`), plus river and stream beds (bankfull depth at the line, falling to 0 at the bank by a smooth step), rounded to decimetres; the record's pits, heaps and plots are added from α04a on.
   A surface material per square metre: rock at the height's layer (`layer_at` over the cell's rock column) where the slope passes 45°; `scree` within 6 m below a face; `gravel` in river beds and on bars inside meanders; `mud` on river banks within 2 m of the water; `sand` on sea shores under 1.5 m above sea level; `litter` where the cell's tree share passes 0.5; else `grass` under 30° and `dirt` from 30° to 45°.
   Point reads (A5.3), equal to the grids: `height_at(cx, sk, p) -> f32`, `material_at`, `slope_at`; `solid_at` joins in α02c.
   `data/models/surfaces.md` gains `gravel`, `mud`, `sand`, `litter`, `chalk_face`, `sandstone_face`, `granite_face` (ladders `gravel`, `mud`, `sand`, `litter`, `lime`, `sand`, `scree`).
   Commit `T02b.2: area ground and point reads (WLD-12, WLD-13, A5.3)`.

3. `T02b.3` **The picture function (`WLD-13`, A5.5).**
   `crates/kd-world/src/area/picture.rs`: `pub fn make_for_picture(cx: &AreaCtx, a: AreaId, order: &[Bucket], out: &mut AreaPicture) -> Progress` filling 257 × 257 heights and 256 × 256 materials bucket by bucket in the order given and returning after each bucket, so a builder can stop and go on; its grids equal the point reads (A5.5).
   An unchanged area is a pure function of the seed, the generator version, the catalogue, its cell, the 4 × 4 nearest cells and the date (A5.3), and nothing in the world reads the picture (A2.3).
   Commit `T02b.3: the picture function (WLD-13, A5.5)`.

4. `T02b.4` **View builders (`PRE-03`, `PLT-04`, A11.5).**
   `crates/kd-app/src/views/`: on native targets two builder threads (`std::thread`, which `kd-app` may start, A2.3), below the audio thread's priority, each pinning itself at its start through the new `Platform::cores(&self) -> Cores { builders: Vec<u32>, sim: Vec<u32> }` and `Platform::pin(&self, cpu: u32)` (A2.2's `cores`; `pin` pins the calling thread): `kd-android` answers cpu 0 and 1 (the small cores, B79) and pins with `sched_setaffinity`, `kd` and the web answer none (α07c fills `sim`); on the web, slices of at most 2 ms of the GL thread a frame, which the frame budget subtracts (A2.6).
   They make the areas whose squares come within 300 m of the view centre from the camp stop inward (`PRE-03`, A5.5), nearest the view centre first, bucket by bucket; build their meshes per 64 m chunk with α01b's mesher at the frame's spacing (0.5 m on cliffs at the two closest stops comes with α02c); hand them to the renderer by `upload_area`, at most 0.2 ms of uploads a frame (A11.1); keep areas up to 1.5 km from the view centre and drop the rest (A11.5); never touch world state (A2.3 rule 3).
   Until an area's chunks are ready, its land is coarse ground; then the detail dissolves in through a dithered fade over 0.5 s, chunk by chunk (A11.5's fallback, as `Trees.stepFade` fades); no frame waits for a builder.
   A pinch inward starts the area under the view centre as the zoom passes 0.40, so detail is ready as the camp stop arrives (A11.5).
   Commit `T02b.4: view builders and the coarse-to-detail fade (PRE-03, PLT-04, A11.5)`.

5. `T02b.5` **Rivers and streams up close (`PRE-26`, A11.6).**
   `crates/kd-render/src/water/`: river ribbons ported from the mockup's `GeoTerrain.buildWater`, four vertices across, a point every 1–2 m along the skeleton's river and stream lines with half-widths, depth and flow; `shaders/water.vert` and `water.frag` ported from `waterVS` and `waterFS`: a deep middle, light shallows, flow lines drifting with the current, a lighter bank edge, riffles where it is under 0.3 m deep (fords), sun glints; any river widened to at least 0.95 art pixel each side and lifted 1.2 m while widened (`uMinHW`, `uLift`); category water (3).
   The sea grid of α02a continues into view areas at level 0, meeting `sand` shores.
   Commit `T02b.5: rivers and streams up close (PRE-26, A11.6)`.

6. `T02b.6` **Golden areas and screens (`TIM-16`, A5.14, A11.12).**
   `tests/golden/generator.toml` gains `areas`: the `num::hash64` of 20 areas' grids (heights and materials), at fixed area ids chosen to cover a river cell, a stream, the escarpment with a gap, a cave mouth, a shore and plain woodland (A5.14's golden hashes); `kd-world::area::tests::golden_areas` checks them on x86 and arm64, and the web smoke checks `window.kd.areaHash(id)` for three of them.
   Golden scenes `river-ford` (zoom 0.14 over a riffle) and `escarpment-gap` (zoom 0.30).
   Commit `T02b.6: golden areas and scenes (TIM-16, A5.14)`.

7. `T02b.7` **Deliver (`PRC-11`).**
   `versionCode=1022`, `versionName=a02b`; `bench/cloud/a02b.json` adds the time to make an area's skeleton, one plain bucket and a whole area on one cloud core (A5.3: at most 0.2 ms, 0.15 ms and 40 ms on a held middle core, cloud × 1.5 by A16.1), and the view's held memory; then P0's steps 5 to 8.

**Data:** `data/models/surfaces.md` (`gravel`, `mud`, `sand`, `litter`, `chalk_face`, `sandstone_face`, `granite_face`).

**Tests:**
- `kd-world` (`WLD-12`, `WLD-13`): `area::tests::unchanged_area_identical` (an area made, dropped and remade on two different days, unchanged, gives one hash); `area::tests::edges_match` (on 200 pairs of neighbouring areas, shared edge heights equal exactly, A5.3); `area::tests::rivers_unbroken` (rivers and streams run unbroken through 1,000 areas along their lines, A5.3); `area::tests::picture_equals_point_reads` (10,000 points, same date and record, A5.5); `area::tests::coarse_equals_height_at` (all 33 × 33 points of 50 cells, A5.5); `area::tests::escarpment_has_gaps` (every escarpment cell holds a gap under 35°); `area::tests::golden_areas` (x86, arm64).
- `kd-app`: `views::tests::builders_never_write_world` (the layering check covers it: `kd-app`'s builders take `&` only); `views::tests::nearest_first` (the build order is by distance from the view centre, ties by bucket index).
- Screens: golden `river-ford`, `escarpment-gap`; smoke `detail_arrives` (after a pinch to the camp stop, `window.kd.ready()` within 2 s of headless time, detail chunks visible).

**On the phone:**
1. Open the app over the camp and pinch in to close range: within about a second the blocky ground gives way to detailed ground, grass, earth and pale rock, without a jump.
2. Find the river (follow the blue line): close up it has a dark middle, light shallows, moving flow lines, gravel bars inside the bends and ripples where it is shallow.
3. Follow the escarpment: a sharp step in the ground with scree at its foot and gaps where it slopes.
4. Pan quickly along the river at the camp stop: new ground keeps arriving, never a hole.

**Not in this alpha:** overhangs, caves and drawn cliff faces (α02c); plants, ground cover and loose stones (α02d); the date (fixed at Year 1, autumn, day 8 for the picture until α03a's clock); kept areas' marks (α04a); areas the simulation makes for people, with their cache (α04a), though the same functions serve both; dormant areas read from disk (α19c).

**Risks:**
- The meander of a river cell disagreeing at an area edge: everything about a crossing is keyed on the river cell's place uid, never the area's, and the test walks 1,000 areas.
- Builders falling behind on a fast pan: coarse ground covers the gap (A11.5), and the phone benchmark (α07d, run at the stage close in α07e) measures how fast detail arrives while panning at each stop (`PRE-03`).
- Too little memory headroom on the web for view areas: A11.11's 40 MB for view-area data holds about 16 areas; the cache drops the farthest first.

### α02c Cliffs and caves (about 5 hours)

**Goal:** the escarpment becomes a real cliff: layered rock faces with lips, joints and stains, overhangs where soft beds are cut back under hard ones, caves you can see into, dark inside but for the light from their mouths, and fallen blocks at the foot.

**Serves:** `PRE-23` (part: layered faces, cracks, stains, scree; soot comes with fire, α14a), `PRE-24` (part: overhangs and caves with real depth, lit only from their openings), `WLD-12` (part: caves, overhangs and cliffs in areas), `WLD-13` (part), `PRE-21` (part: the sunlit lip), `TIM-16` (part).

**Architecture:** `A5.3` (part 3, `solid_at`), `A5.5`, `A11.4` (inside), `A11.5` (cliffs, overhangs and caves), `A11.7` (loose rocks), `A11.12`.

**Needs:** α02b.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-world` (`area/pieces.rs`, `area/ground.rs`, `area/picture.rs`), `kd-render` (`ground/nets.rs`, `ground/faces.rs`, `rocks.rs`, `shaders/face.*`, `shaders/obj.*`), `kd-app` (`views/`), `data/world/rocks.md`, `data/models/shapes.md`.

**Tasks:**

1. `T02c.1` **3D pieces and `solid_at` (`PRE-24`, `WLD-12`, A5.3 part 3).**
   `crates/kd-world/src/area/pieces.rs`: in the buckets the skeleton marks (the escarpment within 30 m of its line, cave and shelter mouths), `pieces(cx, sk, b) -> Pieces`: solid rock, except soft beds (`layer_at`'s soft quarter) cut back 2–6 m under a hard cap as B11's `Site::solid` does (overhangs and rock shelters), and caves of 2–6 ellipsoid chambers joined by passages, sized by the cave record (A5.3's **Decision:** sized chambers, not B11's crossing-noise caves, so each band finds a cave big enough); a piece stores each column's air gaps as pairs of `u16` decimetres, under 1 KB a bucket.
   `solid_at(cx, sk, p) -> bool` from the skeleton's chambers and cut-backs (A5.3), equal to the pieces.
   `make_for_picture` now also fills the pieces of the buckets it reaches (A5.5).

2. `T02c.2` **Surface nets (`PRE-24`, A11.5).**
   `crates/kd-render/src/ground/nets.rs`: a bucket with pieces, or with a height step over 1.5 m, drops its height-field quads and is meshed by surface nets over the solid field: z crossings exact from the decimetre air gaps, x and y crossings at cell midpoints, one relaxation pass; corners every 1 m, every 0.5 m at the person and close-camp stops (A11.5's **Decision**).
   Each vertex carries the mockup's `aF` as A11.5 computes it while meshing: the face's foot and rim heights, its kind (face, overhang roof, cave wall, cave floor) and the cave depth, by a flood fill through air from open sky up to 40 m (A11.5).

   `shaders/face.vert` and `face.frag`, ported from the mockup's `faceVS`, `faceFS` and its `strata` block (`bedTex`, `bedZ0`, `bedAt`, `strataWob`): faces over 50° from horizontal use them; beds, partings, lips, joints and fissures; water stains where a spring or a stream is within 10 m of the face; lichen on north-facing faces above 1 m; grass hanging over grassy rims; the sunlit lip lit through `rim_sun`; soot is A5.4's mark, from α14a.

### α03a Time and light (about 5.5 hours)

**Goal:** the world runs on its own clock: the island settles for ten game years before history starts at Year 1, spring, day 1, then the sun crosses the sky by hour and season with its shadows, through dawn, day, dusk and night, with the moon at night; a touch shows the date and the speed, zoom sets the speed, and the owner can pause, set the dial or lock a speed.

**Serves:** `TIM-01` (part: speeds by zoom), `TIM-04`, `TIM-05` (part: time stops while the app is away), `TIM-10` (part: real speed at the person stop), `TIM-14` (part: dates shown), `TIM-15` (part: pause, dial and lock, and zoom; skip and the director come in Stage 2), `TIM-18` (part: the 60-day year on the clock), `WLD-07` (part: the sun and the moon), `WLD-08` (part: the first region settles), `WLD-16` (part: the preset's daily and seasonal temperatures), `PRE-30` (part: light by hour and season), `PRE-33` (part: every touch shows the date, the speed and the controls), `PRE-34` (part), `PRN-11` (part: time slows when the phone cannot keep up, never the detail).

**Architecture:** `A2.2` (`Pool`, `Serial`), `A3.7` (the sky), `A4.1`, `A4.9`, `A4.10`, `A4.11`, `A4.12`, `A4.13`, `A5.8` (the preset's mean cycle), `A11.3` (the row in use), `A11.4`, `A12.1`, `A12.2`, `A15.11`.

**Needs:** α02d.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-core` (`pool`, `sky`), `kd-sim` (`world`, `header`, `batch`, `step`, `snapshot`, `weather`), `kd-world` (`weather/preset.rs`, `climate`), `kd-view` (`Snapshot`, `SimControl`, `LightView`), `kd-app` (`sim`, `pace`, `speed`, `triple`), `kd-ui` (`time_bar`), `kd-render` (`light`), `web/glue.js`, `tools/screenshots.mjs`, `data/tuning/time.md`.

**Tasks:**

1. `T03a.1` **Pools and the sky (`WLD-07`, A2.2, A3.7).**
   `kd-core::pool`: `pub trait Pool: Sync { fn workers(&self) -> usize; fn run<R: Send>(&self, jobs: usize, job: impl Fn(usize) -> R + Sync) -> Vec<R>; }` (results in job order, never a trait object) and `Serial`; `Workers` joins with the repeat check (α07c).
   `kd-core::sky` (A3.7): `pub struct Sky { tilt_deg, moon_start, node_period, node_start }`, `pub struct SkyState { sun_dir: [f32; 3], sun_height_deg, day_hours, moon_dir, moon_phase, moon_lit, eclipse }` and `pub fn sun_moon(t, lat, lon, sky) -> SkyState` with A3.7's formulas for declination, hour angle with longitude (local noon 4 minutes earlier per degree east), direction (east, north, up), day length with latitude held within ±89.9°, the moon full once a season; `eclipse` stays 0 until `MIL-04`; all maths through `kd_core::m`.
   Commit `T03a.1: pools and the sun and moon (WLD-07, A2.2, A3.7)`.

2. `T03a.2` **The world and its settling (`WLD-08`, `TIM-14`, A4.1, A5.7, A5.8).**
   `crates/kd-sim/src/world.rs`: `pub struct World { header: Header, now: GameTime, cells: WorldCells, weather: WeatherState, batch: BatchState }` with `Header { seed, rules: (u16, u16), generator: u32, catalogue_hash: u64, history_start: GameTime, switches: SwitchSet, sky: Sky }` (A3.9: the switch set stays empty in play, `PRN-12`); `World::from_land(land: &Land, seed: u64, cat: &Catalogue) -> World` builds the cells (α02a), draws the `Sky` (tilt from the land's `sky`, the moon's start and node by keyed draws on the region's place uid, A5.7 step 0), then settles: `history_start = settle_years × YEAR` (`data/tuning/world.md`), and the world advances to it with nobody in it (`WLD-08`; at this stage only the weather runs, so it takes well under a second).
   `crates/kd-world/src/weather/preset.rs` (A5.8, `MIL-01`'s mean cycle): each game hour every weather cell over the island and its sea is set from its climate record: temperature = the season's mean, blended linearly between the middles of neighbouring seasons, + `range / 2 × cos(2π × (solar hour − 15) / 24)` (warmest at 15:00, coldest at 03:00 local solar time); wind from the climate (west, 4 m/s), humidity 0.7, cloud 0.3; no rain, snow, storms or anomalies until α13; `local(cell, t)` adds the cell's `clim` offset (−6 °C per 1,000 m above the reference height, A5.8).
   Commit `T03a.2: the world, its clock, settling and the preset's weather (WLD-08, WLD-16, A4.1, A5.8)`.

3. `T03a.3` **Barriers, the batch schedule and advancing (`TIM-16`, A4.9, A4.10).**
   `crates/kd-sim/src/batch.rs`: A4.9's one schedule as a table of systems with their times and jobs: the weather hourly at :00 (one round of 4 jobs by rows of weather cells, each writing only its rows, merged in job order); the daily-cells row (region `r` at quarter hour `(37 r) mod 96`) and the 5-day cover row (`(37 r) mod 480`) registered with empty bodies, which α05 fills; systems due at one barrier run in the table's order.
   `crates/kd-sim/src/step.rs`: `World::advance_to<P: Pool>(&mut self, t, pool: &P, blocks: &dyn BlockReader, stop: &dyn Fn() -> bool) -> Advance`, running each barrier it reaches (every `WINDOW` = 300 s), the batches due there, and with no beings yet nothing between barriers; `finish_step`, `now()`; `stop` is polled every 64 events (and at each barrier) and only the web passes a live one (A4.10); `BlockReader` is A14.12's trait, with `NoBlocks` until dormant blocks exist.
   Commit `T03a.3: barriers, the batch schedule and advance_to (A4.9, A4.10)`.

4. `T03a.4` **Snapshots and the triple buffer (`PRN-11`, A4.13).**
   `kd-view::Snapshot` (A4.13, A11.9) gains `t_w: GameTime`, `history_start`, `asked_speed`, `real_speed` (game seconds a real second), `light: LightView { sky: SkyState at the view's place, temp_c, wind }` and the view it was built for; `cube` goes.
   `kd-sim::snapshot::build(world: &World, view: &ViewRequest, out: &mut Snapshot)` reuses the slot's buffers (no allocation in steady state).
   `kd-app::triple`: three `Snapshot` slots and one atomic index word; the sim thread fills the free slot and swaps it to ready; the GL thread takes ready when newer; neither waits (A4.13, `PRN-11`).
   Commit `T03a.4: snapshots and the triple buffer (A4.13)`.

5. `T03a.5` **The simulation thread and pacing (`PRN-11`, `TIM-05`, A4.11, A4.12).**
   `kd-app::sim` (native): a simulation thread owning the `World`, reading `SimControl` (asked speed, pauses, the view; written by the GL thread with `try_lock`, which skips a frame rather than wait), pacing, advancing and publishing; it sleeps while ahead.
   `kd-app::pace`: display time `T_d` advances by real time × real speed; the world is advanced to `ceil(T_d + lead)`, the lead being 3 frames of game time, so the snapshot is at or ahead of what is drawn; if the world falls behind, `T_d` stops gaining and time slows smoothly with no backlog (A4.11, `PRN-11`).
   Web (A4.12): each frame handles input, advances the world with `stop` firing at `max(1 ms, frame interval − last drawing time − 1.5 ms)`, builds a snapshot only if the step finished, then draws.
   `AppMsg::Pause` (the app leaving the screen) sets the system pause, so no game time passes while it is away (`TIM-05`); `Resume` clears it.
   Commit `T03a.5: the simulation thread and pacing (PRN-11, TIM-05, A4.11, A4.12)`.

6. `T03a.6` **Speed control (`TIM-01`, `TIM-04`, `TIM-10`, `TIM-15`, A4.11).**
   `kd-app::speed`: the asked speed by zoom from A4.11's table (person 1, close camp 60, camp 480, valley 21,600 and region 259,200 game seconds a real second), the logarithm of the speed following the logarithm of the view width in a straight line between stops and rising toward top speed above the region stop; who sets the speed, the first active of: pause (yours or the system's), the dial or the lock, zoom (skip, overnight mode and the director join with their alphas, keeping `TIM-15`'s order); real speed is the asked one or what the phone holds, whichever is lower, and the speed shown is the real one over the last real second (A4.11).
   The numbers live in `data/tuning/time.md` (`zoom_speeds`, `lead_frames = 3`); the region's row waits for its stop (α19b), the zoom reaching 0.50 for now.
   The start view moves to the camp stop (zoom 0.30, over the first camp's cave mouth, yaw −0.45), so a new world opens at camp speed.
   Commit `T03a.6: speed by zoom, pause, dial and lock (TIM-01, TIM-04, TIM-15, A4.11)`.

7. `T03a.7` **The time bar (`PRE-33`, `PRE-34`, `TIM-04`, A12.1, A12.2).**

8. `T03a.8` **Light, time and season (`PRE-30`, A11.3, A11.4).**
   `crates/kd-render/src/light.rs`: from the snapshot's `SkyState` at the view's place, light by the sun's height per A11.4's table (below −6° the moon, at 0.32 × a phase factor from 0.2 new to 1 full; −6° to 6° a blend; 6° to 25° the dawn row in the morning and the dusk row in the evening; above 25° the day row), values blending over 4° at each border; the sun's direction to `uSunDir` in GL coordinates (x east, y up, z south), and the shadow pass following it.
   The palette row in use is computed on the CPU by OKLab interpolation between its two neighbouring versions in steps of an eighth and uploaded (1 KB) when it changes (A11.3), so each frame uses one row; the palette texture keeps the four versions for the tables.
   Day and night at speed (A11.4): from the region stop outward, and whenever a game day passes in under 10 real seconds, light is averaged over the day (the row between day and night by the night's share for the place and season, shadows held at the season's noon sun); a switch between the two eases over one real second; seasons blend over a season's first two game days.
   The picture's date (A5.5) now comes from the snapshot, so plants' season states follow it and areas are made again once a game day has passed (A11.5).
   Commit `T03a.8: light by hour and season (PRE-30, A11.3, A11.4)`.

**On the phone:**
1. Open the app: it is night at the camp (history starts at midnight), the land dim and bluish under the moon; touch the screen: the bar shows `Year 1, spring, day 1, 00:0x` and `a day in 3 minutes`.
2. Wait about 45 seconds: dawn comes, colours warm, long shadows stretch from the cliff and the trees; then full day, then dusk; the shadows turn with the sun.
3. Pinch in to the person stop: the bar says `real time`; pinch out to the valley stop: `a season a minute`, and the light holds steady instead of flashing day and night.
4. Tap pause: time stops; move the dial: the speed holds wherever you zoom; tap the lock at `an hour a minute` and zoom about: it stays.
5. Leave the app and come back a minute later: the date is where you left it.

**Not in this alpha:** people (α03b); rain, storms, snow and anomalies (α13); the warmth of the land through the year and plants' seasons moving with it (α05); skip and the story director (α11b); overnight mode (α43a); `Workers` (α07c); the moon's eclipses (α20a).

**Risks:**
- The sim thread and the GL thread fighting over `SimControl`: `try_lock` on the GL side and a skipped write are the design (A4.12); the pacing test runs with a fake clock.
- Day and night flashing at middle speeds: A11.4's averaging rule and its 1 s ease; the screenshot set at the valley stop and the brightness test guard it.
- Settling too slow on the phone once more layers run (α05 adds cover): A4.9's budget is about 155 ms a game day for the whole world, so the island's 600 days stay within a few seconds.

**Serves:** `BIO-08` (part: everyone different, inborn numbers drawn round the average), `BIO-13` (part: six body parts), `BIO-17` (part: average differences in size and strength), `BIO-22` (part: looks as two copies, mixed at the start), `PRE-27` (part: figures of blocks, posed 10 times a second, built from looks and build), `PRE-28` (part: tiny figures and the camp point), `PRE-44` (part: idle, sit and sleep movements), `PRE-46` (part: the person figure), `PRE-03` (part: the person stop), `WLD-13` (part: poses come from the world, never the camera).

### α03c Walking (about 5.5 hours)

**Goal:** people now do things as activities with a start and an end on the world's event queue: they walk out from the cave, sit or stand a while, walk back and sleep at night, moving smoothly at every speed; the owner taps a person to select and follow them, and every run repeats exactly however it is split.

**Serves:** `TIM-17` (part: activities with an end, results at the end, positions worked out from the way and the pace, the same at any speed), `TIM-16` (part: the same events in the same order however the run is split), `TIM-10` (part: figures move at real speed at the person stop), `PRE-06` (part: pick anyone and follow), `PRE-33` (part: tap to select), `PRE-44` (part: walking), `BIO-21` (part: walking speeds), `WLD-13` (part), `PRN-11` (part).

**Architecture:** `A3.4` (reservations), `A4.3`, `A4.4`, `A4.6`, `A4.8` (one cluster, spills, the barrier), `A4.10`, `A4.13`, `A4.16`, `A11.2` (colour 1, picking), `A11.8` (`loop_phase`), `A12.2`, `A12.4` (follow), `A15.9`.

**Needs:** α03b.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-core` (`act`, `motion`), `kd-sim` (`queue`, `activity`, `cluster`, `barrier`, `hash`), `kd-people` (`store.rs` activity columns, `body/walk.rs`, `stub.rs`), `kd-view` (`loop_phase`, `ActView`), `kd-render` (`pick`, colour 1, `post.frag` selection edge), `kd-ui` (selection, follow), `kd-app`, `kd-tools` (`kd det`), `tools/check.sh` (step 6), `data/tuning/people.md`.

**Tasks:**

1. `T03c.1` **The event queue (`TIM-17`, `TIM-16`, A4.3).**
   `crates/kd-sim/src/queue.rs`: A4.3's 40-byte `#[repr(C)] Event` (`time`, `subject`, `source`, `seq`, `stamp`, `payload`, `kind: EvKind`, `phase: Phase`) declared with `fixed!`; the phases `Barrier`, `Window`, `Act`, `World`, `End`, `Body`, `Notice`, `Choose`; a `BinaryHeap` ordered by (time, phase, subject, seq, source), popping the least; a subject has at most one live event per (`seq`, `source`), asserted in debug builds; an event whose stamp is older than its subject's is dropped, and the heap is rebuilt without stale events when they pass half of it; handlers schedule only for a later second, or the same second in a later phase (debug assertion).
   Commit `T03c.1: the event queue and its total order (TIM-17, TIM-16, A4.3)`.

2. `T03c.2` **Activities (`TIM-17`, A4.4).**
   `kd-core::act`: `Target`, `Partial` (`Position`, `Share`, `OnThing`, `Nothing`), `ActKind` (the everyday activities as they arrive: `Walk`, `Rest`, `Sit`, `Sleep` now), `Activity { kind, bp, start, end, stamp, target, repeats_done, repeats_allowed }`, `Plan` (what to start: kind, target, length, path) and the trait `ActRules<C>` (`finish`, `partial`, `go_on`).
   The person store gains A4.4's activity columns (about 48 bytes) and the path.
   `crates/kd-sim/src/activity.rs`: `start(cx, who, plan)` pushes the activity's End event; the End event calls `finish`, then schedules `Choose` that second; repeats each get their own End event and `go_on` decides on the next with no new choice; `interrupt(cx, who, why)` applies `partial` by its `Partial` (a walker stands where they got to), raises the stamp, and schedules `Choose`.
   `crates/kd-people/src/body/walk.rs`: the `ActRules` of `Walk`, `Rest`, `Sit` and `Sleep` (A8.3 lists the everyday activities; their effects on the body arrive in α04b).
   Commit `T03c.2: activities with an end (TIM-17, A4.4)`.

3. `T03c.3` **Movement along a way (`TIM-17`, `BIO-21`, A4.6).**
   `kd-core::motion`: `Path { t0: GameTime, pts: SmallVec<[Pos; 8]>, at: SmallVec<[f32; 8]> }` (seconds after `t0` at each point) and `pos_at(p, t, frac) -> Pos` (binary search for the leg, then `offset` along it, A3.7); a walk ends at `ceil(at[last])`; height is the ground's.
   The window cap: no being moves more than `M = 1.25 km` in one window; a leg sequence that would is slowed so its window's total ends at the cap (A4.6).
   `walk_speed(p)` (A8.3): 4.5 km/h for a fit adult on open flat ground, × 0.75 for children under 10 and × 0.85 over 55 (A8.7's slower young and old, tuned in `data/tuning/people.md`), × Tobler's rule on the leg's slope (`6 × e^(−3.5 × |slope + 0.05|)` km/h, scaled to 4.5 on the flat, A5.12).
   Commit `T03c.3: movement along a way (TIM-17, BIO-21, A4.6)`.

4. `T03c.4` **One cluster, spills and the barrier (`TIM-16`, A3.4, A4.8).**
   `crates/kd-sim/src/cluster.rs`: at each barrier, positions of every being at B; union-find over a grid of 2,048 m squares on the torus, joining beings within `L = 4.0 km` (A4.8 step 2; the constants `WINDOW`, `M`, `R`, `L` in `kd_sim::cluster`, saved in the world header); clusters ranked by smallest member uid, the rank being the uid lane (A3.4); each cluster's reservation per kind (A3.4's starting sizes: people 2 + members ÷ 20, things 64 + 16 a member); an entity made past a reservation goes to the cluster's spill list, merged at the barrier in rank then ordinal order with its handles rewritten (A4.8).
   Clusters run one after another on the calling thread here (one band makes one cluster); their parallel run, with the owner table's split, comes with the bands of α12 (A4.17).
   `crates/kd-sim/src/barrier.rs`: A4.8's barrier steps that exist now, in order: merge in rank order, `end_window` for every store, batch systems due (α03a), clusters formed, the window phase (empty until talk, α06b), clusters run to the step's end.
   Commit `T03c.4: clusters, spills and the barrier (A3.4, A4.8)`.

5. `T03c.5` **A stand-in day on the queue (`TIM-17`).**
   `kd-people::stub` v1 replaces α03b's `pose_at` with a stand-in chooser called at each `Choose`, until α04b's needs and α04c's choosing replace it: from 06:00 to 21:00, walk to a keyed spot within 300 m of the cave mouth that a straight way reaches (sampled every 4 m: no slope over 35° by `slope_at`, no water over 1 m deep), then `Sit` or `Rest` there 20–60 game minutes (keyed), then walk back; after 21:00, walk to their sleeping spot and `Sleep` until 06:00.
   Straight ways are themselves a stand-in: α03d's routes replace them.
   Commit `T03c.5: a stand-in day of walks and rests (TIM-17)`.

6. `T03c.6` **Walking drawn at every speed (`TIM-10`, `PRE-44`, A4.13, A11.8).**
   The snapshot carries each person's path near `T_w` and their previous and current activities (A4.13, A11.9); the GL thread places each figure at `pos_at(path, T_d)`, heading along the leg, and shows the previous activity until `T_d` passes the current one's start (A4.13).
   `kd-view::loop_phase(uid, act, shared, t_d, real_s, speed) -> f32` (A11.8): while the display speed is at most 4 times real, the phase follows display time, a walk playing one loop per two steps at its speed; faster, it runs on unpaused real time plus an offset from `hash64(uid)`; a change between the two carries the phase over and eases the rate over 0.5 s.
   Commit `T03c.6: walking drawn at every speed (TIM-10, PRE-44, A11.8)`.

7. `T03c.7` **Picking and following (`PRE-06`, `PRE-33`, A11.2, A12.2, A12.4).**
   The art target gains colour 1 (A11.2): a 24-bit index into the frame's pick table and an 8-bit kind (ground 0); figures, plants and loose rocks write theirs.
   `Renderer::pick(at_px)` reads 13 × 13 art pixels through a pixel-pack buffer and a fence without stalling, answered by `take_pick()` one or two frames later: the nearest id wins, figure before herd before thing before plant; with none, the centre's depth gives a ground position (A11.2).
   A tap on the world picks (A12.2); a picked person is selected: the post pass draws a one-pixel `f3` edge round the selected id (A11.2), and a small panel at the bottom shows `Person <n>` and a Follow button (cards come in α04d); following keeps the camera's target on the person's `pos_at(T_d)` until a drag (`PRE-06`).
   Commit `T03c.7: picking, selection and follow (PRE-06, PRE-33, A11.2)`.

8. `T03c.8` **The state hash and `kd det` v0 (`TIM-16`, `RES-05`, A3.1, A15.9).**
   `kd_sim::World::state_hash() -> u64`: `num::hash64` over the canonical little-endian encoding of the header, the clock, every store's columns in slot order (dead slots and generations included), the queue's live events sorted by their key, and the cells' changing state (A3.1 rule 9; α07a moves this encoding into the save's chunks, A14.3).
   `kd det first-camp --days 3` (A15.9 item 2's split-anywhere form for now): runs the first camp three game days twice, once in one call and once in steps of random length from 1 s to a game day with `stop` firing at random event counts, and compares state hashes at each game day; `tools/check.sh` step 6 becomes this command.
   Commit `T03c.8: state hash and kd det split-anywhere (TIM-16, RES-05, A15.9)`.

9. `T03c.9` **Deliver (`PRC-11`).**
   Golden scenes `camp-walk` (close-camp stop at 09:30 on day 2, people walking out) and `walk-person` (person stop on a walker, 8 frames at real speed); `versionCode=1033`, `versionName=a03c`; `bench/cloud/a03c.json` adds events a second and µs a person a game day for the stand-in day (A4.15's `Probe` comes in α07d; here the whole step's time over 20 people); then P0's steps 5 to 8.

- `kd-core`: `motion::tests::continuous_across_legs_and_seams` (A4.6).
- `kd det first-camp --days 3` passes (`RES-05`), also on arm64 under qemu in `tools/check.sh` step 3 as `cargo test -p kd-sim --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu split_anywhere`.
- `kd-render`: `pick::tests::figure_before_plant` (a fixed scene: a tap on each kind picks it, A11.2).
- `kd-ui`: `selection::tests::drag_ends_follow`.
- Screens: golden `camp-walk`, `walk-person`; smoke `tap selects` (a tap on a figure in `camp-walk` makes `kd.selected()` that person's uid).

**On the phone:**
1. Open in the morning (or let night pass): people walk out of the cave in different directions, legs swinging, then sit or stand somewhere for a while and walk back; at night they all return and lie down.
2. Tap a walking person: a bright one-pixel edge rings them and a small panel says `Person 7` with Follow; tap Follow: the camera stays on them as they walk.
3. Pinch in to the person stop while following: they walk at real speed, every step visible; pinch out to the camp stop: they hurry along at camp speed, legs still moving steadily.
4. Drag the screen: following stops.

**Not in this alpha:** routes round cliffs and rivers (α03d: today's walks are straight lines that avoid steep ground and deep water); needs, eating, drinking and real sleep (α04b); choosing with reasons (α04c); the person card (α04d); clusters in parallel (α12); the noticing and interruption by danger (α12c).

**Risks:**
- A stale event surviving a reload or a split: stamps and the split-anywhere check, run at every merge from now on (A4.16).
- Pick reads stalling the GL thread on the phone: the pixel-pack buffer and fence answer a frame or two later by design (A11.2); fallback, rays against figure boxes and the height field.
- Straight walks crossing awkward ground: they test slope and water every 4 m; any oddity is named in the note as gone in α03d.

### α03d Ways (about 4.5 hours)

**Goal:** people find real ways: round the cliff through its gaps, along the river to a ford, through woods and over the floodplain, at speeds set by slope and cover; walks wear paths into the ground that the owner sees appear, and a way back is the way out reversed.

**Serves:** `TIM-17` (part: the way taken and its time), `BIO-21` (part: 20–30 km a day on open ground, slower uphill and in woods), `WLD-12` (part: walks cross the cells' ground; paths worn on cells), `MAT-08` (part: worn paths, fading after a few unused years), `MND-09` (part: ways, the last way reversed), `WLD-01` (part: no way crosses the polar seam), `PRE-26` (part: fords drawn).

**Architecture:** `A5.12`, `A5.3` (gaps, fords), `A8.15` (ways), `A2.9` (B10's files).

**Needs:** α03c.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-core` (`geo/grid.rs`), `kd-world` (`path/`), `kd-people` (`stub.rs`, the `last_way` column), `kd-sim` (path cache at the barrier), `kd-render` (the `path` surface), `data/tuning/world.md`, `data/models/surfaces.md`.

**Tasks:**

1. `T03d.1` **B10's grid and smoothing, recovered (`WLD-01`, A2.9).**
   Recover `b10-map/src/sq.rs` into `crates/kd-core/src/geo/grid.rs` (`wrap_abs`, `octile`, the 8-neighbour moves on the torus, in `f32` and integers, without `f64`) and `b10-map/src/path.rs`'s `los`, `smooth` and `length` into `crates/kd-world/src/path/smooth.rs` (one pass skipping ahead while the next point is in sight, keeping worn paths' points, A5.12); name the sources in the commit.
   Commit `T03d.1: B10's grid and smoothing (A5.12; from pretests/b10-map)`.

2. `T03d.2` **Ways across cells (`WLD-12`, `WLD-01`, A5.12).**
   `crates/kd-world/src/path/cells.rs`: A* on the 8-neighbour cell grid, a step's time from slope by Tobler's rule (about 5 km/h on the flat), cover (trees over half: × 1.3; marsh × 2), worn edges (a fifth quicker), fords (a river cell crossed only at its ford points, where the skeleton's riffle is under 0.3 m deep; closed elsewhere above `depth × speed` 0.5 m²/s), sea, deep lakes and the seam row closed (A3.7), a step across an escarpment over 3 m closed except at the skeleton's gaps (A5.3); ties to the lower cell index.
   A landmass label per cell refuses unreachable ends at once; a search stops at 100,000 expansions as "too far" (A5.12); trips over 50 km on the block grid wait for whole worlds (α19a).
   Commit `T03d.2: ways across world cells (WLD-12, A5.12)`.

3. `T03d.3` **Ways inside areas (`WLD-12`, A5.12).**
   `crates/kd-world/src/path/area.rs`: A* on the 4 m patches of the areas being read (16 times fewer nodes than metres; the last metres walked straight), closed at cliff lines (`solid_at` and slopes over 35° by point reads), water too deep to wade (over 1 m), thickets (a patch with bushes at density over 0.6) and structures (none yet), then smoothed; in caves, the skeleton's chamber graph.
   A whole way: the start area's patches to the cell where it leaves, cells to the end's cell, the end area's patches, stitched and smoothed once more; reads only what A5.3 allows (point reads, never pictures).
   Commit `T03d.3: ways inside areas and caves (A5.12)`.

4. `T03d.4` **The path cache and the last way (`MND-09`, A5.12, A8.15).**
   `crates/kd-sim/src/paths.rs`: world ways cached by (start cell, end cell, walker class), valid only while no region meeting the bounding box of the way's ellipse `{x : h(s, x) + h(x, e) ≤ its cost}` has a newer cost version (a version rises when a cell's cost class changes: worn edges now; snow, ice, fire and floods later), so a hit equals a fresh search (A3.1 rule 8); clusters read it in a window and add new ways at the barrier in cluster order; 65,536 ways, oldest dropped; scratch about 14 MB a worker (A5.12).
   The person store gains `last_way` (176 bytes, A8.2): going back to where the last walk began, from within 30 m of its end, takes it reversed while every region and area it crossed keeps its cost version (A8.15).
   The stand-in chooser (α03c) now asks for real ways.
   Commit `T03d.4: path cache and the way back (MND-09, A5.12, A8.15)`.

5. `T03d.5` **Worn paths (`MAT-08`, `WLD-12`, A5.12).**
   `CellState`'s sparse map `worn` (A5.2): each walk adds one wear to each cell edge it crosses, counted once per walk, with the day; a worn edge is walked a fifth quicker (tuned) and fades 3 game years after its last use (`MAT-08`); walks along worn edges pass through their cells' keyed path points (A5.12).
   Areas draw them from their cell (`WLD-12`): metres within 0.6 m of the line through an edge's path points, once its wear passes 20 walks (tuned), take the `path` surface (`data/models/surfaces.md`, ladder `path`), so the picture shows trodden paths, saving nothing (`WLD-13`).
   Commit `T03d.5: worn paths on cells, drawn in areas (MAT-08, WLD-12)`.

6. `T03d.6` **Deliver (`PRC-11`).**
   Golden scene `ford-path` (camp stop over the ford nearest the camp after a 20-day run of the stand-in day from a fixed seed, `kd.time`); `versionCode=1034`, `versionName=a03d`; `bench/cloud/a03d.json` adds a 20 km world way's search time (A5.12: at most 0.3 ms on a held middle core), one inside an area (at most 50 µs) and the cache's hit rate over the 20-day run; then P0's steps 5 to 8.

**Data:** `data/tuning/world.md` (`ford_limit = 0.5`, `wood_factor = 1.3`, `marsh_factor = 2.0`, `worn_speedup = 0.2`, `worn_fade_years = 3`, `worn_draw_walks = 20`, `thicket_density = 0.6`); `data/models/surfaces.md` (`path`).

**Tests:**
- `kd-world` (`WLD-12`, `WLD-01`): `path::tests::b10_numbers` (over 1,000 random pairs on the island, smoothed ways at most 1.5% longer than the ideal on average and 5% at the 95th percentile, A5.12); `path::tests::never_across_seam_or_cliff` (no way crosses row 0 or an escarpment step outside a gap, over 10,000 ways on a test grid holding the seam); `path::tests::fords_only` (no way crosses the river except at ford points); `path::tests::ford_near_camp` (a ford within 3 km of the first camp's cave, on its side of the river, on each of 20 seeds); `path::tests::unreachable_refused_at_once`.
- `kd-sim`: `paths::tests::hit_equals_fresh` (10,000 queries with random cost changes anywhere: every cache hit equals a fresh search, A5.12); `paths::tests::reversed_way_only_while_valid`.
- `kd-people` (`BIO-21`): `walk::tests::day_on_open_ground` (an adult walking the floodplain for 6 game hours covers 24–30 km; uphill and through woods less, `BIO-21`'s Done when).
- `kd det first-camp --days 3` still passes.
- Screens: golden `ford-path`.

**On the phone:**
1. Watch people leave the cave: they no longer walk straight; they go round the cliff to a gap, follow the river to a shallow ford and cross there, and take the easier way through the woods.
2. Follow one out and back: they come home the way they went.
3. Let several days pass at the valley stop, then pinch in near the cave: pale trodden paths have appeared in the grass where people walk most.

**Not in this alpha:** walking together and a carried baby (α06c); worn paths fading over years (it starts counting now; the owner will see it over game years); snow, ice and floods changing ways (α13, α20a, α20c); the noticing of what cells hold along a walk (α10a).

**Risks:**
- Searches too slow on the phone for many walkers: the cache and the reversed way, as A8.21 counts them; the cloud benchmark records the hit rate from now on.
- Ways looking robotic: one smoothing pass leaves about 1% extra length (B10); fallback, any-angle search (Theta*), A5.12's.
- A ford missing where people need one: every river cell's riffles are fords, and the camp's side has one within 3 km, checked by `path::tests::ford_near_camp`.

### α04a Wild food (about 5.5 hours)

**Goal:** the land bears food in its season: hazelnuts, acorns, blackberries, crab apples, nettles, wild garlic, pignut and reedmace roots become things when gathered, carried in the hands and eaten, rot where they lie, and a stripped bush stays stripped until its next ripening; people know the food places of their home range and go gathering on their walks.

**Serves:** `MAT-01` (part: wild foods as items of class plant and water), `MAT-02` (part: forms and sizes), `MAT-03` (part: the 18 characteristics), `MAT-09` (part: gathering takes from the plant and its cell), `MAT-10` (part: the first items and things), `MAT-11` (part: carrying in the hands), `MAT-16` (part: only what `MIL-01` needs), `MAT-17` (part: the Complete and mass checks), `MAT-19` (part: rotting and drying), `WLD-12` (part: kept areas hold only taken yields and things left), `WLD-30` (part: yields scaled to the 60-day year), `WLD-31` (part: yields, ripe windows, taking), `BIO-20` (part: home-range places and food by season), `MND-28` (part: places and facts at the start), `PRN-05`.

**Architecture:** `A5.2` (`notable`, `taken`), `A5.3` (areas the simulation makes), `A5.4`, `A5.13`, `A6.2`, `A6.3`, `A6.4`, `A6.5`, `A6.8` (the bucket index), `A6.9` (plain uses), `A6.12`, `A6.13`, `A6.14` (Complete, mass), `A7.2`, `A7.3`, `A7.4`, `A8.8` (starting knowledge), `A8.13` (the map).

**Needs:** α03d.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-data` (kinds `Item`, `State`, `Shape`; `Plant.yields`; `kd catalog build`'s ladders), `kd-core` (`kinds::ItemKind`, `Chars`), `kd-things` (`items`, `states`, `things`, `bucket`, `carry`, `timers`, `gather.rs`), `kd-life` (`plants/ripe.rs`, `plants/pools.rs`), `kd-world` (`area/record.rs`, `area/kept.rs`, `cells::notable`, α02d's `area/contents.rs`: `PlantRules`), `kd-people` (`mind/map.rs`, `setup.rs`, `stub.rs`), `kd-sim` (`world`, the area cache, `ThingWorld`, `PlantRules` over `kd-life`), `kd-render` (held things, ripe looks), `data/items/`, `data/states.md`, `data/models/shapes.md`, `data/plants/`.

**Tasks:**

1. `T04a.1` **Items and states (`MAT-01`, `MAT-02`, `MAT-03`, `MAT-10`, `MAT-17`, A6.2, A6.3).**
   `kd-data` kind `Item` with A6.2's fields: `class` (one of `MAT-01`'s nine), `form` (one of `MAT-02`'s 13), `size`, all 18 `[characteristics]` written out (A3.6), `main` (never food or water), `[[timers]]`, `[breaks]` (optional for raw plant parts), `mild_taste`, `[look] colour`, check-only `fits` and `tags`; kind `State` (A6.3: classes, value shifts by class, states it clears, timer factors, how it shows); `ItemKind(u16)` and `Chars(u64)` (18 values of 3 bits in `MAT-03`'s order) in `kd-core::kinds` (A6.2).

   Commit `T04a.3: things, carrying and the bucket index (MAT-10, MAT-11, A6.4, A6.5, A6.8)`.

4. `T04a.4` **Rotting (`MAT-19`, A6.12).**
   `crates/kd-things/src/timers.rs`: A6.12's timer groups: things sharing conditions (an area's open ground, a carrier's hands) form a group with one clock per timer kind, `G(t) = ∫ condition factor dt`, advanced in O(1) at each condition step (the hourly weather step); factors by temperature band (frozen below 0 °C 0, cold 0–5 °C 0.25, mild 5–15 °C 0.5, warm 15–25 °C 1, hot over 25 °C 1.5), by state (`dried` × 0.2, `wet` × 1.5, A6.12); a row (24 bytes) holds its own factor and the `G` it is due at, in a heap per kind; a group has one pending event, so a weather step costs one step a group; a finished rotting timer sets `rotten` (A6.3).

5. `T04a.5` **Taking a yield and kept areas (`WLD-12`, `MAT-09`, A5.3, A5.4, A6.9, A6.13).**
   The simulation now makes areas where people act (A5.3): `kd-sim` holds area parts in a cache keyed by all they read (a skeleton by its area; a bucket's contents by area, bucket, day and the versions of the 4 × 4 cells read), so dropping a part changes nothing (A3.1 rule 8).
   `crates/kd-world/src/area/record.rs`: `AreaRecord { id, next_ordinal, updated, marks, patch_sets }` (A5.4) with the mark `TakenYield { spot or patch, part, grams, regrows_at }`: the spot shows less of that yield until it regrows at its rate, or until its next ripening for fruit; a record exists only while a mark or a kept thing remains, and when the last fades it is deleted and the area's epoch rises (A3.4), so the area is the seed's again.
   `ThingWorld::take_yield(spot, part, grams) -> Taken` (A6.1): the yield becomes a thing whose size and quality come from the spot's place uid (the same whoever takes it), the cell's `taken` share for its group rises, and the mark is written (A5.4, A6.13: gathering takes from the plant and its cell, and nothing comes from nothing).
   `crates/kd-world/src/area/kept.rs`: `kept_view(rec, things, at) -> KeptView`, marks faded by formula to the date, read by the picture so a stripped bush is drawn stripped wherever the camera looks (A5.4, `WLD-13`); dormant blocks on disk come with whole worlds (`MIL-04`).
   `crates/kd-things/src/gather.rs`: the plain use `gather` (A6.9) as a repeated activity: each repeat of one game minute takes up to a handful (or one larger piece) of the ripe yield of the spot or patch the gatherer stands at, landing as it ends (`TIM-17`), until the hands are full, nothing ripe is in reach, or 30 minutes pass.
   Commit `T04a.5: gathering, taken yields and kept areas (WLD-12, MAT-09, A5.4, A6.9)`.

**On the phone:**
1. Let time run at the camp stop on an autumn day (pause at the valley stop and drag the dial to move fast to autumn, then play): people walk out to hazel thickets and oaks, stand at them gathering, and come away with something in their hands, then sit and eat.
2. Pinch in on a hazel bush being gathered: brown nuts on it before, fewer after; on bramble, dark berries.
3. Follow a gatherer home: the bush they stripped stays stripped when you look at it again later in the season.
4. In spring, gatherers go to nettles and wild garlic instead; in winter, to reedmace and pignut roots.

- The area cache changing results when dropped: its key holds every version it read (A3.1 rule 8), and `kd det` runs with the cache dropped at random barriers from now on.
- A kept area that never fades back (a mark with no end): every mark kind has its fade rule (A5.4), and the faded-area test runs each kind.

### α04b Hunger, thirst and sleep (about 4.5 hours)

**Goal:** bodies run on food, water and sleep: bellies empty with work and fill with meals, people drink at the river and springs, sleep when tired, and grow thin or die when they cannot; when a need turns urgent it stops what they are doing, and they set off to meet it.

**Serves:** `BIO-09` (part: hunger, condition, thirst and rest with their real effects), `BIO-10` (part: food value by the food characteristic), `BIO-14` (part: death by hunger or thirst, with its cause), `BIO-21` (part: eat, drink and sleep), `MND-07` (part: the four body needs, urgent below 20), `TIM-17` (part: a need below 20 interrupts; what builds up keeps its share), `TIM-18` (part: daily rates kept), `MND-21` (part: taste: bitter spat out unless starving), `BIO-12` (part: poison decided at its worst), `WLD-17` (part: drinking at running water).

**Architecture:** `A4.5`, `A4.7` (interruptions by need), `A8.3`, `A8.4`, `A8.6` (death through limits), `A8.10` (body needs), `A14.8` (deaths logged).

**Needs:** α04a.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-core` (`smooth`), `kd-people` (`body/levels.rs`, `body/food.rs`, `body/limits.rs`, `body/sleep.rs`, `mind/needs.rs`, `stub.rs`), `kd-sim` (Body events, `interrupt`, `deaths`, the history list), `kd-things` (`drink`), `kd-render` (eat, drink and sleep poses), `kd-ui` (`selection`: need bars), `data/tuning/body.md`, `data/text/cards.md`.

**Tasks:**

1. `T04b.1` **Smooth values and the Body event (`MND-14`, A4.5).**
   `kd-core::smooth`: `Smooth { v0: f32, t0: GameTime, rate: f32, lo: f32, hi: f32, stamp: u32 }` with `at(t)` (`clamp(v0 + rate × (t − t0), lo, hi)`), `rebase(t, rate)` (`v0 = at(t)`, `t0 = t`, stamp + 1) and `crossing(level) -> Option<GameTime>` (the first whole second at or past it); values never hold NaN (A3.2).
   Each person has one Body event, at the earliest crossing among their levels that triggers something; a re-base bringing it forward replaces it by stamp, one moving it later leaves it to fire, find nothing and re-arm (A4.5).
   Commit `T04b.1: smooth values and the one Body event (A4.5)`.

2. `T04b.2` **The body's levels (`BIO-09`, `TIM-18`, A8.3).**
   `crates/kd-people/src/body/levels.rs`, A8.3's table for what `MIL-01` holds: `belly` (a day's food, 0–1.5), falling by `use ÷ 24` an hour; `condition` (0–100), +5 × use a day while the belly is over 1 and −5 × use while it is 0; `water` (a day's water, 0–1, 3 litres), falling by `use_w ÷ 24` an hour; `dry` (days, 0–3), rising while water is 0 and repaid first by drinking; `rest` (hours awake left, −20 to 16), −1 an hour awake (× 1.3 heavy work), asleep +2 (children +1.4, × 0.5 when cold, hungry or hurting); `chill` and `heat` columns, held at 0 until α05 gives warmth.
   Food use (A8.3) = a day's food a day × (mass ÷ the average adult's)^0.75 × activity (rest 0.9, light work 1.1, walking 1.2, heavy work 1.5), + 0.2 growing, with + 0.25 chilled from α05 and pregnancy and nursing from α06c; water use 1 by default, more in heat and heavy work from α05 (A8.3).
   Every rate in `data/tuning/body.md`, each with its life and game length checked by `TIM-18`'s rule (A4.2).
   Commit `T04b.2: the body's levels (BIO-09, TIM-18, A8.3)`.

3. `T04b.3` **Eating, drinking and sleeping (`BIO-10`, `BIO-21`, `MND-21`, `BIO-12`, A8.3, A8.4).**
   `Eat` (A8.4): a meal of 15–30 minutes fills the belly's room from what is held, a kilogram giving 2^(food − 4) of an adult's day and 0.2 l of water per point of its water characteristic (`BIO-10`), quality never changing it; taste (`MND-21`): food with poison or medicine of 2 or more tastes bitter, unless fruit or marked `mild_taste`, and is spat out unless hunger is below 20; cut short, a meal gives its share (`Partial::Share`).
   Poison (A8.4, `BIO-12`) is decided once, at its worst about 6 hours after eating, by its value and the dose against body mass; its harm (cramps, illness, death) is A8.4's, with `poisoned` set on the person; at `MIL-01` only known poisons exist, so this runs in tests (`MAT-16`).
   `Drink` (`crates/kd-things/src/drink.rs`, the plain use `gather` filling oneself): at a river, stream or spring a drink a minute, `fresh_water` taken from the water there (never from the sea, which makes thirst worse, `WLD-26` from α20c) until water is full; cut short, its share.
   `Sleep`'s `finish` runs the wake job (A8.3), which at `MIL-01` resets the day's counters; dreams, memories and plans join it in Stage 2.
   Poses: `eat` and `drink` (kneeling, hand to mouth, from the mockup's `sit` and `scrape` frames) and `sleep` (α03b) in `figures/poses.rs` (A11.8's `MIL-01` list).
   Commit `T04b.3: eating, drinking and sleeping (BIO-10, BIO-21, MND-21, A8.4)`.

4. `T04b.4` **The body needs and urgent interruptions (`MND-07`, `TIM-17`, A4.7, A8.10).**
   `crates/kd-people/src/mind/needs.rs`: hunger = 100 × min(1, belly ÷ 0.75), thirst = 100 × min(1, water ÷ 0.75), rest = 100 × clamp(rest ÷ 16), warmth = 100 − max(chill, heat) (A8.3); discomfort `D(L) = 100 × ((100 − L) ÷ 100)^k` with k = 2 for these four (A8.10).
   A need crossing below 20 is a Body event: `worth_interrupting(cx, who, why)` says yes unless the current activity serves that need (A8.9), and `interrupt` keeps what the activity had built up (`TIM-17`); at rest −20 people fall asleep where they stand (A8.3).
   The selection panel (α03c, `kd-ui::selection`) shows the four body needs as bars under the person's number: hunger, thirst, rest and warmth, each 48 × 4 UI pixels in `f2` over `shade`, `o3` once urgent (below 20), with its label from `data/text/cards.md`; the snapshot carries the selected person's four levels (A12.3); α04d's card replaces the panel.
   Commit `T04b.4: body needs and urgent interruptions (MND-07, TIM-17, A4.7, A8.10)`.

5. `T04b.5` **Death through the body's limits (`BIO-14`, A8.6, A14.8).**
   `crates/kd-people/src/body/limits.rs`: condition 0 is death by hunger, `dry` 3 death by thirst (`BIO-09`); each makes `Death { cause, how, place, age }`, `how` from the activity under way and the last meal or drink ("hunger, after 20 days without food, at the cave"), never "unknown" (`BIO-14`); the person leaves the store at the next barrier (A8.2); the death is logged in the world's history list, which A14.8's log replaces in α07b; the body lies where it fell until α06c makes it a corpse.
   The two test lands of the scenario tests below, in A5.6's schema under `scenes/lands/` (read by the tests through `kd-data`'s `Land`, its `compile` feature a dev-dependency; α07c's scenes name them): `barren-dry.toml`, the first region's numbers with `island_km = 4`, `base_height = "20 m"`, `relief = "5 m"`, `valley.flow = "0 m3/s"`, `escarpment.height = "0 m"` with no caves or shelters, every season's rain `"0 mm"`, `cover = { biome = "barren", trees = 0, bushes = 0, grass = 0, reeds = 0, bare = 1 }`, `herds = []` and no small game, so it holds no river, stream, spring or plant (α02a's rules); and `barren-river.toml`, the same with `valley.flow = "8 m3/s"`, a river and still no plant; their adult starts in the open at the islet's centre, knowing its few places.
   Why: a person who can explore (α04c) finds water and food on the first region however much they forget, and a pass rule may not be loosened later (`RES-09`), so the limits are tested where nothing can be found.
   Commit `T04b.5: death by hunger and thirst, with its cause (BIO-14, A8.6)`.

6. `T04b.6` **The stand-in chooser by need (`MND-07`).**
   Until α04c's choosing, the stand-in serves the most pressing body need below 70 first: thirst to the nearest known water, hunger to food held or the best known ripe place, rest to the sleeping spot (any time of day), then the α04a day; it reads only the person's own places and facts (A8.13), never the world.
   Commit `T04b.6: the stand-in day serves body needs first`.

7. `T04b.7` **Deliver (`PRC-11`).**

**On the phone:**
1. Follow someone through a day: they walk to the river or a spring and kneel to drink; later they go gathering and eat; at night they sleep, and on a long day someone tired lies down before dark.
2. Let a few days pass at the camp stop: people go to drink every day, and nobody grows hungry in summer.
3. Tap a person: the small panel now shows their four body needs as bars (hunger, thirst, rest, warmth).

**Not in this alpha:** warmth from weather, the cave and huddling (α05); the other five needs (α04c); choosing by score with reasons (α04c); the full card (α04d); wounds, pain and bleeding (α06c for births, α09b for the rest); variety and scurvy (α15) and cooked food (α14a); corpses (α06c).

**Risks:**
- Rates in game time drifting from life: each one passes `TIM-18`'s rule check, and the starvation and thirst tests run at real and at top speed.
- Everyone sleeping at once in the day: rest falls only while awake, and the stand-in's night sleep resets it; a test checks fewer than 3 daytime sleepers a day in the first camp.

### α04c Choosing (about 5.5 hours)

**Goal:** the stand-in day is gone: at every activity's end each person scores up to 30 options by what they do for all nine needs, with effort, time, distance and what they believe about each food, picks one, and keeps the three reasons that put it ahead with the options it beat; they learn places and foods from what they find, so the day has a rhythm of its own.

**Serves:** `MND-09` (part: options, score, picking, reasons kept, habits), `MND-07` (part: all nine needs), `MND-02` (part: choices use only what they know, audited), `MND-04` (part: kinds known, by sight and by eating, look-alikes), `MND-28` (part: facts from arrivals and activity ends, corrected when wrong), `MND-14` (part: capped choosing, the hourly settle), `PRN-01` (part), `PRN-13` (part: reasons kept with each activity and logged), `BIO-18` (part: sight, hearing and smell ranges), `BIO-21` (part: play), `MND-05` (part: starting links weigh in choosing).

**Architecture:** `A4.7` (the hourly settle in the window phase), `A8.9`, `A8.10`, `A8.13`, `A8.14` (starting links in choosing), `A8.15`, `A8.21` (choosing's cost), `A12.6` (card lines).

**Needs:** α04b.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-core` (`mind`), `kd-people` (`mind/needs.rs`, `mind/kinds.rs`, `mind/map.rs`, `mind/habits.rs`, `sense.rs`, `choose/`), `kd-sim` (`PeopleWorld`, the window phase's settle, the history list's reasons), `kd-text` (`cards.rs`), `kd-ui` (selection panel), `data/tuning/minds.md`, `data/text/cards.md`, `data/minds/options.md`.

**Tasks:**

   `mind/needs.rs` adds safety, belonging, status, curiosity and love with A8.10's rates and weights for what `MIL-01` holds: safety toward 70 at 50 an hour (+15 sheltered in the cave, +5 a companion within 20 m up to +15; fire, fear and believed danger join later); belonging −10 a game day while unmet (alone: no band member within 200 m), +10 for a shared task or a day's talk together (talk in α06b); status toward 50 at 1 an hour; curiosity −10 a game day with nothing new, +10 for something new (a place or a thing here; stories and experiments join in Stage 2); love −10 a game day apart from partner, children and close friends, +10 a game day with them, at most 70 unpartnered, −20 for a baby away from its mother; the daily amounts are settled hourly as a 24th each, these being A8.10's numbers; `k` 1.5; weights hunger 1.2, thirst 1.4, warmth 1.2, rest 1.0, safety 1.3, belonging 0.7, status 0.6, curiosity 0.5, love 0.8; trait factors stay 1 until traits act (Stage 2, A8.23); babies feel only the body's needs, safety and love, and the others weigh `(age − 1) ÷ 13` of an adult's (A8.7).

   `crates/kd-people/src/choose/worth.rs`: the worth table (64 kinds), direct relief from believed values (eaten, slept on) × `1 ÷ (1 + have ÷ enough)` (A8.15's direct worth, `MIL-01`), rebuilt when a kind's believed values change.
   `crates/kd-people/src/choose/score.rs`: `score = p × (Σ_needs w·τ·[D(L) − D(min(100, L + Δ))] + K + F) + B − C` (A8.15) with `p` a fact's sureness for a place; `K` and `F` 0 until α06b and α26a; `B` = habit up to 3 and links (a held harm link costs `strength ÷ 5 × (1 + 0.25 × cautious)`, so strong hunger still eats a forbidden food, A8.14 rule 8); `C` = 4 a game hour, effort 2 an hour light and 6 heavy × (1 + tiredness), travel from the map's rough times.
   `crates/kd-people/src/mind/habits.rs`: up to 32 habits (place, hour band, season, activity kind) counted as they happen; what they usually do there and then scores up to 3 higher, so days have a rhythm (`MND-09`).
   Commit `T04c.4: worth, the score and habits (MND-09, MND-05, A8.15)`.

5. `T04c.5` **Picking and reasons (`MND-09`, `PRN-13`, A8.15).**
   `crates/kd-people/src/choose/pick.rs`: `choose(v: &MindView, rules: &MindRules, w: &impl PeopleWorld, why: Trigger) -> Choice` (A8.15): options at 0.9 × the best or more are weighted by `score − 0.8 × best` and one drawn by `minds.choice_pick` (system 10, fortune `None`, `GOD-04`), ties by option key; nothing above 0 means rest.
   Reasons (24 bytes, `PRN-13`): the three score parts that most put the winner ahead of the best option it beat, each a kind (need, trait, belief, plan, memory, dream, custom, kin) with a 32-bit lasting id, and the kinds of the two best options beaten; a close second drawn by chance has "chance among close options" first; a forced activity (asleep where they stand) keeps its cause as its one reason.
   They sit in the activity's columns (A4.4) and go with each event the choice caused into the history list (A14.8 from α07b).
   The stand-in chooser is deleted.
   Commit `T04c.5: picking with kept reasons (MND-09, PRN-13, A8.15)`.

6. `T04c.6` **Facts from arrivals and activity ends (`MND-28`, A8.13).**
   On arrival at a place and at each activity's end there, a person records what they came for and what is in reach (small things within 30 m while searching or gathering, A8.9): a fact's amount, seasons, sureness 100 and day seen; a fact found wrong is corrected at once (no ripe food where they expected it sets the amount to 0 until its season comes round, `MND-28`'s "berries eaten out are not sought until next season"); a new place joins the map (a spot one per area, a stretch per world cell), and when the map is full the least used places fade (A8.13).
   Commit `T04c.6: places and facts learned on the spot (MND-28, A8.13)`.

   The selection panel (α03c) shows `Doing: <activity> · because <three reasons> · beat <two options>`.
   Commit `T04c.7: the audit and the reason lines (MND-02, PRN-01, PRE-37)`.

8. `T04c.8` **Deliver (`PRC-11`).**
   `versionCode=1043`, `versionName=a04c`; `bench/cloud/a04c.json` adds choices a person a game day and µs a choice (A8.21: about 15 a day at most 19 µs each on a held middle core); then P0's steps 5 to 8.

**Data:** `data/tuning/minds.md` (the nine needs' rates, weights and `k`; option caps; pick margins); `data/minds/options.md` (`play`, `explore`, `rest`, `sleep` with their reliefs and costs, `checks = ["MND-09", "BIO-21"]`); `data/text/cards.md` (activity and reason lines).

**Tests:**
- `kd-people` (`MND-09`, `MND-04`): `choose::pick::tests::best_wins_about_two_in_three` (against one option at 0.9 of it, A8.22); `choose::options::tests::at_most_30`; `choose::score::tests::thirsty_goes_to_water` (with water 20 m away and food 200 m away, a thirsty person drinks first, its first reason `thirsty`); `mind::kinds::tests::look_alike_takes_nearest` (an untried berry takes the hidden values of the known berry nearest in looks); `mind::habits::tests::rhythm_scores_higher`.
- `kd-people` (`MND-28`): `mind::map::tests::eaten_out_not_sought_until_next_season`.
- Rust scenario tests in `crates/kd-sim/tests/choosing.rs`, 20 runs each (seeds 4301–4320), every choice audited (`MND-02`, `PRN-01`), each over 10 game days unless it says otherwise, with a budget of 0.05 session-hours (`RES-09`): `everyone_has_three_reasons` (every activity under way over 5 game days holds three reasons and two options beaten, `MND-09`'s Done when, in 20 of 20); `lonely_seeks_company` (one adult set 2 km from camp for 3 days returns to the band within a day in at least 16 of 20, `MND-07`'s Done when); `no_idle_while_starving` (nobody idle 6 hours while hunger is urgent and known food lies within 1 km, A8.22's oddity, in 20 of 20); `no_flicker` (nobody changes activity over 6 times an hour for an hour, in 20 of 20).
- `kd det first-camp --days 3` passes with choosing (the choice draw is keyed; `MND-14`).

**On the phone:**
1. Tap a person: the panel says what they are doing and why, for example `Doing: drinking at the spring · because thirsty; knows the spring; usually drinks here at this hour · beat gathering hazelnuts, resting`.
2. Follow someone for a day at the close-camp stop: they drink, gather, eat, play with others or explore, rest in the heat and sleep at night, each time with new reasons.
3. Watch the children: between meals and sleep they play near the cave and near their carers.

**Not in this alpha:** warmth from weather, shelter and huddling (α05); the person card and the details of a mind (α04d); talk, sharing and kin in the score (α06b); traits acting (Stage 2, A8.23); plans and the year remembered (α26a); blueprints as options (α09).

**Risks:**
- Choosing too costly: A8.21 counts 285 µs a person a day for choosing; the cloud benchmark records it, and A8.21's cuts (`InReach` from bucket summaries, `find_inputs` capped) are built in from the start.
- People stuck in loops between two options: the hourly settle and habits damp it; `no_flicker` guards it.
- A choice reading the world by accident: `MindView`'s types and the audit (A8.15).

### α05 Seasons and plants (about 5.5 hours)

**Goal:** the 60-day year turns in the land: each plant buds, leafs, flowers, fruits and goes bare at its own time, earlier in the warm valley than on the uplands; grass and herbs grow and die back within a season; the cover of each cell drifts toward its biome; winters bite, and people keep warm in the cave on grass beds, huddled together, while a band forages its home range through the whole year.

**Serves:** `TIM-18` (part: the 60-day year's seasons in the plants), `WLD-31` (part: life through the year, cover per cell growing toward its biome), `WLD-30` (part: the land's numbers checked in a year's foraging), `WLD-12` (part: plant cover every 5 game days), `BIO-11` (part: felt temperature, the comfort limit, shelter, bedding, huddling, shivering and freezing), `BIO-02` (part: caves with beds of grass), `BIO-09` (part: a band keeps its condition through a mild year), `BIO-14` (part: death by cold), `MND-07` (part: the warmth need moving), `PRE-30` (part: palettes for every season), `WLD-08` (part: settling now grows the cover).

**Architecture:** `A4.9` (the daily and 5-day rows), `A5.2` (`warmth`, `taken`), `A5.8` (the day's sums), `A7.3`, `A7.4`, `A8.5`, `A8.6` (freezing), `A11.3` (versions for each season), `A11.4` (seasons blending), `A11.7` (plants by season state).

**Needs:** α04d.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-world` (`weather/preset.rs` day's sums), `kd-life` (`plants/ripe.rs`, `plants/cover.rs`, `plants/ground.rs`), `kd-sim` (`batch.rs` rows), `kd-people` (`body/warmth.rs`, `body/limits.rs`, `setup.rs`), `kd-render` (`plants/`, `palette.rs`, `light.rs`), `data/plants/`, `data/palette/light.md`, `data/items/plant.md`, `data/tuning/`, `scenes/lands/cold-test.toml`.

**Tasks:**

1. `T05.1` **The land's warmth through the year (`TIM-18`, A4.9, A5.2, A5.8).**
   The hourly weather step adds the hour's degree-hours above 5 °C to the day's sums (A5.8 step 4); A4.9's daily-cells row (region `r` at quarter hour `(37 r) mod 96`) now adds each land cell's day to `warmth` (degree-days this year, reset on spring day 1) and resets each group's `taken` share on the day that group first ripens again (A7.4).
   Commit `T05.1: degree-days through the year (TIM-18, A5.2, A5.8)`.

2. `T05.2` **Seasons in each plant (`WLD-31`, `TIM-18`, A7.2, A7.3).**
   `season_state` and `ripe` (α04a) take the warmth shift: a species' days move earlier by one day for each 10% the cell's `warmth` to date runs above its normal for the date, later when below, at most 3 days either way (A7.2, `data/tuning/world.md` `ripen_shift_days = 3`), so the warm valley flowers before the uplands.
   Ground-cover patches follow the season (`crates/kd-life/src/plants/ground.rs`, read by area contents through α02d's `PlantRules`): a herb or grass patch's density rises from a tenth at its bud day to full by its leaf day plus 10, holds, and dies back to a tenth after its bare day; evergreens and roots hold all year.
   Single plants' growth stage comes from their age (the spot's keyed age at Year 1 plus the years since), through each species' `growth` (seedling, young, grown, old, dead), and a dead tree stands until its stage passes, then is gone, its spot following the cell's cover again (A7.3).
   Commit `T05.2: season states, ripening shifts and growth stages (WLD-31, A7.3)`.

3. `T05.3` **Plant cover every five game days (`WLD-12`, `WLD-31`, A4.9, A7.4).**
   `crates/kd-life/src/plants/cover.rs`: A4.9's 5-day row (region `r` at quarter hour `(37 r) mod 480`): each land cell's cover grows toward its biome's shares (`data/world/biomes.md`) at each group's pace (grass and herbs within a season, bushes over a few game years, trees over decades: rates in `data/tuning/world.md`), leaving the share people changed (`people_cover`, empty until people clear ground) alone; `tree_age` gains 5 days; fire, flood and lava reset it from α14b, α20c and α20b (A7.4).
   Settling (`WLD-08`) now runs it for its 10 years, so Year 1's cover is the settled land's.
   Commit `T05.3: plant cover on cells every five days (WLD-12, WLD-31, A7.4)`.

4. `T05.4` **The look of each season (`PRE-30`, A11.3, A11.4, A11.7).**
   `data/palette/light.md` gains `season_spring`, `season_summer` and `season_winter`, OKLab transforms applied to the four time-of-day versions as the mockup's autumn is (spring: greener and lighter; summer: fuller greens, warmer; winter: greyer and cooler), giving A11.3's versions for each season; the row in use is interpolated in time of day and in season, seasons blending over a season's first two game days and holding a steady mix of all four when one passes in under 10 real seconds (A11.4).
   Plants are drawn by their season state and stage (A11.7): budding pale, leaves in `leaf_spring`, `leaf_summer` and `oak_autumn`, blossom in its ladder, ripe fruit as α04a draws it, bare deciduous trees as trunk and branches (`Trees`' `tube` for each branch, no crown clumps), dead trees grey and bare; ground cover's stamps thin and fade with the season.
   Commit `T05.4: the look of every season (PRE-30, A11.3, A11.7)`.

5. `T05.5` **Keeping warm (`BIO-11`, `BIO-02`, `MND-07`, A8.5).**
   `crates/kd-people/src/body/warmth.rs` (A8.5): felt = the cell's air (A5.8's local weather) − wind (1.5 °C per m/s, at most 10, none inside a cave) − 5 if wet (rain comes in α13) + sun (5 × the sine of its height × (1 − cloud), in the open) + shelter (a cave 4 °C) (+ fire in α14a); comfort limit = 24 °C − 6 × clothing points (none yet) − 10 working − 6 × bedding points asleep − 6 huddled (a sleeper within 1 m of another); gap = limit − felt; `chill` moves toward 4 × gap at 40 an hour (60 for children and the over-60s), `heat` toward 5 × (felt − 32 °C), doubled in heavy work, at 40 an hour; thresholds: above 0 shivering (tries −0.1), 40 clumsy (work × 0.7), 80 freezing, death after 3 hours (2 at a gap of 30); heat 80 faints, 100 heatstroke (A8.3); recomputed at the hourly weather barrier, at activity starts and ends, and when shelter changes (A8.5); frostbite waits for wounds (α09b) and cold spells (α13).
   The body's uses follow (A8.3, `BIO-09`): food use gains + 0.25 while chilled (chill above 0); water use `use_w` = 1 + 0.5 in heavy work + heat ÷ 100, at most 2 (an adult's 3 litres a day, up to twice that in heat or hard work), both in `data/tuning/body.md`.
   `data/items/plant.md` gains `grass_bedding` (plant, strand, a heap; warmth 2, burn 5, fibre 1); the first camp's set-up places a 2 kg heap at each sleeping spot, owned by its sleeper (`BIO-02`: caves with beds of grass or leaves); sleeping on it counts its warmth as bedding.
   Death by cold is a limit (`BIO-14`: `Death { cause: Cold, ... }`); the warmth need now moves, and α04c's options for warmth at hand (go to the cave, lie down by others, sleep on bedding) come alive.
   Commit `T05.5: keeping warm in the cave (BIO-11, BIO-02, MND-07, A8.5)`.

6. `T05.6` **A year's foraging (`WLD-30`, `BIO-09`, `RES-16`).**
   Rust scenario tests in `crates/kd-sim/tests/seasons.rs` (α07c moves them into scene files): the first camp v0 grown to 25 people on the first region, runs from seeds 5101–5120, one game year each; if the forage area misses its range, tune `land_yield_scale` and the yields only (`RES-16`), logging each change in `data/TUNING-LOG.md` with the seeds it was tuned on.
   Commit `T05.6: a year of foraging, tuned (WLD-30, BIO-09, RES-16)`.

7. `T05.7` **Deliver (`PRC-11`).**
   Golden scenes `valley-spring`, `valley-summer`, `valley-winter` (the valley stop at noon on day 8 of each season) and `cave-winter-night` (close camp at the cave at 02:00 in winter: sleepers huddled on bedding); `versionCode=1050`, `versionName=a05`; `bench/cloud/a05.json` adds the daily cells' and 5-day cover's time for the island (A4.9: at most 30 and 15 ms a game day for the whole world); then P0's steps 5 to 8.
