- `kd-life` (`WLD-31`): `plants::ripe::tests::valley_before_uplands` (hazel at 100 m ripens up to 3 days before hazel at 340 m); `plants::ground::tests::herbs_grow_within_a_season`; `plants::cover::tests::returns_to_biome` (cells set bare return to their biome's shares at each group's pace: grass within a season, trees within decades).
- `kd-people` (`BIO-11`): `body::warmth::tests::limits_and_gap` (A8.5's formula on fixed cases: naked at rest 24 °C, working 14 °C, asleep on bedding 12 °C, huddled on bedding 6 °C); `body::warmth::tests::freezes_after_three_hours`.
- Scenario tests, 20 runs each from seeds 5101–5120, game-time limits as stated, budgets 0.05 session-hours and 0.1 for the two year-long ones (`RES-09`; `BIO-11`, `BIO-09`, `WLD-30`): `huddled_in_cave_survive_two_degrees` (the first camp through a night of 2 °C air in the cave on bedding: nobody dies, nobody's chill passes 60, in 20 of 20, `BIO-11`'s Done when); `alone_at_minus_five_dies` (one adult on `cold-test` land at −5 °C felt with no shelter known dies of cold that night in at least 18 of 20; frostbite joins in α13); `band_keeps_condition_in_a_mild_year` (25 people, one game year: nobody dies of hunger, thirst or cold, and the median condition at year's end is within 10 of its start, in at least 16 of 20, `BIO-09`'s Done when); `forage_area_one_to_three_hundred_km2` (the cells where the band gathered over the year cover 100–300 km² in at least 16 of 20, `WLD-30`'s Check).
- `kd det first-camp --days 3` passes; the golden areas are unchanged (contents follow the date, not a new generator).
- Screens: golden `valley-spring`, `valley-summer`, `valley-winter`, `cave-winter-night`.

**On the phone:**
1. At the valley stop, let a year pass (about four minutes): the woods go from pale buds to deep green, flowers, gold and brown, then bare grey branches in winter, while the pines stay dark; the light itself changes with each season.
2. Pinch in on the floodplain in spring and again in late summer: the grass and herbs grow, then thin out.
3. On a winter night, pinch in on the cave: everyone lies close together on heaps of grass; tap one: their warmth bar is lower but holding.
4. Tap someone walking in winter: their reasons mention the cold more often.

**Not in this alpha:** rain, snow and cold spells (α13); fire's warmth (α14a); clothing (α25a); wounds (α09b) and frostbite (α13); planting and seeds (α45); the year remembered for plans (α26a).

**Risks:**
- The forage area out of range: tuning `land_yield_scale` (A5.13) and the yields, logged (`RES-16`); if tuning cannot reach it, the alpha's note gives the owner the options (`RES-16`).
- Winter too harsh without fire or clothing (people freezing every winter): the island's winter mean of 3 °C with the cave, bedding and huddling meets `BIO-11`'s 2 °C night; if the scene fails, the preset's climate is the one to retune, logged, since `BIO-02` gives no fire before `MIL-03`.
- Season blending making the picture shimmer at speed: A11.4's steady mix when a season passes in under 10 real seconds.

### α06a Names and families (about 5 hours)

**Goal:** the world has its own language, and the band is made as real families: couples with children born about four years apart, grandparents, an orphan or a widow, each person inheriting their build, nature and looks from their parents, and everyone and every known place named in the language, shown with its meaning.

**Serves:** `CUL-17` (part: one language made with the world), `CUL-18` (part: names of people and places, with their meaning), `BIO-03` (part: one band made directly, as families; the other bands come with α12), `BIO-06` (part: inherited body numbers and traits), `BIO-22` (part: looks from two copies, passed one each), `BIO-17` (part: the inborn leaning of attraction), `PRE-35` (part: names and kin on cards), `MND-20` (part: twelve traits stored, acting from Stage 2), `SCP-20` (part: no real language copied).

**Architecture:** `A8.7` (the leaning), `A8.8`, `A9.1`, `A9.2`, `A9.3`, `A9.4`, `A12.1` (words in ochre).

**Needs:** α05.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-culture` (`lang.rs`, `names.rs`, `groups.rs`, `purposes.rs`), `kd-people` (`setup.rs`, `body/inherit.rs`, `looks.rs`, the trait columns), `kd-sim` (`GroupView`, set-up, `World::record_kinds()`), `kd-ui` (`views/person.rs`, `views/place.rs`, `findable.rs`), `kd-text` (`cards.rs`), `data/culture/`, `data/tuning/culture.md`, `data/tuning/people.md`.

**Tasks:**

1. `T06a.1` **The language's data (`CUL-17`, `SCP-20`, A9.2).**
   `kd-data` kinds `Sound`, `ConceptGroup` and `BannedWords`.
   `data/culture/sounds.md`: about 40 sounds, each with its IPA, a 1–2 letter Latin spelling that reads back unambiguously (`ng`, `lh`, `'`), its class (stop, nasal, fricative, affricate, liquid, glide, vowel), commonness 1–5 and `voice_kept = true` (A13 sets which the murmur's voice keeps at α17).
   `data/culture/words.md`: concepts grouped one entry per topic (landforms, waters, plants, animals, materials, colours, weather and seasons, body and traits, kin, actions, feelings, name parts), each `concepts = [["cliff", "A"], ...]` with A9.2's classes (A: 1–2 syllables, B: 2, C: 2–3); about 160 concepts now, every plant, animal, rock and landform of the first region, the kin words, the colours and enough traits and weather for names; the rest of A9.2's 340 join as their things arrive.
   `data/culture/banned.md`: about 1,000 common English words of 2–6 letters, one entry per first letter, that no word may spell (A9.2's list grows to about 3,000 with the murmur's phrases at α17).
   Commit `T06a.1: the language's sounds, concepts and banned words (CUL-17, A9.2)`.

2. `T06a.2` **Making the language (`CUL-17`, A9.2).**
   `crates/kd-culture/src/lang.rs`: `make_language(seed, cat) -> Language` by A9.2's four steps, every draw from system 11 on the world's place uid at moment 0: pick 12–20 consonants and 4–7 vowels from the kept sounds by commonness, with at least 2 stops, 2 nasals, a fricative, a liquid or glide and 3 spread vowels; syllable shapes CV, plus V (0.5), CVC (0.7), CCV ending in a liquid or glide (0.3) and VC (0.2), with 2–6 consonants allowed to end a syllable; stress first (40%), last (25%) or second-last (35%), compounds modifier-first (60%) or head-first; each concept a word, redrawn up to 20 times when it repeats a word or a syllable three times or spells a banned word; `spell(l, w) -> SmallString<24>` in Latin letters; about 18 KB, under 5 ms, made at world creation and kept in the world (chunk `cul.lang` from α07a).
   Commit `T06a.2: a language from the world's seed (CUL-17, A9.2)`.

3. `T06a.3` **Names (`CUL-18`, A9.3).**
   `crates/kd-culture/src/names.rs`: `Name` (1–4 word parts and a pattern, 20 bytes) with its English meaning built from the parts' glosses (A9.3); a store `Names` (chunk `cul.names` from α07a).
   A person is named at birth by the mother (A9.3): after a visible trait (50%) or the season's sign or weather (30%), and the remaining 20%, a dead ancestor's name where the dead are held to live on (`CUL-19`), goes to a trait until such a belief exists (α32b); founders are named the same way at set-up.
   Every place the band knows at the start gets a name (`CUL-18`: at the start every known place has a name): colour, plant or animal with its landform ("Red Cliff", "Hazel Ford").
   Commit `T06a.3: names for people and places (CUL-18, A9.3)`.

4. `T06a.4` **Inheritance and the twelve traits (`BIO-06`, `BIO-22`, `MND-20`, A8.8).**
   `crates/kd-people/src/body/inherit.rs`: a child's body number = μ + ½ × (parents' mean − μ) + σ × √(7/8) × `normal()`, from the parents' inborn values, never their current ones, so the spread stays σ (A8.8, `BIO-06`); the sex factors applied after (`BIO-17`).
   The person store gains `traits_inborn` and `traits: [i8; 12]` (in tenths, −30 to +30) in `MND-20`'s order (curious, brave, cautious, patient, hard-working, playful, sociable, kind, greedy, hot-tempered, proud, spiritual), inherited by the same rule with σ one level and clamped to ±3; they act on choosing from Stage 2 (A8.23), so α04c's trait factors stay 1.
   Looks (`BIO-22`): a child takes one copy of each feature from each parent by a keyed draw, with no mutation.
   The leaning (`BIO-17`, A8.7): `drawn`, a keyed draw at birth or set-up, not inherited: drawn to the other sex for 19 in 20, and the 1 in 20 split evenly between their own sex and either (`data/tuning/people.md` `drawn_other = 0.95`).
   Commit `T06a.4: inheritance, traits and the leaning (BIO-06, BIO-22, MND-20, BIO-17)`.

5. `T06a.5` **The band made directly (`BIO-03`, A8.8).**
   `crates/kd-people/src/setup.rs`: `first_band(world_seed, cave, cat, lang) -> BandSetup` replaces `first_camp_v0` (in the set-up uid space): a band of 15–30 people (keyed) made of 3–6 couples aged about 18–45 with their children, born about 4 years apart, each mother 18–38 at each birth (`BIO-03`); 1–3 grandparents over 45; 0–2 orphans living with an aunt, uncle or grandparent; 0–2 widowed people; about two in five under 14; men and women about equal; about 1 adult in 10 with an old scar, a limp or a crooked arm (a `lasting` value on one part).
   Each founder couple's members are made as the children of made-up parents (two per founder, not in the world), drawn as founders are (wide looks, numbers round the average, traits round 0), so siblings in the band resemble each other and children inherit from real parents (A8.8); couples are partnered; `mother` and `father` are set for everyone born in the band; a brother or sister in another band, for about one adult in three, comes with the other bands (α12).
   Commit `T06a.5: the first band made as families (BIO-03, A8.8)`.

6. `T06a.6` **Families and the band as facts (`BIO-03`, A9.1, A9.4).**
   `crates/kd-culture/src/groups.rs`: `Culture` (in the world state) with A9.4's family records (a couple or lone parent with children under 14, plus a partnerless parent over 45 joining their eldest child's family; its head the adult the band respects most, which at `MIL-01` is the elder of the couple until respect comes in α26b) and one band record (members, camp, home range cells within 10 km of the cave, fires held 0), and the per-person columns `band` and `family`; group records change only at barriers (A9.1's cluster rule).
   `GroupView` (A9.4), implemented by `kd-sim` over `Culture`: `band_of`, `family_of`, `people_of` (the first people, unnamed until peoples form at α36b).
   Commit `T06a.6: families and the band as facts (A9.4)`.

7. `T06a.7` **Names and kin on cards (`PRE-35`, `CUL-18`, A12.1).**
   The person card shows the name in the people's word in ochre (`o3`) with its meaning in quotes (A12.1), then the band (`the band at <cave's name>`) and kin lines (mother, father, partner, children, brothers and sisters, by name, each a link to that person's card); place cards and the details of a mind show places by name and meaning; the map's place names appear on place cards only (no labels on the world, `PRE-32`).
   `World::record_kinds()` gains `cul.lang`, `cul.names` and `cul.groups` (the band and its families), with their `FINDABLE` lines (the person card's name, band and kin lines; the place card's name), so α07e's report lists them (`PRE-13`).
   Commit `T06a.7: names and kin on cards (PRE-35, CUL-18, PRE-13)`.

8. `T06a.8` **Deliver (`PRC-11`).**
   Golden `card-family` (a parent's card with kin); `versionCode=1061`, `versionName=a06a`; `bench/cloud/a06a.json` adds the language's making time; the note gives the world's name for "river" and "cliff" as a taste of its language; then P0's steps 5 to 8.

**Data:** `data/culture/sounds.md` (about 40 sounds); `data/culture/words.md` (12 concept groups, about 160 concepts); `data/culture/banned.md` (26 entries, about 1,000 words); `data/tuning/culture.md` (`name_mix = { trait = 0.5, season = 0.3, ancestor = 0.2 }`, the language's shape numbers of A9.2); `data/tuning/people.md` (`band_size = [15, 30]`, `couples = [3, 6]`, `birth_spacing_years = 4`, `drawn_other = 0.95`, `old_harm_share = 0.1`).

**Tests:**
- `kd-culture` (`CUL-17`, `CUL-18`): `lang::tests::same_on_every_target` (one seed gives one language hash on x86, arm64 and wasm, the last through the web smoke's `kd.langHash()`); `lang::tests::thousand_seeds` (over 1,000 seeds: no repeated or banned word, no unkept sound, at least 990 distinct inventories, A9.2); `names::tests::every_name_parses` (every person and place name parses into its world's words, `CUL-18`).
- `kd-people` (`BIO-06`, `BIO-22`, `BIO-03`, `BIO-17`): `body::inherit::tests::spread_stays_sigma` (100,000 children of random parents: each number's spread within 5% of σ, and children's values correlate with their parents' mean); `looks::tests::children_mix_parents` (each shown feature lies between or at the parents' copies); `inherit::tests::leaning_one_in_twenty` (100,000 draws within `RES-13`'s range of 1 in 20, A8.22); `setup::tests::band_shape` (over 200 seeds: 15–30 people, every child with a living parent or kin caring, every mother 18–38 at each birth, two in five under 14 within 10%, men and women within 3 of each other, `BIO-03`'s Done when for one band).
- `kd-culture`: `groups::tests::families_cover_the_band` (everyone in exactly one family).
- `kd det first-camp --days 3` passes with the new band.
- Screens: golden `card-family`.

**On the phone:**
1. Tap a person: their name is now a word of this world's language in ochre, with its meaning in quotes, for example `Tesha "Quick Water"`, and their band at the named cave.
2. Their kin are listed: tap a child's name to open the child's card, then the mother's; parents and children look alike in skin, hair and build.
3. Tap a known place on the map's ground: its name and meaning ("Hazel Ford").
4. Count the people at the cave: between 15 and 30, about two in five children.

**Not in this alpha:** relations, opinions and trust (α06b); births, growing up and deaths (α06c); the other 2–3 bands and siblings in them (α12); second names and coined words (α11a, α12); the murmur (α17); traits acting on choices (Stage 2).

**Risks:**
- The language spelling English words: the banned list catches common ones; the owner reports any that slip through, and the list grows (A9.2).
- Names reading oddly in English ("Red Red Cliff"): A9.3's patterns never repeat a part; the test checks every name's meaning for a repeated word.
- Founder numbers drifting from the population's spread through made-up parents: the inheritance rule keeps σ (A8.8), checked by `spread_stays_sigma`.

### α06b Talk, sharing and courtship (about 5 hours)

**Goal:** people talk while they work, passing news of food, water and places, so a spring one of them found is soon known to all; they share food with the hungry and help each other gather; opinions and trust move with all this; and unpaired adults court the one they like and are drawn to, and pair.

**Serves:** `CUL-24` (part: talk kept as topics, at its pace; plain talk of food, water, danger, a death, places and questions), `MND-33` (part: chat, share, help and court; talk alongside work ending no activity; the last ten topics kept; courtship and pairing), `MND-24` (part: relations in full: kinship, opinion, trust, respect, love, favours, bonds, drift), `MND-26` (part: kin, caring for the hungry, favours, own group, raised together), `MND-27` (part: a told fact believed at the teller's sureness times trust), `MND-28` (part: places from talk), `BIO-17` (part: whom one courts, by the inborn leaning), `BIO-15` (part: couples pair, logged), `PRE-35` (part: recent talk and relations on cards), `PRE-44` (part: talking).

**Architecture:** `A4.7` (talk at quarter hours in the window work), `A8.7` (courting, pairing, raised together), `A8.10` (belonging, love), `A8.15` (`K` and social options), `A8.18`, `A9.3` (place names passed in talk), `A14.8` (pairings logged).

**Needs:** α06a.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-people` (`social/relations.rs`, `social/talk.rs`, `social/acts.rs`, `life/pairing.rs`, `choose/`), `kd-sim` (the window work's talk, `PeopleWorld`), `kd-culture` (families on pairing), `kd-render` (talking over a posture), `kd-ui` (`views/person.rs`, `views/mind.rs`, `findable.rs`), `kd-text`, `data/minds/topics.md`, `data/minds/acts.md`, `data/tuning/minds.md`.

**Tasks:**

1. `T06b.1` **Relations (`MND-24`, `MND-26`, A8.18).**
   `crates/kd-people/src/social/relations.rs`: A8.18's records (48 bytes, at most 150; kin stay while alive, otherwise the weakest by opinion and recency goes): who, kinship as believed, opinion −100 to +100, trust, respect and love 0–100, the day opinion last rose past +60, favours, grief (0 until α28), last met, flags (partner, friend, rival, enemy, raised together) and who-knows-what bits (0 until α10b); whom one is drawn to is no relation value but the inborn leaning `drawn` (A8.7, `BIO-17`).
   Starting relations (`BIO-20`): everyone in the band and their kin, kinship true, trust 70 for kin and 50 for the band (A8.18), opinions +20 to +40 for kin and 0 to +20 for the rest, plus for each adult 1–2 friendships (+60) and 0–1 grudge (−30), keyed (starting values in `data/tuning/minds.md`).
   The hourly settle drifts them (A8.18, `MND-24`): apart, opinion a point a week back toward 0; together, a point a week up between like personalities (likeness above 0.5) and down toward a hot-tempered one, with likeness = 1 − mean |trait difference| ÷ 6 (traits stored since α06a); love grows while opinion stays above +60 and fades 0.5% a day apart; a friend after 10 days at 60 or more; respect at 50 until α26b builds it.
   Commit `T06b.1: relations in full (MND-24, MND-26, A8.18)`.

2. `T06b.2` **Talk alongside work (`CUL-24`, `MND-33`, `MND-27`, `MND-28`, A4.7, A8.18).**
   `crates/kd-people/src/social/talk.rs`, run at each quarter-hour barrier after the window phase, first inside each cluster (A4.7, A8.18): people within 4 m who are walking, gathering, at seated work, eating or resting and not in danger form talk groups of up to 8, joined in uid order.
   A group passes one topic a quarter hour, so a chat moves at `CUL-24`'s pace of about one topic every 10–15 minutes: each member's best candidate scores its weight in `data/minds/topics.md` × (1 + 0.15 × sociable), skipping the teller's last 10 told, and the highest is told, ties by uid; the factor for listeners who lack it waits for who knows what (α10b), and sociable for traits acting (Stage 2).
   Plain talk (A8.18's `MIL-01` topics) carries news of food, water, danger or a death, places, and questions: a fact the teller first learned within the last 2 game days (`news_days`) is news, an older one a `place`; a `question` asks for a place of a kind the teller knows none of for an urgent need (water, a ripe food, shelter), and each listener holding one has that place as their best candidate at the next quarter hour, so the answer is told then.
   Its content is read once for the group, and `hear(p, topic, teller, now)` gives each listener the news or place fact at the teller's sureness × trust ÷ 100 (`MND-27`), with the place's name (A9.3); nobody takes part in more than 60 topics a game day, past that neither telling nor hearing until the next (`CUL-24`); talk ends no activity (`MND-33`).
   Each person keeps their last 10 topics told and heard (`MND-33`); a day's talk together gives belonging +10 (A8.10) and each talker's opinion of the other +1, once a pair and a day (`MND-24`, A8.18).
   The snapshot marks talkers (A4.4's overlay), and figures talk with their upper body over their posture (A11.8: head and hands, a loop of 4 key poses).
   Commit `T06b.2: talk alongside work (CUL-24, MND-33, MND-27, A8.18)`.

3. `T06b.3` **Sharing food and helping (`MND-33`, `MND-26`, A8.15, A8.18).**
   `crates/kd-people/src/social/acts.rs` with `data/minds/acts.md` (A8.18's starting values, `checks = ["MND-33", "MND-24"]`): `share`, an activity of 2 minutes giving half of the held food to someone within 20 m who looks hungrier (hunger below 40 shows, as others' needs are read from what is seen, `MND-23`), the receiver's relief counted, their opinion of the giver +3 (`MND-24`'s shared food) and a favour owed (`MND-26`); `help`, joining someone's gathering at the same spot as a shared activity (A4.4's `Shared` record, the fewest 2), each gathering at their own pace, opinion +3 each way and a favour owed (A8.18), belonging +10 for the day's shared task (A8.10).
   The score's `K` (A8.15): each affected person's relief × kin weight (parent, child or partner 0.5, sibling 0.35, grandparent or grandchild 0.25, other kin 0.12) + 0.1 × kind for anyone; favours owed pull toward repaying (+3 in `B` a favour owed to that person).
   Options (A8.15): social acts toward the 6 nearest within about 20 m, or one person sought (6).
   **Decision:** A8.23 lists kin weights at `MIL-02`; `SCP-16` puts sharing food and help in `MIL-01`, and sharing runs on them, so they come here.
   Commit `T06b.3: sharing food and helping (MND-33, MND-26, A8.15)`.

4. `T06b.4` **Courting (`MND-33`, `BIO-17`, `MND-26`, A8.7).**
   `court` (A8.7, A8.18): an activity of 15–30 minutes of time together with the courted (walking together, sitting close), chosen by unpartnered adults, whose love need stops at 70 (A8.10), toward the one they are drawn to (`drawn` and the other's sex, read only in `life::pairing`, `BIO-17`) and like most, at an opinion above +40 (`MND-33`), never someone raised with them; it relieves love by A8.10's +10 for a day with them, once a day, and moves opinion only as `MND-24` says: the day's chat (+1), and the courter's `share` and `help` toward the courted (+3 each), which court makes nearby options.
   Raised together (`MND-26`, A8.7): two people who lived in one band for 3 years while both were under 6, or while one was under 6 and the other its parent or main carer (A8.7's **Decision**: carers count); the set-up flags siblings, parents and children, and cousins born within 3 years of each other in the band; such a pair never courts or pairs.
   Commit `T06b.4: courting, never between those raised together (MND-33, BIO-17, MND-26)`.

5. `T06b.5` **Pairing (`MND-33`, `BIO-15`, A8.7, A9.4, A14.8).**
   `crates/kd-people/src/life/pairing.rs` (A8.7): when each one's opinion of the other has stayed above +60 for 10 days (the relation's day it last rose past +60; `data/tuning/minds.md`), both are unpartnered adults drawn to each other's sex, they were not raised together, and no living parent of either holds an opinion of the other below −20, they pair (`MND-33`); `partner` set both ways, the pairing logged forever (A8.6, A14.8), a new family record made at the next barrier (A9.4), and from then love +10 a game day together (A8.10); customs that forbid a pairing come with marriage customs (`CUL-27`, α37).
   Commit `T06b.5: pairing (MND-33, BIO-15, A8.7)`.

6. `T06b.6` **Talk and relations on cards (`PRE-35`, `PRE-14`).**
   The person card lists recent talk by pattern lines (`told Mena of the spring at Hazel Ford`, `heard of ripe hazelnuts at Red Cliff`, `asked where to find water`, from `data/text/cards.md`) and the partner; the details of a mind gain relations (kinship, opinion, trust, respect, love, flags, favours) under the people they know, sorted by opinion; whom one is drawn to is never shown, staying private to its four modules (`BIO-17`).
   `World::record_kinds()` gains `people.relations` and `people.talk` (the last ten topics), with their `FINDABLE` lines (the details of a mind's relations; the card's recent talk and partner) (`PRE-13`).
   Commit `T06b.6: recent talk and relations on cards (PRE-35, PRE-14, PRE-13)`.

7. `T06b.7` **Deliver (`PRC-11`).**
   Golden `camp-talk` (close camp at 11:00 on summer day 4: gatherers talking); `versionCode=1062`, `versionName=a06b`; `bench/cloud/a06b.json` adds topics told and heard a person a day and µs each (A8.21: about 8 and 30, at most 1.5 and 0.4 µs); then P0's steps 5 to 8.

**Data:** `data/minds/topics.md` (`news_food`, `news_water`, `news_danger`, `news_death`, `place`, `question`, each with `weight`, `checks = ["CUL-24"]`); `data/minds/acts.md` (`share`, `help`, `court`, `chat`); `data/tuning/minds.md` (relation starts and drifts, `pair_opinion = 60`, `pair_days = 10`, `court_opinion = 40`, `parent_veto = -20`, `news_days = 2`, talk group radius 4 m and size 8).

**Tests:**
- `kd-people`: `social::relations::tests::drift_apart_and_together` (`MND-24`'s rates over a season: a point a week each way); `social::talk::tests::one_topic_a_group_a_quarter_hour` (`CUL-24`'s pace: a group of 8 talking for a game day passes 96 topics at most, and nobody passes 60); `social::talk::tests::talk_ends_no_activity` (`MND-33`); `social::talk::tests::question_answered` (a thirsty adult who knows no water asks, and a listener who knows a spring tells it at the next quarter hour, `CUL-24`, `MND-28`); `life::pairing::tests::parent_veto` (a parent at −30 toward the suitor stops the pairing, A8.7); `social::talk::tests::belief_at_sureness_times_trust` (`MND-27`); `life::pairing::tests::never_raised_together` (siblings, a parent and the child they raised, and cousins born within 3 years never pair, over 10,000 random bands).
- Rust scenario tests in `crates/kd-sim/tests/social.rs`, 20 runs each from seeds 6201–6220, every choice audited, limits as stated (5 game days where none is), budgets 0.05 session-hours and 0.1 for the year-long ones (`RES-09`): `spring_news_spreads` (one adult is shown a new spring on day 1; within 5 game days most of the band's adults hold its fact, in at least 16 of 20, `CUL-24`'s Done when); `told_spring_used_when_thirsty` (an adult only told of a spring nearer than any they found goes there when thirsty, in at least 16 of 20, `MND-28`'s first half); `sharers_come_to_like` (over a season, pairs who shared food five or more times end with opinions higher than they began, in at least 16 of 20, `MND-24`'s Done when for sharing; insults join at α30b); `a_pair_forms_within_a_year` (a band with 4 unpaired adults not raised together forms a pair within a game year, in at least 16 of 20, `MND-33`'s Done when); `no_raised_together_pairs` (over one game year of the first band, no pair raised together, in 20 of 20, `MND-26`'s Done when, first half); `people_talk_while_they_work` (on every day, at least 8 of 10 gatherers in company hear a topic while gathering, in 20 of 20).
- `kd det first-camp --days 3` passes with talk.
- Screens: golden `camp-talk`.

**On the phone:**
1. Watch gatherers at close camp: people near each other nod and gesture as they talk without stopping their work.
2. Tap someone: their card lists what they told and heard lately ("heard of ripe blackberries at Red Cliff"); go there later: others arrive who heard.
3. Open a person's mind: their relations, with how much they like and trust each person.
4. Over a season, an unpaired young adult keeps company with another, and one day the card shows a partner.
5. When food is short, someone with food in hand gives half to a hungrier child or friend.

**Not in this alpha:** talk bubbles (α30a, with `PRE-45`); how-to talk (α10b); gifts, gossip and comfort (α30a); quarrels and insults (α30b); who knows what (α10b); births from new pairs (α06c); marriage customs and moving between bands (α37); grief (α28).

**Risks:**
- Talk too costly at quarter hours: groups are capped at 8, topics at 60 a person a day, content read once a group (A8.18), measured in the benchmark.
- News spreading too slowly or too fast for `CUL-24`'s window: topic weights and `news_days` are tuned (`RES-16`) against the spring scene, logged.
- No pair forming in a small band where most young people were raised together: that is the rule (`MND-26`); the pair scene uses adults not raised together, and pairs across bands come with α12.

### α06c Births, ageing and deaths (about 5.5 hours)

**Goal:** the band lives whole lives: couples conceive unseen, mothers carry for 45 days and give birth at the cave with their kin beside them, sometimes hard, now and then twins; babies are carried and nursed, toddlers follow their mothers, children grow into helpers and adults; the old stoop, grey and weaken until the body gives out; and every death leaves a body where it fell and a cause in the record.

**Serves:** `BIO-04` (part: the stages, growth to the inherited size, and the rules behind the target ranges; the ranges themselves are checked on whole worlds from α27b), `BIO-15` (part: conception never shown, 45-day pregnancy, birth risks with and without a helper, twins, nursing, the motherless baby, the birth record; wound fever after births comes with illness, α17b), `BIO-16` (decline from 45, fertility ending about 38, the body giving out from 55), `BIO-14` (part: deaths from birth bleeding, birth and old age; every death's cause and how; the body where it fell), `BIO-06` (part: children grow into their inherited numbers; the setback of a hungry childhood), `BIO-17` (part: sex at birth; `sex` and `drawn` read by their four modules only), `BIO-21` (part: carrying a baby; the young and the old slower), `MND-07` (part: a baby's needs; children's other needs growing with age), `MND-26` (part: raised together counted from birth; kin attending births and taking in orphans), `MND-15` (part: nothing caps births), `TIM-09` (part: the world runs on after a band's last death), `PRE-10` (part: births logged with mother, father, date and place), `PRE-27` (part: children and elders drawn by age, grey hair), `PRE-44` (part: carrying and nursing a baby, lying dead, the child and elder variants), `PRE-35` (part: age, stage, expecting, nursing and dead kin on the card).

**Architecture:** `A4.5` (life times as Body crossings), `A8.2` (the children columns; the dead leave the store), `A8.3` (food use in pregnancy and nursing; blood lost), `A8.6` (bleeding's closed form; deaths through limits; births and deaths logged), `A8.7`, `A8.8` (the setback), `A8.10` (a baby's needs, parent and baby love), `A8.15` (`K`, the new social options, led children), `A9.3` (named by the mother), `A9.4` (families after births and deaths), `A11.8` (movements, variants), `A12.4` (cards), `A14.8`.

**Needs:** α06b.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-core` (`motion::follow`), `kd-people` (`life/stages.rs`, `life/birth.rs`, `life/nursing.rs`, `life/death.rs`, `body/numbers.rs`, `body/blood.rs`, `store.rs` (the `wounds` column), `body/levels.rs`, `choose/options.rs`, `purposes.rs`), `kd-culture` (`groups.rs`), `kd-things` (`remains.rs`), `kd-sim` (the barrier's births and deaths, `deaths.rs`, snapshot), `kd-tools` (`kd check names`), `kd-view` (`FigureView`, `RemainsView`), `kd-render` (`figures/`), `kd-ui` (`views/person.rs`, `views/remains.rs`, `findable.rs`), `kd-text`, `data/models/movements.md`, `data/items/remains.md`, `data/minds/acts.md`, `data/text/cards.md`, `data/text/deaths.md`, `data/tuning/people.md`, `data/tuning/body.md`.

**Tasks:**

1. `T06c.1` **Stages, growth and ageing (`BIO-04`, `BIO-16`, `BIO-06`, `MND-07`, A8.7, A8.8).**
   `crates/kd-people/src/life/stages.rs`: age in game years from `born` (A4.2: a child born in Year 1 is an adult in Year 15); `stage_at(age) -> LifeStage` with `Baby` (under 1: carried, on milk), `Toddler` (1–4: walking from 1, talking from 2, led by a carer), `Child` (5–13: helping, gathering and carrying), `Adult` (14–44) and `Old` (45 and over), the α03b column now kept current.
   Growth (A8.7): `height_frac(age)` 0.3 at birth, 0.5 at 2, 0.75 at 9, 0.95 at 14 and 1 at 16, straight between; mass = the adult mass of the person's inborn height and build × `height_frac`³; walking speeds keep α03c's age factors.
   The wake job's daily body checks (A8.3) gain `life::daily(p, now)`: a day before 14 with condition under 30 adds one to `child_hunger`; on the birthday when age reaches 14, min(0.15, 0.1 × `child_hunger` ÷ 60) comes off height and strength for life (A8.8's setback); each birthday moves the stage on.
   Ageing (`BIO-16`): `body::numbers::current(p, which, now)` = the inborn value × growth × (1 − 0.02 × years past 45) for strength, stamina, resistance, sight and hearing, and healing (here: blood coming back, T06c.3) slows the same way (A8.6).
   Children's needs (A8.7, `MND-07`): a baby feels only hunger, thirst, warmth, rest, safety and love; from 1, every other need's weight in α04c's score is × (age − 1) ÷ 13, reaching an adult's at 14.
   Commit `T06c.1: stages, growth and ageing (BIO-04, BIO-16, A8.7, A8.8)`.

2. `T06c.2` **Conception and pregnancy (`BIO-15`, `BIO-16`, `MND-15`, A8.3, A8.7).**
   `crates/kd-people/src/life/birth.rs`: a woman can conceive while she has a male partner in her band, her fertility is above 0, her condition is 30 or more, and she is neither pregnant nor nursing; fertility is 1 from 18 to 33, 0.5 from 33 to 38 and 0 outside (`data/tuning/people.md`).
   These are A8.7's and `BIO-15`'s numbers (18 to 38, half as fast from 33, never while nursing), so the weaning age (T06c.4) is what spaces births, checked against about 4 years by `births_about_four_years_apart`.
   The wait is one exponential draw (`bodies.conceive`, system 9, subject the woman, fortune `None`): −ln(u) × 30 days ÷ fertility (1 in 30 a day, A8.7), counted from the moment every condition holds; it is redrawn when one changes (a partner, condition crossing 30, a birthday changing fertility, the end of nursing), at most once a game day; like every life time below, it is a crossing in the person's one Body event (A4.5, A8.3), so no new event kind is needed.
   At conception `pregnancy = Some(Pregnancy { father: Uid, since, due, early_end: Option<GameTime> })`, `due` being `since` + `"9 mo"` (45 game days by `game_length`); the early end is drawn there (`bodies.early_end`, fortune `Bad`): 1 in 6, × 1.5 for each of condition under 50 and age 33 or more (illness joins in α17b), its day drawn in the first 30 days.
   Food use rises 0.2 while pregnant (A8.3); in the last 15 days stamina × 0.7 and walking × 0.8 (A8.7); nothing shows before those 15 days, and conception is never shown or logged (`BIO-15`).
   An early end clears the pregnancy and is logged (`pregnancy_ended`, not kept forever).
   Nothing caps births (`MND-15`): no rule here reads the band's size or the world's.
   Commit `T06c.2: conception and pregnancy (BIO-15, BIO-16, MND-15, A8.7)`.

3. `T06c.3` **Birth (`BIO-15`, `BIO-14`, `BIO-17`, `PRE-10`, A8.6, A8.7, A9.3, A9.4, A14.8).**
   At `due`, labour starts as a forced activity that interrupts whatever she does (A8.9): within 2 km of camp she walks back first, then `GiveBirth` (2–12 game hours, `bodies.labour_hours`) in the cave; farther out, where she stands.
   `data/minds/acts.md` gains `attend_birth` (A8.15's "one person sought", joining her activity as a shared one, α06b's `Shared`; relief to her 40, so `K` = 40 × kin weight, `checks = ["BIO-15", "MND-26"]`): adults of her kin choose to sit with her (who does is never set by sex, `BIO-17`); she gives birth "with a helper" when an adult attends within 4 m at the end.
   At the end, by system 9: hard (`bodies.hard_birth`, `Bad`) at 1 in 10 × 1.5 for a first child × 1.5 under 20 or from 33 (A8.7) × 1.3 small (inborn height under the average by more than its σ) × 1.3 hungry (condition under 30); twins (`bodies.twins`, `None`) at 1 in 80.
   A hard birth loses the baby (`bodies.baby_lost`, `Bad`) at 1 in 5 with a helper and 2 in 5 alone, and makes the mother bleed: one roll (`bodies.birth_bleed_death`, `Bad`) at 1 in 20 with a helper (× (1 − 0.05 × the helper's healing experience), 0 until experience comes in α11a) and 2 in 20 alone decides it, and the outcome is shown through the blood level (A8.7).
   So, as A8.7 and `BIO-15` say, about 1 helped birth in 200 kills the mother by bleeding (1 in 10 hard × 1 in 20), twice that alone; the other half of `BIO-15`'s 1 in 100, wound fever after 1 birth in 70, comes with illness (α17b, A7.13).
   `crates/kd-people/src/body/blood.rs`: the person store's `wounds` column (`SmallVec<[Wound; 2]>`, A8.2) joins with A8.6's `Wound` (24 bytes: part, kind, flags, size, heal rate, flow, made and bleed-start minutes) with the kind `BirthBleed` only; flow starts at a tenth of the size a minute and halves every 10 minutes, so the loss is 1.44 × size left alone; `blood_lost(p, t)` is that closed form (A8.3's one value that is not a `Smooth`), its crossings of 25 (weak), 35 (collapse) and 50 (death) scheduled in the Body event; blood comes back 10 a day, slower with age (T06c.1); a death roll gives a size whose loss passes 50, a survival one a size whose loss ends at 20–34, so she is weak for days; other wound kinds, pressing and care come in α09b.
   The newborn (`life::birth::newborn(mother, father, at, cx) -> NewPerson`): sex by `bodies.sex` (`None`, 0.512 boys), inborn numbers, traits and looks inherited by α06a's rules, the leaning drawn as α06a draws it, named by the mother (α06a, A9.3), a uid from the cluster's reservation (A3.4), stage `Baby`, condition 60 and belly and water full, in its mother's band and family from the next barrier (A9.4), relations with its kin (kinship true; its parents' and its love 80 both ways, A8.10's leaning), carried by its mother.
   A lost baby is made and dies at the same second (cause `Birth`, how "a hard birth, in the cave at Red Cliff"), so the record keeps both (`BIO-14`, `PRE-10`).
   Each birth is logged forever: child, mother, father, date and place (`PRE-10`, A14.8), in the history list until α07b's log takes it.
   Commit `T06c.3: births, hard births and twins (BIO-15, BIO-14, PRE-10, A8.6, A8.7)`.

4. `T06c.4` **Babies, nursing, carers and led children (`BIO-15`, `MND-07`, `MND-26`, `BIO-21`, A8.7, A8.10, A8.15).**
   `crates/kd-people/src/life/nursing.rs`: a mother nurses from the birth (`nursing`, `nursing_since`; food use + 0.25, A8.3) until her child's weaning age, drawn at birth at 2–3 game years (`bodies.weaning`, `None`); a woman nurses at most two.
   A baby's belly and water fill while it is carried by, or within 4 m of, a woman nursing it, at its use × min(1, her condition ÷ 40) (A8.7); for its first `"6 mo"` (30 game days) milk alone, then also soft food that a carer `share`s (α06b's act): food whose hardness and toughness are both 1 or less by its characteristics, which among `MIL-01`'s foods are blackberries and crab apples.
   Babies never choose: each is carried by its carer (a `carrier: Uid` column beside A8.2's children columns, which A8.2 gains in this branch; the mother first), held close for warmth (the carrier's felt temperature + 4 °C), asleep whenever its rest falls below 50 and awake by 80, wherever its carrier is; its love falls 20 away from its mother (A8.10); its need under 20 interrupts its carrier as a call (A4.7's "a baby's cry"; other calls come in α10a).
   A baby left without a carrier (T06c.5) lies where it was, and two options open (A8.15's "one person sought", `data/minds/acts.md`): `take_baby` for any adult of the band (relief: the baby's safety and love × kin weight), and `nurse_other` for a nursing woman (relief: its hunger and thirst × kin weight), who carries it and feeds it as her own; whoever takes it becomes its carrier and main carer; without milk and under 6 months it dies of thirst within about 3 days (A8.3's `dry`), which is `BIO-15`'s rule coming out of the body.
   Raised together (`MND-26`, A8.7): each game day, every child under 6 and every band member who is under 6 or is its main carer add a day to their relation both ways (a `young_days: u16` in α06b's record); at 3 game years (180 game days) the pair is flagged raised together, so α06b's courting and pairing rules see it.
   Led children (A8.15's walking together): a toddler follows its carer whenever she walks over 30 m away, on her path 2 s behind (`kd_core::motion::follow(path, delay_s) -> Path`, re-aimed when her path changes, A4.6); while she stays, it chooses among options within 30 m of her (play, rest, sleep, eat what it holds, drink at water there), so it drinks where she drinks and eats what she shares (`K` 0.5 for a parent); from 5, children choose on their own and gather (A8.7's helping).
   Commit `T06c.4: babies, nursing, carers and led children (BIO-15, MND-26, A8.7, A8.15)`.

5. `T06c.5` **Old age, every death and the body (`BIO-16`, `BIO-14`, A8.2, A8.6, A8.7, A9.4, A14.8).**
   `crates/kd-people/src/life/death.rs`: giving out (`BIO-16`, A8.7): at each birthday from 55, the body gives out within the coming year at chance 1 − e^(−h), h = 0.02 × 2^((age − 55) ÷ 7) (`bodies.giving_out`, `Bad`), on a day drawn in that year (`bodies.giving_out_day`, `None`), scheduled in the Body event; cause `GaveOut`.
   Deaths now come only through the limits `MIL-01` has (`BIO-14`, A8.6): hunger and thirst (α04b), cold and heat (α05), blood lost 50 (births), birth (a lost baby), the body giving out, and poison (in tests); `Death { cause, how, place, age }`, the how from pattern ids in `data/text/deaths.md` with their arguments ("bleeding, after a hard birth, in the cave at Red Cliff"; "old age: his body gave out in his sleep in the cave"; "thirst, a baby without milk, at Hazel Ford"), never "unknown".
   `crates/kd-things/src/remains.rs`: the body becomes a thing of kind `human_body` where they fell, with a `Remains` row (who, `looks::remains_look(p)`: the shown look, build, height and age the figure needs, so nothing outside `looks` reads `sex`; died), drawn lying dead (T06c.6); held things fall beside it (`put`); its rotting timer (A6.12, `{ life = "4 w", game = "4 w" }`, slower in cold, stopped in frost) turns it into `human_bones`, which stay.
   Awake people within 30 m learn the death at once (a `news_death` fact at sureness 100, α06b's topic), the rest by talk (A8.6); relations to the dead stay, marked dead.
   At the next barrier the dead leave the store (A8.2); a partner is unpartnered; a carried baby is left lying (T06c.4); families change (A9.4): a lone parent's children under 14 join the family of their closest living kin in the band (grandparent, adult brother or sister, aunt or uncle, by kinship, then age), else the family of the band's eldest woman.
   **Decision:** unpartnered adults stay in the family that raised them until they pair, since A9.4 leaves them out and α06a's `families_cover_the_band` keeps everyone in one family.
   Each death is logged forever with its cause and how (`BIO-14`, A14.8); a band's last death leaves the world running (`TIM-09`'s first half; its entry and choice come with the book in α11b).
   Commit `T06c.5: old age, every death and the body left behind (BIO-16, BIO-14, A8.6, A8.7)`.

6. `T06c.6` **Figures for a whole life (`PRE-44`, `PRE-27`, A11.8).**
   `data/models/movements.md`, a new kind `Movement` holding A11.8's closed list (`checks = ["PRE-44"]`): the movements built so far move here from `figures/poses.rs` with their key poses, loop length and marks (`idle`, `sit`, `sleep`, `walk`, `eat`, `drink`, and `talk` with its 4 gesture poses); the activities that borrowed `idle` until now get their own (`gather`: stooping, a hand to the plant and back to the other hand, from the mockup's `scrape` frames, its mark at each handful; `play`: crouch, hop, turn and clap; `carry`: forearms level over the walk); and three join: `carry_baby` (forearms cradling at the chest, over any posture), `nurse` (sitting, the baby held close; no body detail at any content level, `PRE-18`) and `lie_dead` (on the back, limbs loose, no breathing frame); the catalogue check fails an activity kind without a movement (A11.8).
   Variants (A11.8): `child` under 12 (child sizes, pace × 1.25) and `elder` over 55 (torso forward 12°, head down 6°, pace × 0.8); a figure's size follows `height_frac`; hair moves toward `hair_grey` from 50, half by 60 and fully by 70.
   A baby is drawn as a small figure (child sizes at height fraction 0.3) attached at its carrier's chest (`attach`, A11.8), or lying where it was left; `kd-view` gains `FigureView.carried_by: Option<Uid>` and `RemainsView { at, heading, look, bones: bool }`; a body is its person's figure in `lie_dead`, and bones a low pale heap (the `lump` shape in α01a's `bone` ladder, the mockup's).
   Commit `T06c.6: babies carried, children, elders and the dead drawn (PRE-44, PRE-27, A11.8)`.

7. `T06c.7` **A life on the cards, and the private readers (`PRE-35`, `PRE-10`, `BIO-14`, `BIO-17`, A8.7, A12.4).**
   The person card shows age in years with its stage word (`baby`, `small child`, `child`, `young woman` or `young man` to 20, `woman` or `man`, `elder` from 55), `expecting a child` in the last 15 days of a pregnancy only, `nursing <name>`, children with their ages, and dead kin as `<name>, died <date>`.
   Tapping a body opens `crates/kd-ui/src/views/remains.rs`: "The body of Tesha 'Quick Water' · died Year 3, winter, day 4, aged 58 · old age: her body gave out in her sleep in the cave", with her card a tap away (the grave card of α24b grows from it); its lines come from `data/text/deaths.md` and `data/text/cards.md` (`PRE-37`).
   `kd check names` gains A8.7's private readers (`BIO-17`): `People`'s `sex` and `drawn` columns and their accessors may be named only in `body/numbers.rs`, `life/birth.rs`, `life/pairing.rs` and `looks.rs`, and anywhere else fail with the file and line; set-up (α06a's `first_band`) asks `body::numbers` for a mother or a father, and the snapshot's `BodyLook` (α03b) comes from `looks::body_look(p)`, so neither names the column.
   `World::record_kinds()` gains `people.life` (stage, pregnancy, nursing, carers and led children) and `things.remains` (a body, with its death's cause and how), with their `FINDABLE` lines (the person card's life lines; the remains card) (`PRE-13`).
   Commit `T06c.7: a life on the cards; sex and the leaning kept private (PRE-35, BIO-17, PRE-13)`.

8. `T06c.8` **Deliver (`PRC-11`).**
   Golden `camp-baby` (close camp at 10:00 on summer day 6 of Year 3 of a fixed seed: a mother carrying a baby, a toddler behind her, an elder sitting); `versionCode=1063`, `versionName=a06c`; `bench/cloud/a06c.json` adds births and deaths a game year over 10 game years of the first band and the cost of the daily life check (at most 0.5 µs a person); the note says that the dead now lie where they fell until burial comes with customs; then P0's steps 5 to 8.

**Data:** `data/tuning/people.md` (`fertile_from = 18`, `fertility_halves_at = 33`, `fertile_until = 38`, `conceive_days = 30`, `pregnancy = "9 mo"`, `early_end = 0.167`, `hard_birth = 0.1` with its factors, `baby_lost = 0.2`, `bleed_death = 0.05`, `alone_factor = 2`, `twins = 0.0125`, `labour_hours = [2, 12]`, `weaning_years = [2, 3]`, `milk_only = "6 mo"`, `newborn_condition = 60`, `boys = 0.512`, `height_frac` table, `decline = { from = 45, per_year = 0.02 }`, `giving_out = { from = 55, h0 = 0.02, doubling_years = 7 }`, `led_until = 5`, `led_m = 30`, `follow_s = 2`, `notice_death_m = 30`, `raised_together_days = 180`); `data/tuning/body.md` (`pregnant_food = 0.2`, `nursing_food = 0.25`, `blood_back_per_day = 10`, A8.6's bleeding numbers); `data/items/remains.md` (`human_body`, `human_bones`: class flesh and bone, tag `remains`, outside `MAT-10`'s count like A7.6's carcasses, `checks = ["BIO-14", "MAT-08"]`); `data/models/movements.md` (the 7 built so far, `gather`, `play`, `carry`, `carry_baby`, `nurse`, `lie_dead`); `data/minds/acts.md` (`attend_birth`, `take_baby`, `nurse_other`); `data/text/deaths.md` (the how of each cause); `data/text/cards.md` (stage words, `expecting a child`, `nursing`, `died`).

**Tests:**
- `kd-people` (`BIO-15`, `BIO-16`, `BIO-04`, `MND-15`): `life::birth::tests::risks_over_100k_births` (a mother of 25 with a second child and a helper: hard births 1 in 10 and babies lost 1 in 5 of them, within a third either way; mothers lost to bleeding 1 in 200 and twins 1 in 80, within half to double, `RES-13`; alone, both losses doubled); `life::birth::tests::conception_wait` (100,000 draws: mean 30 days at 25, 60 at 35, never at 39 or while nursing); `life::birth::tests::nothing_caps_births` (a band of 200 conceives at the rate of a band of 20); `body::blood::tests::closed_form_matches_steps` (within 0.1 point of minute-by-minute steps, A8.22); `life::stages::tests::growth_table` (A8.7's fractions, full height at 16); `life::stages::tests::decline_from_45` (strength at 65 is 0.6 of the same person's at 45); `life::stages::tests::setback_at_14` (60 hungry days take 0.1 off height and strength); `life::death::tests::giving_out_hazard` (100,000 lives from 55: deaths at each age within `RES-13`'s ranges of 1 − e^(−h), about 1 in 50 at 55, doubling every 7 years); `life::nursing::tests::belly_follows_her_condition`.
- `kd-sim` (`BIO-14`): `deaths::tests::every_death_has_cause_and_how` grows to every `MIL-01` cause; `deaths::tests::body_where_they_fell`.
- `kd-culture` (`MND-26`): `groups::tests::orphans_join_closest_kin`; `groups::tests::families_cover_the_band` still holds after births and deaths.
- `kd-tools` (`BIO-17`): `names::tests::sex_read_outside_its_modules_fails` (a planted reader in `choose/` fails).
- Rust scenario tests in `crates/kd-sim/tests/life.rs`, 20 runs each from seeds 6301–6320, every choice audited, limits as stated (the labour one until her baby is born, at most 60 game days), budgets 0.05 session-hours and 0.3 for the two 10-year ones (`RES-09`; α07c moves them into scene files): `births_about_four_years_apart` (the first band for 10 game years: the median gap between a mother's births 3–5 game years, in at least 16 of 20, `BIO-15`'s first line inside one band); `kin_attend_a_birth` (a woman in labour at the cave has a helper in at least 16 of 20); `orphan_nursed_by_kin_lives` (the setting starts a 10-day-old baby whose mother died before the start, with a nursing aunt in the band: alive after 30 game days in at least 16 of 20); `baby_without_milk_dies` (the same with no nursing woman: dead within 5 game days, of thirst, in 20 of 20, `BIO-15`'s last line); `toddlers_stay_near_carers` (over 5 game days every toddler is within 40 m of its carer at every barrier, in 20 of 20); `every_death_named` (over the 10-year run, every death has a cause and a how, in 20 of 20, `BIO-14`'s Check).
- `kd det first-camp --days 3` passes.
- Screens: golden `camp-baby`.

**On the phone:**
1. Touch the screen and drag the dial until the bar reads about `3 years a minute`; after about a minute (three game years) tap pause and look at the cave: someone now carries a baby at her chest; tap her: `nursing <name>`; tap the baby: its name, its mother and its father.
2. Follow a mother out to gather: a small child walks a step behind her all the way.
3. Tap an elder: grey hair and a stoop, aged over 55.
4. Tap a child born in the game: their parents, brothers and sisters listed, the child resembling them.
5. If anyone has died, their body lies where they fell; tap it: who they were, when and why they died.

**Not in this alpha:** wound fever after births and every illness (α17b); other wounds, pressing and plain care (α09b); healing experience making helpers better (α11a); grief and mourning (α28); graves and burial (α24b, `CUL-19` at α32b); the family tree (α10b); births and deaths in the book of ages, and the last death's entry and choice (α11b); marriage customs (α37; the parent's veto on pairing is α06b's); leaving a newborn (α39a, `CUL-08`); `BIO-04`'s ranges and `BIO-15`'s whole-world lines (the pace tests, α27b).

**Risks:**
- Too few or too many births for about every 4 years: conception's 1 in 30 a day and the weaning ages are tuned (`RES-16`) on `births_about_four_years_apart`, logged in `data/TUNING-LOG.md`; nothing is capped.
- A carried baby drifting from its carrier at speed: a carried baby has no path; its place is read from its carrier's at every read, so it cannot drift.
- A small band dying out in a bad year: nothing props it up (`MND-15`); the world runs on (`TIM-09`), and the note says so if a delivered seed's band dies.
- Bodies lying about the camp: that is `PRE-18`'s rule until burial; at the Plain level they are drawn unmarked, as at every level until wounds exist.

### α07a Saving (about 5.5 hours)

**Goal:** worlds are kept: every 30 real seconds and whenever the app leaves the screen, a crash-safe save writes the whole world, so closing the app, swiping it away or a flat battery never loses more than the last few seconds; a damaged save is never loaded; and every alpha from now on keeps old worlds opening.

**Serves:** `PLT-07` (part: a save every 30 s and on leaving; a damaged save never loaded; reopening within 3 s; the catch-up comes in α07b), `TIM-05` (closing and reopening at any moment gives the same history as never closing), `TIM-16` (part: save, load and carry on equals the unbroken run, on every target), `PRN-15` (part: the present state saved, never re-run), `PLT-10` (part: present state, kept areas and the island's fixed layers kept; unchanged areas remade from the seed), `PLT-09` (part: versions in every save, migrations, fixtures, older worlds read-only after a big update), `WLD-08` (part: a world keeps its generator version), `RES-05` (part: a save opens with one state hash on every target), `RSK-21` (part: a fixture world from every schema change).

**Architecture:** `A14.1`, `A14.2`, `A14.3`, `A14.4`, `A14.5`, `A14.6`, `A14.9`, `A14.10` (the container, for fixtures and `kd`), `A14.11` (the web), `A14.12`, `A14.13`, `A3.2` (`Fixed` encodings), `A3.4` (allocators saved whole), `A2.5` (`onPause`, `destroy`), `A4.10` (saving at a finished step), `A16.5`.

**Needs:** α06c.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-core` (`persist`), `kd-world`, `kd-things`, `kd-people`, `kd-culture` and `kd-sim` (each store's `Persist`), `kd-save` (`storage.rs`, `files.rs`, `mem.rs`, `pack.rs`, `manifest.rs`, `save.rs`, `open.rs`, `migrate.rs`, `container.rs`), `kd-app` (`io.rs`, autosave, `Platform::storage`), `kd-android` (`filesDir`, `onPause`, `destroy`), `kd-web` (`idb.rs`), `web/glue.js`, `kd-tools` (`kd world`, `kd kill-test`), `tests/fixtures/worlds/`, `data/tuning/save.md`, `tools/check.sh`.

**Tasks:**

1. `T07a.1` **Persist and the chunk encoding (`PRN-15`, A3.2, A14.3, A14.12).**
   `kd_core::persist`: `ChunkKind(u16)` with every kind numbered in one table (`kd_core::persist::kinds`, permanent numbers like A3.3's purposes, a test failing on a repeat): `world.header`, `world.clock`, `sim.queue`, `sim.ids` (each allocator's free list in order and the spill state, A3.4), and the architecture's names: `world.fixed`, `world.cells` and `world.sparse` (the sparse maps, the worn edges of α03d among them, A5.2), `world.weather`, `area.head`, `area.marks` and `area.things` (kept areas by A5.4's block, A5.4), `things.live` (things in live areas and carried, with their timer groups and clocks and the live areas' change counts, A6.16), `people.hot`, `people.lists` (A8.2), `cul.lang`, `cul.names`, `cul.groups` (A9.1) (α07b adds `hist.head`); `things.area` waits for dormant blocks (α19c); `ChunkKey { kind: u16, schema: u16, area: u32, part: u32 }` (A14.3: `area` the A5.4 block of 8 × 8 areas or 0, `part` splitting big columns); `ChunkSink` and `ChunkSource`; `LoadError`.
   The encoding (A14.3): little-endian fixed-width fields of `Fixed` types written by each store's own code, floats through `num::clean` (−0.0 as +0.0, never NaN), ids whole, catalogue entries by permanent id (A3.6), maps in key order, no pointer, padding, `usize` or `isize`, at most 8 MiB raw a chunk, so every target writes the same bytes.

   Commit `T07a.1: Persist and the canonical chunk encoding (PRN-15, A14.3, A14.12)`.

2. `T07a.2` **Every store saves itself (`PRN-15`, `PLT-10`, `TIM-16`, A14.1, A14.3).**

4. `T07a.4` **Packs, manifests and the save (`PLT-07`, A14.2, A14.4, A16.5).**
   `crates/kd-save/src/pack.rs`, recovering `b04-b11-storage-terrain/phone/src/save.rs`'s codec enum, `compress`, `decompress`, table of contents and trailer (A2.9), cut to A14.4's layout: `pack-<gen>.kdp` = magic `KDPACK01`, the chunks each compressed alone (zstd level 1 natively, `ruzstd`'s compressor on the web, codec 0 when compressing does not shrink one, A2.4), a table (per chunk: key, offset, stored and raw lengths, codec, `num::hash64` of the stored bytes), the table's length and a trailer hash.
   `manifest.rs`: `manifest-<gen>.kdm` = magic `KDMANI01`, `FORMAT_VERSION = 1`, the save's second T, `data/VERSION.toml`'s rules (`major`, `minor`) and generator versions and the catalogue hash (A14.9), each chunk kind's schema, every live chunk's pack, offset, lengths, codec and hash, the history log's extents (empty until α07b), and a trailer hash.
   `save.rs`: `begin_save(w, st, pool, why) -> SaveJob` and `SaveJob::step(storage, max_chunks)` as A14.12, in A14.4's order: the world paused at a second where `advance_to` returned `Reached` (A4.10); every chunk's raw encoding copied into the save buffer (at `MIL-01` all of them each time; dirty bits come in α19c) and the world resumed; each chunk compressed and hashed and `pack-<g>.kdp` written with `write_atomic`; `manifest-<g>.kdm` written the same way, which is the commit; then `meta.bin` (at most 8 KB: world id, name, date, people, seed, versions, sizes, flags) and `ui.bin` replaced, and packs and manifests named by neither g nor g − 1 removed; a failed commit leaves g − 1 the newest, and no save starts while one is being written; the last step returns `SaveReport { bytes, chunks, pause_ms, total_ms }`.
   A world lives in `worlds/w-<16 hex>/` (A14.2), its id random at creation from `Platform::now_ns` and the device line, outside the world's chance, so two worlds from one seed differ.
   Commit `T07a.4: packs, manifests and crash-safe saves (PLT-07, A14.4; from pretests/b04-b11-storage-terrain)`.

**On the phone:**
1. Note the date on the time bar, press Home, swipe Kindling away in recent apps, and open it again: the same date to the second, everyone where they were, the camera where you left it.
2. Let it run at the valley stop for a minute, turn the screen off and on: it carries on from where it stopped.
3. Open the web link, let it run, then reload the page: the world carries on from its last save (or the version line says `not saved here` if this viewer blocks storage).
4. When the next alpha arrives, install it over this one: this world is still there.

**Not in this alpha:** the history log, crash catch-up, the list of worlds and settings (α07b); the self-check's save and reopen (α07c); dirty chunks, compaction, dormant blocks and storage warnings (α19c); export and import on the phone, and the safety copy pinned after an update (α53a); your acts in `acts.log` (α16).

**Risks:**
- IndexedDB blocked inside the artifact viewer: the world runs in memory and says so (A14.11); the APK keeps worlds.
- A column left out of a chunk, so a reopened world drifts: `close_and_reopen_equals_unbroken` and `kd det --reopen` catch it at once, naming the first differing chunk (`kd diverge` comes in α07c).
- A save pausing the world too long as worlds grow: the pause only copies encodings (A14.4) and is measured every alpha from now (A16.5).

### α07b History, worlds and settings (about 5 hours)

**Goal:** the world keeps its history as it happens: every birth, death and pairing for good, and every activity's end with its reasons for 50 game years, in a crash-safe log; after a crash the world catches up to where it stopped under a short note, losing nothing; and the owner keeps several worlds, starts a new one, switches between them and sets the content level.

**Serves:** `PRN-15` (part: history saved as it happened), `PLT-07` (the catch-up after a crash; `PLT-07`'s Done when, with the kill test), `PLT-10` (part: history kept and its thinning rule in place, first acting at game year 51), `TIM-08` (part: several saved worlds, switching; the book of ages joins in α11b), `PRE-40` (part: the list of worlds, settings and credits; the first launch opens the first region), `PRE-18` (part: the content level in settings), `PRE-10` (part: births and pairings kept forever and queried by person), `BIO-14` (part: every death logged with its cause and how), `PRN-13` (part: reasons logged with each activity's end), `TIM-16` (part: a crash remade exactly).

**Architecture:** `A14.1`, `A14.2` (the log's files), `A14.5` (step 5), `A14.7`, `A14.8`, `A14.11` (sizes in the list), `A14.12` (`EventSink`, `query_history`), `A3.9` (`settings.toml`), `A12.4` (Worlds, Settings, First launch, Catch-up line), `A12.8`.

**Needs:** α07a.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-core` (`persist::LoggedEvent`, `EventSink`), `kd-data` (kind `EventKind`), `kd-sim` (`history.rs`: buffers and the merge), `kd-people` and `kd-culture` (events emitted), `kd-save` (`log.rs`, `catchup.rs`, `worlds.rs`), `kd-app` (`settings.rs`, the I/O thread's queries, the worlds flow), `kd-view` (`Query::History`), `kd-ui` (`time_bar`, `views/worlds.rs`, `views/settings.rs`, `views/catchup.rs`, `views/person.rs`, `findable.rs`), `kd-text`, `data/history/event_kinds.md`, `data/text/settings.md`, `data/tuning/save.md`, `assets/LICENSES.md`.
