1. `T07b.1` **Events and their kinds (`PRN-15`, `PRN-13`, A14.8, A14.12).**
   `kd_core::persist`: `LoggedEvent` (32 bytes, `fixed!`: `time: u64`, `kind: u16`, `flags: u16`, `place: u32`, `actor: u64`, `target: u64`) with an optional payload in a side column, and the trait `EventSink` (A14.12).
   `data/history/event_kinds.md`, kind `EventKind` (`checks = ["PRN-15", "PLT-10"]`), each with `logged`, `kept_forever`, `first_able` and `pattern` (a `data/text/` pattern id): `world_made` (kept forever; seed and versions), `birth` (kept forever; actor the child, target the mother, payload the father and the name, a twin flag), `death` (kept forever; payload the cause, the how's pattern and arguments, the age and the name), `pairing` (kept forever), `activity_end` (logged; payload the activity kind and its 24-byte reasons, A8.15), `pregnancy_ended` (logged), `rules_changed` (kept forever; old and new versions, A14.9); Stage 2 adds its own from α11a on (`learned`, `people_first`, `world_first`, `hunch_tried`, then α11b's `craft_lost` and `craft_regained`).
   `crates/kd-sim/src/history.rs`: each cluster buffers its events, merged at every barrier and pause in (time, actor uid, sequence) order (A4.8, A14.8), so the order never depends on how clusters ran; α04b's history list goes, and every emitter goes through `PeopleWorld::emit` (A8.15).
   Commit `T07b.1: logged events and their kinds (PRN-15, PRN-13, A14.8)`.

2. `T07b.2` **The history log (`PRN-15`, `PLT-10`, `PRE-10`, A14.8).**
   `crates/kd-save/src/log.rs`, recovering `b04-b11-storage-terrain/phone/src/hist.rs`'s `Log` (`open`, `append_day`, `roll`, `person`, `region`, A2.9; its SQLite half left behind): the open game year goes to the journal by `append_flush`, one hashed block per game day or per 10 real seconds, whichever comes first; at the first save after a game year ends, the year's events are sorted by region, person and time into `log/seg-<year>.kdl` with its index, in blocks of 4,096 events, and the journal starts afresh.
   **Decision:** the journal is `log/journal-<gen>.kdj`, named by the save that started it, and a year's roll is written inside that save, before its manifest, which names the new segment and journal; why: a crash mid-roll then leaves either the old journal or the new segment standing, as with packs; A14.2 is updated in this branch.
   Each save records the log's extents (the journal's name and length, its last block's hash, each segment's hash) in its manifest (α07a's field); `kd_core::persist::kinds` gains `hist.head` (the open block's buffer and counters).
   Thinning (`PLT-10`): `thin_segment(year)` keeps only kinds kept forever and events still named by a living record, run by the first save after a segment turns 50 game years old, so it first acts in Year 51.
   `query_history(storage, HistoryQuery) -> Vec<LoggedEvent>` by person (as actor or target), by kind and by span, answered on the I/O thread; `kd-view::Query::History` reaches it from the UI, the reply a frame or two later (A12.3); the card's dead kin read their death's date this way (α06c), and α10b's family tree will; `World::record_kinds()` gains `hist.log`, with its `FINDABLE` line (the person card's dates of births, pairings and deaths; the book from α11b) (`PRE-13`).
   Commit `T07b.2: the history log, segments and thinning (PRN-15, PLT-10, A14.8; from pretests/b04-b11-storage-terrain)`.

3. `T07b.3` **Catching up after a crash (`PLT-07`, `TIM-16`, A14.5, A14.7).**
   `crates/kd-save/src/catchup.rs`: on opening (A14.5 step 5), whole journal blocks past the save's extents mean the world did not stop cleanly; their hashes are noted, they are cut from the journal, and the world runs at top speed from the save to the last whole block's end under the line `Catching up to where the world stopped: Year 3, autumn, day 6` (`kd-ui/src/views/catchup.rs`, A12.4); each remade block's hash is compared with the noted one, and a mismatch is a determinism break, written to the diagnostics the phone benchmark reports (α07d), the remade state standing (A14.7).
   Nothing after the last whole block is lost: the world goes on from there and makes the same events again; the catch-up repeats at most one autosave interval, so it lasts at most about 30 s (A16.5); acts recorded in `acts.log` join it in α16.
   `kd kill-test` now also checks the log: after each kill, open and catch-up, every event the journal held in whole blocks before the kill is in the log, in the same order, and none twice (`PLT-07`'s "never loses an event").
   Commit `T07b.3: catching up after a crash (PLT-07, TIM-16, A14.7)`.

4. `T07b.4` **Several worlds (`TIM-08`, `PRE-40`, `PLT-10`, A12.4, A14.11).**
   `crates/kd-save/src/worlds.rs`: `list_worlds(storage)` from each `meta.bin` (name, date, people, sizes of present state, kept areas and history, and marks for damaged, read-only and test worlds, A14.11), and `delete_world(storage, id)`.
   A world is named after its first band's cave in its own language, with the first four hex digits of its seed (`Red Cliff · 3fa2`).
   `crates/kd-ui/src/views/worlds.rs` (A12.4): the list; a tap opens a world, saving the current one first (`TIM-08`); `New world` makes the first region from a new seed (`WLD-34`; α27a's New world screen replaces it); `Delete` asks "Delete Red Cliff · 3fa2? This cannot be undone." and deletes only on that confirmation (`PLT-10`); export and import come in α53a.
   First launch (A12.4, `PRE-40`): with no world saved, the app makes the first region from a new seed and opens it at the camp stop on the band's cave, showing `A new world: Red Cliff · 3fa2` for 3 s.
   The time bar (α03a) gains a `views` button opening a short list: Worlds and Settings (the book joins in α11b).
   Commit `T07b.4: several worlds, new worlds and the first launch (TIM-08, PRE-40, A12.4)`.

5. `T07b.5` **Settings and credits (`PRE-40`, `PRE-18`, A3.9, A12.4, A12.8).**
   `crates/kd-app/src/settings.rs`: `settings.toml` outside the worlds (A3.9) with `content = "show" | "plain" | "gentle"` (default `show`), `last_world`, `help_seen` and `last_self_check` (α07c); the live-moment level joins in α11b and the volumes in α16b.
   `crates/kd-ui/src/views/settings.rs` (A12.4): the content level with A12.8's line for each (`data/text/settings.md`: Show "wounds and blood shown; the dead lie where they fell", Plain "no blood or wound marks; the dead lie still", Gentle "as Plain, and dark events never come to you"), `Show help cards again`, credits (the 7-pixel font from `assets/LICENSES.md`; recordings join with sound) and the version line, whose long press opens the Tests screen from α07d (`PRE-40`: settings open the review page).
   The content level changes only what is drawn and heard, never the world (`PRE-18`): at `MIL-01` nothing differs yet, since wounds and blood come in α09b, and a test holds the state hash equal at all three levels.
   Commit `T07b.5: settings with the content level, and credits (PRE-40, PRE-18, A12.8)`.

6. `T07b.6` **Deliver (`PRC-11`).**
   Smoke gains `two worlds` (make a second world, open the first again: its date and state hash are those it was left with); `versionCode=1072`, `versionName=a07b`; `bench/cloud/a07b.json` adds events logged a person a game day and bytes an event (A14.8: about 10 and 13), the journal's flush time and the log's size after 10 game years of the first band; then P0's steps 5 to 8.

**Data:** `data/history/event_kinds.md` (`world_made`, `birth`, `death`, `pairing`, `activity_end`, `pregnancy_ended`, `rules_changed`); `data/text/settings.md` (the three levels' lines, labels; kind `TextPatterns`, `checks = ["PRE-40", "PRE-18"]`); `data/tuning/save.md` gains `journal_block_real_s = 10`, `segment_block_events = 4096`, `thin_after_years = 50`.

**Tests:**
- `kd-save` (`PLT-07`, `PLT-10`, `TIM-08`): `log::tests::journal_blocks_hashed`; `log::tests::person_query_fast` (B04's case: one person's two game years from segments in under 5 ms on a cloud core); `log::tests::roll_commits_with_its_save` (a kill between the segment's write and the manifest leaves the old journal and no segment); `log::tests::cut_back_then_remade` (A14.8); `log::tests::thinning_keeps_kept_forever` (a synthetic segment 51 game years old keeps its births, deaths and pairings only); `catchup::tests::kill_after_events_ends_equal` (A14.13: the caught-up world equals the unbroken run); `worlds::tests::three_worlds_reopen_exactly` (`TIM-08`'s Done when, the book of ages joining in α11b).
- `kd-sim` (`PRN-15`): `history::tests::merge_order_independent_of_cluster_order` (clusters run in reverse order give the same log).
- `kd-app` (`PRE-18`): `settings::tests::content_level_leaves_state_hash`.
- `kd kill-test --kills 20` with the log check at every merge; 100 before the stage closes (`PLT-07`'s Done when).
- `kd det first-camp --days 3 --reopen` passes with the log.
- Screens: smoke `two worlds`.

**On the phone:**
1. Touch the screen, tap the `views` button on the time bar, then Worlds: your world is listed with its name, date, people and size.
2. Tap New world: a new island band opens, with its own names in its own language; open Worlds again and tap your first world: it opens exactly where you left it.
3. Open Settings: the content level with a line for each choice, the credits and the version line.
4. Tap someone whose parent or partner has died: the card shows them as died, with the date.

**Not in this alpha:** the book of ages and the last death's entry (α11b); the family tree (α10b); the live-moment setting (α11b) and the volumes (α16b); acts in the catch-up (α16); export and import (α53a); storage warnings and the storage sheet (α19c); the Tests screen (α07d).

**Risks:**
- The journal's flushes costing the phone at top speed: B04 measured 0.07–0.36 ms a block (A14.8), and at top speed that is about 3 blocks a real second; the benchmark records it.
- A catch-up mismatch: it is a determinism break, never hidden, reported by the next benchmark and found with `kd diverge` (α07c).
- Too many worlds on the phone: a first-camp world is under 10 MB, and the list shows sizes; the storage sheet comes in α19c.

### α07c Scenes and the repeat check (about 5.5 hours)

**Goal:** every behaviour built so far is checked the project's way, as sandbox scenes run 20 times from fixed seeds with pass rules locked before they first run; the world runs on four worker threads with the same result as one; every merge proves that a world stopped, saved and resumed on any thread count and any target ends identical; each new version checks itself on the phone once; and a test can run a scene with one mechanism switched off, which play never can.

**Serves:** `RES-21` (part: scenes on the first region, with its own decoys, every choice audited for unknown blueprints and unseen facts), `RES-23` (part: a scene for each everyday behaviour so far), `RES-13` (runs, ranges and the rerun rule), `RES-09` (pass rules stated first and locked), `RES-18` (scenes on play's rules, nothing scripted), `RES-10` (part: switch-off runs, test-only, recorded in their results and worlds, with the first switch), `RES-05` (the repeat check), `RES-12` (part: the never-rules in a ten-year scene), `TIM-16` (part: one and four workers, any split, any target give one result), `PRC-10` (part: scenes and the repeat check in the checks), `PRC-11` (part: the self-check's world parts, once a version), `PRC-12` (part: scenes' IDs in the coverage check), `PRN-01` (part: the audit in every scene run), `PLT-01` (part: the simulation on the four middle cores), `RSK-04` (part), `RSK-27` (part).

**Architecture:** `A2.2` (`Workers`, `Platform::cores`), `A3.3` (switches beside purposes), `A3.9` (switches), `A4.16`, `A8.22`, `A14.1` (switches in a world's identity), `A15.4` (the self-check), `A15.7`, `A15.9`, `A15.12` (steps 5 and 6).

**Needs:** α07b.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-core` (`pool::Workers`, feature `threads`; `switches`, feature `test-switches`), `kd-people` (`purposes.rs`: the first switch; `social/talk.rs`), `kd-save` (`meta.bin`'s switches), `kd-ui` (the test-world line), `kd-data` (kind `Scene`), `kd-sim` (`scene.rs`, the audit hook), `kd-tools` (`kd scene`, `kd det`, `kd diverge`), `kd-app` (`Platform::cores`, `selfcheck.rs`), `kd-android` (pinning to the middle cores), `kd-web` (`kd.sceneHash`), `scenes/`, `scenes/passrules.lock`, `tools/check.sh`, `tools/build-apk.sh`, `tools/build-web.sh`, `tools/filecheck.py`.

**Tasks:**

1. `T07c.1` **Workers on the middle cores (`TIM-16`, `PLT-01`, A2.2, A4.12).**
   `kd_core::pool::Workers` (feature `threads`, `rayon`, A2.2): a pool of n threads whose `run` returns results in job order, the web keeping `Serial`; every `Pool::run` caller so far (weather rows, area builds, save encodings, open's hash checks) runs on it; clusters still run one after another, their parallel run with the owner table coming with the bands in α12.
   `kd-app`: `Platform::cores` (α02b) fills `Cores::sim` (A2.2); `kd-android` finds the four middle cores by `cpuinfo_max_freq`, as B79's `Logic.clustersByFreq` did (`git show <before>:pretests/b78-b79-phone/app/app/src/main/java/dev/kindling/pretests/Logic.kt`), and pins each worker there with `sched_setaffinity` from rayon's start handler (`PLT-01`: the simulation uses at most the four middle cores); `kd` takes `--threads n` (4 by default).
   Commit `T07c.1: Workers on the middle cores (TIM-16, PLT-01, A2.2)`.

2. `T07c.2` **The scene format (`RES-21`, `RES-09`, `RES-18`, A3.9, A15.7).**
   `kd-data` kind `Scene` compiled from `scenes/<alpha>-<name>.toml` with A15.7's keys: `id`, `checks`, `stage`, `runs`, `base_seed`, `until`, `budget_session_hours`, `quick`, `switches` (refused unless `kd` is built with `test-switches`, `RES-10`, `PRN-12`), `[setting]`, `[[measure]]` and `[pass]`; the compiler fails a test scene without `runs`, `until`, a budget or a pass rule (`RES-09`), and any scene naming an ID that does not exist or is Dropped; a scene marked `bench`, `review` or `hash` (`det-cross`, `selfcheck-ten`) is a world to build, measured or hashed, not a test, and needs only its setting, its `checks` and, where it runs, `until`.
   `[setting]` chooses only the start: `land` (`first_region` or a file in `scenes/lands/`), `start` (a date after settling), `bands = [{ people, home = "cave", knowledge = "start" }]` (`home = "camp"` puts a band in the open at the land's centre, for test lands without caves, as α04b's and α05's tests do), `place = [{ item, count, within_m }]`, and per-person adjustments (`[[setting.adjust]]`: `who` such as `"adult:1"` or `"baby:1"`, `age`, `condition`, `forget = ["water"]`, `at`, `mother_dead = true`, which the set-up writes as a death logged before the start); there is no key for an event after the start, so nothing in a scene is scripted (`RES-18`).
   `[[measure]]` reads `state` (at every barrier or at the end) or `log` (α07b's events: `first`, `count`, `median`); `book` joins in α11b; `[pass]` uses A15.7's grammar (`count(cond) >= n`, `all`, `none`, `median(m) in [a, b]`, comparisons, `missing`).
   `kd_sim::scene::build(scene, seed, cat) -> World` makes the world from the compiled setting with play's rules, minds and catalogues, so `kd`, the phone and the web make the same world from one seed (A15.7); scenes marked `bench` or `review` go into the catalogue blob.
   Test scenes are named `scenes/<alpha>-<name>.toml` (P0); the scenes the app and the checks run by name keep short names (`det-cross`, `selfcheck-ten`, and from α07d and α07e `bench-*` and `review-*`), each with its own `checks` (`RES-05`, `PRC-11`, `PLT-04`, `PRE-31`).
   Commit `T07c.2: the scene format and its compiler (RES-21, RES-09, RES-18, A15.7)`.

3. `T07c.3` **The scene runner (`RES-13`, `PRN-01`, A8.22, A15.7).**
   `kd scene run <file> | --quick | --stage MIL-01 [--runs n] [--threads n]`: one run a worker, 4 at a time, run i from `base_seed + i`, every choice audited by A8.15's `audit` (nothing used beyond the person's own records, `PRN-01`); it writes `results/scenes/<id>.json` (each run's seed, measures, pass flags, CPU seconds, switches) and lines such as "everyone drank every day in 20 of 20 runs" (`RES-13`).
   A failing rule reruns on 20 fresh seeds (`base_seed + 20` to `+ 39`) before it fails, applied to all 40 (at least 32 of 40 for 16 of 20); fewer runs scale the rule, rounded against passing, and mark it provisional (`RES-13`).
   `scenes/passrules.lock` holds each pass rule's hash as first merged; `tools/filecheck.py ids --merge` now reads scenes' `checks` and fails a pass rule changed without a `reason = "..."` line in its file, which the reviewer must accept (`RES-09`, A15.7).
   `kd scene list` prints each scene's ID, checks, runs, limit and budget; `kd scene hash <id> [--seed s]` prints one run's final state hash.
   Commit `T07c.3: the scene runner, reruns and locked pass rules (RES-13, RES-09, PRN-01)`.

4. `T07c.4` **The first scenes (`RES-23`, `RES-12`, `RSK-27`).**
   The Rust scenario tests of α04b, α04c, α05, α06b and α06c become scene files with their seeds, game-time limits and pass rules unchanged (a rule moved is not a rule loosened, `RES-09`), each `quick = true` and `stage = "MIL-01"`, and their Rust versions are deleted: `a04b-eats-and-drinks`, `a04b-no-water`, `a04b-no-food`, `a04c-three-reasons`, `a04c-lonely`, `a04c-no-idle-starving`, `a04c-no-flicker`, `a05-cave-night`, `a05-alone-cold`, `a05-mild-year`, `a05-forage-area`, `a06b-spring-news`, `a06b-told-spring`, `a06b-sharers-like`, `a06b-pair-forms`, `a06b-no-raised-together`, `a06b-talk-at-work`, `a06c-births-apart`, `a06c-kin-attend`, `a06c-orphan-nursed`, `a06c-no-milk`, `a06c-toddlers-near`, `a06c-deaths-named`.
   For example, `scenes/a04b-no-water.toml`:
   ```toml
   id = "a04b-no-water"
   checks = ["BIO-09", "BIO-14"]
   stage = "MIL-01"
   quick = true
   runs = 20
   base_seed = 4101
   until = "6d"
   budget_session_hours = 0.05
   [setting]
   land = "barren-dry"                      # scenes/lands/barren-dry.toml (α04b): no water, no plant
   start = "Year 1, summer, day 1, 08:00"
   bands = [{ people = 1, home = "camp", knowledge = "start" }]
   [[measure]]
   name = "death_day"
   first = { from = "log", kind = "death", cause = "thirst" }
   [pass]
   dies_day_3_or_4 = "count(death_day in [3, 4]) >= 20"
   ```
   Two new scenes: `a07c-first-camp-decade` (`RES-12`, `RSK-27`, `PRN-01`; the first band for 10 game years, seeds 7101–7120, budget 0.5 session-hours; pass: in 20 of 20, nobody idle 6 game hours while urgently hungry with known food within 1 km, nobody changing activity over 6 times in a game hour for an hour, no thing gaining mass (A6.13's audit), every death with its cause and how, and no choice failing its audit) and `a07c-sleep-at-night` (`BIO-21`, `MND-07`; 10 game days, seeds 7201–7220; pass: at 02:00 at least 9 in 10 people asleep, and at most 3 people a day asleep between 10:00 and 17:00, in at least 19 of 20).
   Every scene on the first region holds its own look-alikes and bitter foods (lords-and-ladies berries among the blackberries, bitter raw acorns), never a decoy made for the check (`RES-21`); the barren test lands of `a04b-no-water` and `a04b-no-food` hold nothing, as the limits they test need.
   `tools/check.sh` step 5 becomes `cargo run -q --profile fast -p kd-tools --features test-switches --locked -- scene run --quick` (`PRC-10`).
   Commit `T07c.4: the first scenes, moved and new (RES-23, RES-12, RSK-27)`.

5. `T07c.5` **The repeat check and `kd diverge` (`RES-05`, `TIM-16`, A4.16, A15.9).**
   `kd det` grows A15.9's short forms: `kd det repeat` (item 4: the first camp and `a06b-spring-news`'s first seed each run on 1 worker and on 4 with a stop, save and reopen between, ending identical; α07d adds `bench-100`); `kd det split-anywhere` (items 1 and 2: α03c's random splits, with saves and reopenings at random paused seconds, once with every cache dropped); `kd det views` (item 3: snapshots built for two different views and frame lengths varied give one state hash, `WLD-13`, `MND-14`); `kd det cross-target` (item 5: the scene `det-cross`, the first camp for one game day from seed 1, gives one state hash natively, on arm64 under qemu (`cargo run --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu -p kd-tools -- scene hash det-cross`), and as wasm in headless Chromium through `kd.sceneHash("det-cross")` in the smoke test).
   `kd diverge <a> <b>`: replays two runs given as world folders or scene and seed with a different `--threads`, compares each chunk's hash at every barrier, and names the first barrier, chunk kind and column that differ (each store's chunk maps its byte ranges to column names, A15.9).
   `tools/check.sh` step 6 becomes `kd det repeat && kd det cross-target && kd det first-camp --days 3 --reopen`, the repeat check of `PRC-10`; the long forms join the nightly runs when they start (α12).
   Commit `T07c.5: the repeat check across workers and targets, and kd diverge (RES-05, TIM-16, A15.9)`.

6. `T07c.6` **Switches and the first switch-off run (`RES-10`, `RES-18`, A3.3, A3.9, A8.22).**
   `kd_core::switches`: `SwitchId { system: u32, number: u32, name: &'static str }` and `SwitchSet`, the sorted list of switches that are off, saved in the world header (α03a's `switches`) and `meta.bin`; its only constructor with entries, `SwitchSet::with_off(&[SwitchId])`, exists under `kd-core`'s feature `test-switches`, which only `kd-tools` turns on in a build, and other crates' tests through a dev-dependency (α00b's `kd check layers` fails any other), and every build honours a saved set (A3.9).
   Each system declares its switches beside its purposes (A3.3, A8.22) with a `switches!` line; the first is `minds.talk` in `kd-people/src/purposes.rs`, read at α06b's talk: while it is off, no talk group passes a topic; A8.22's `teaching`, `copying`, `experimenting`, `dreams` and `trait.<name>` are declared with their mechanisms in Stage 2, `talk` being the one `MIL-01` mechanism a scene can show depends on.
   A scene's `switches = ["minds.talk"]` (T07c.2) or `kd scene run <file> --switch minds.talk=off` sets it; `results/scenes/<id>.json` and every result line say `switches: minds.talk off`, and such a run never counts as passing in play (`RES-18`); a world with switches opens on the phone and the web as a test world, `Test world: minds.talk off` under the version line (A3.9, `PLT-05`).
   Scene `a07c-spring-news-no-talk` (`RES-10`, `CUL-24`): `a06b-spring-news`'s setting, seeds and limit with `switches = ["minds.talk"]`, `quick = true`; pass: `count(adults_holding_the_spring_at_day_5 <= 2) >= 18` (the finder and at most one who found it alone), so the news's spread is shown to depend on talk.
   **Decision:** `talk` joins A8.22's switch list, since no switched mechanism of A8.22 exists before Stage 2 and `RES-10` is placed here; A8.22 is updated in this branch.
   `tools/check.sh` step 5 builds `kd` with `--features test-switches` (A3.9: only `kd-tools`).
   Commit `T07c.6: switches and the first switch-off run (RES-10, A3.9)`.

7. `T07c.7` **The self-check's world parts (`PRC-11`, `RES-05`, A15.4).**
   `crates/kd-app/src/selfcheck.rs` (α00's) runs only on the first launch of a new `versionCode` (`settings.toml`'s `last_self_check`, α07b) and spends at most 5 s on: the catalogue blob's hash; the scene `selfcheck-ten` (10 people of the first band, one game day from seed 1, in the blob) run on the phone's workers against the state hash baked in at build; a save and reopen in `cacheDir` (`MemStorage` on the web) giving the same state hash; every shader compiled (α00's part); AAudio joins in α16b and the writer's status with the writer.

- `kd-data` (`RES-09`, `RES-18`): `scene::tests::missing_pass_rule_refused` (and a `bench` scene without one accepted); `scene::tests::dropped_id_refused`; `scene::tests::switch_needs_test_build`; `scene::tests::no_key_after_start`.
- `kd-tools` (`RES-13`, `RES-05`): `scene::tests::rerun_applies_to_forty`; `scene::tests::fewer_runs_round_against_passing`; `diverge::tests::names_planted_column` (a planted change to one column at one barrier is named exactly).
- `tools/filecheck.py selftest` gains a scene naming a Dropped ID and a pass rule changed without its reason, each failing.
- Every scene above passes at its threshold with `kd scene run --quick`; `kd det repeat`, `kd det split-anywhere`, `kd det views` and `kd det cross-target` pass.
- `kd-app` (`PRC-11`): `selfcheck::tests::world_parts_report_each_failure`.
- `kd-core` (`RES-10`): `switches::tests::empty_without_test_build` (without the feature, a set can only be empty or read from a save); `kd-sim` (`RES-10`): `switches::tests::reopened_world_reports_its_switch` (A3.9's test: a run with `minds.talk` off, saved and reopened, reports the switch); `kd-tools`: `scene::tests::result_lines_name_switches`.
- Screens: smoke `self-check OK`, `scene hash`.

**On the phone:**
1. Install and open: the first start of this version checks itself for a few seconds; nothing appears if all is well, or a box with a code to copy into your reply.
2. At the valley stop, drag the dial to `3 years a minute`: a game year passes in about 20 seconds, smoothly, the phone now running the world on its four middle cores.
3. Open the note: it lists every scene and its result, such as "everyone drank every day in 20 of 20 runs"; read a few and say if any sounds wrong.

**Not in this alpha:** bench worlds and the benchmark (α07d); the review and the stage report (α07e); whole worlds and the nightly runs (α12, A15.8); scene `[[acts]]` (α16); A8.22's other switches, with their mechanisms (Stage 2), and long switch-off runs at night (A15.6, α12); blueprint trials and `kd scene gen` (α09); parallel clusters (α12).

**Risks:**
- The quick set pushing `tools/check.sh` past 20 minutes: the slowest scenes are made cheaper or split, and none up to 10 game years leaves the merge set (A15.12); the decade scene and `a06c-births-apart` are the two to watch.
- A scene passing only on lucky seeds: the seeds are fixed in each file and the rerun rule applies to 40 (`RES-13`), so a pass cannot be shopped for.
- Pinning failing on some kernels: workers then run unpinned, with the note saying so; results never depend on it.

### α07d The benchmark (about 5 hours)

**Goal:** the cloud measures every alpha on the same bench worlds the phone builds for itself, and the phone measures itself: one tap on a Tests screen runs about 20 minutes of bench worlds, drawing tests and a battery phase, and gives a short result code whose state hashes must equal the cloud's.

**Serves:** `PLT-04` (part: `MIL-01`'s measurements: bench worlds on bench lands, held speed, cost per person by system, frames at each stop in reach, the dense forest, memory, saves and opening, battery and heat), `TIM-07` (part: measured at every alpha, judged in the stage report), `MND-15` (part: µs per person per game day against A8.21), `RES-05` (part: the phone's state hashes against the cloud's), `PLT-01` (part: its Done when's hash comparison), `PLT-05` (part: the cloud benchmark every alpha), `VIS-14` (part: smoothness, opening, battery and heat measured), `PRN-11` (part: frames on time under load), `PRE-40` (part: settings open the Tests screen).

**Architecture:** `A2.5` (`device`), `A4.15`, `A5.6` (bench lands), `A8.21`, `A11.11`, `A12.4` (Tests screen), `A15.10`, `A16.1`, `A16.2`, `A16.3`, `A16.4`, `A16.5`, `A16.6`, `A16.7`.

**Needs:** α07c.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-core` (`probe`), `kd-sim` (marks at every handler, batch and phase), `kd-world` (`lands.rs`: repeated islands, two escarpment lines), `kd-people` (`setup.rs`: one band a cave), `kd-tools` (`kd bench`, a counting allocator), `kd-app` (`bench.rs`, the frame ring), `kd-android` and `android/` (`Device.kt`, `device`), `kd-web` (`?bench=1`), `kd-ui` (`views/tests.rs`), `scenes/bench-*.toml`, `scenes/lands/bench.toml`, `bench/budgets.toml`, `data/tuning/bench.md`, `tools/decode-bench.py`, `tools/check.sh`.

**Tasks:**

1. `T07d.1` **The probe and the cost of each system (`MND-15`, A4.15, A8.21).**
   `kd_core::probe`: `pub trait Probe: Sync { fn begin(&self) -> Mark; fn end(&self, m: Mark, sys: SysId, beings: u32); }` with an opaque `Mark` the simulation hands back unread, so timing never reaches a rule (A4.15); `SysId` names every handler, batch and phase so far, in A8.21's rows: choosing, paths (trips, moves, the cache), talk (told, heard), activity starts and ends, results (gathers, meals), body (re-bases, crossings, warmth), the hourly settle, the wake job, life (conception, births, deaths), barriers and clustering, weather, daily cells, cover, areas (skeletons, contents), things and timers, the history log, the save's copy.
   `NoProbe` in tests; `TimingProbe` in `kd-app` and `kd` with counters per worker (`Platform::now_ns`), costing at most 1%.
   It reports µs per person per game day by system, events a second, spills, pool idle time and the largest cluster's share (A4.15).
   Commit `T07d.1: the probe and cost by system (MND-15, A4.15, A8.21)`.

2. `T07d.2` **Bench lands and bench worlds (`PLT-04`, `WLD-34`, A5.6, A15.10).**
   `scenes/lands/bench.toml` (A5.6's bench lands, in the island's schema): the first region's numbers with `repeat = { islands = n, spacing_cells = 200 }`, each island at its own place and so with its own draws, and `escarpment = { side = "north", height = "30 m", rocks = ["chalk", "sandstone", "granite"], lines = 2, caves = 10, shelters = 0, caves_apart = "10 km" }`; `lands::build` gains `repeat`, `lines` (a second escarpment 12 km south of the centre) and `caves_apart`, whose defaults (1, 1 and 1.5 km) leave the first region's golden hash unchanged.
   `setup.rs`'s `first_band` makes one band of 25 at each cave a setting lists, about 11 km² of land a person on 10 bands an island (A5.6: about 10), camps at least 10 km apart, so no bench crowds an island into one cluster (A15.10).
   Bench scenes (`bench = true`, compiled into the blob, so the phone builds them bit for bit as the cloud does, A15.10): `bench-100` (one island, 4 bands), `bench-500` (2 islands), `bench-1000` (4), `bench-2000` (8), `bench-3000` (12), `bench-7000` (28, phone only), `bench-camp-30` (one band of 30 at the first region's cave), `bench-village-300` (300 people of 12 bands within 300 m of one cave mouth, standing in for A15.10's village until villages exist), `bench-forest` (the camp stop over the first region's densest woods); each from a fixed seed at Year 1, spring, day 1.
   Commit `T07d.2: bench lands and bench worlds (PLT-04, WLD-34, A5.6)`.

3. `T07d.3` **The cloud benchmark (`PLT-04`, `PLT-05`, `TIM-07`, A15.10, A16).**
   `kd bench [--quick]`: for `bench-100`, `-500`, `-1000`, `-2000`, `-3000`, `bench-camp-30` and `bench-village-300`: build and open (timed), warm up 10 game days, then 60 real seconds at top speed on 4 workers; writes `bench/cloud/<version>.json` with game years a real minute, µs per person per game day by system, `PLT-04`'s shares (the world's own layers a game day; making areas against the simulation), batch costs, memory per layer (`heap_bytes` against a counting global allocator in `kd`, a gap over 10% flagged, A16.4), a save's pause, bytes and time, open time and size, and the state hashes after 1, 5 and 10 game days.
   `bench/budgets.toml` holds A16's numbers (A16.1): `MIL-01`'s stage budget of at least 3 game years a real minute at 1,000 people (`PLT-04`, set by the owner on 2 October 2026; A16.3's model expects about 3.4), A8.21's µs per system, A16.2's frame numbers, A16.4's memory lines and A16.5's first-camp saves; `kd bench` flags anything over budget or 10% slower than the last alpha's file, converting cloud figures to the phone by 1.5 until the first phone benchmark (A16.1).
   It takes at most 10 minutes (A16.7); `tools/check.sh` step 9 runs `kd bench --quick` (two worlds, 10 s each) at a delivery, and P0's delivery runs the full one.
   Commit `T07d.3: the cloud benchmark and budgets (PLT-04, PLT-05, A15.10, A16)`.

4. `T07d.4` **The phone's counters (`PLT-04`, `VIS-14`, A2.5, A16.4, A16.6).**
   `android/app/src/main/java/dev/kindling/app/Device.kt`, started from B79's `Probe.kt` (`git show <before>:pretests/b78-b79-phone/app/app/src/main/java/dev/kindling/pretests/Probe.kt`, A2.9): battery level, charging, current (`BATTERY_PROPERTY_CURRENT_NOW`, µA) and voltage (`EXTRA_VOLTAGE`, mV), battery temperature, thermal status by listener and `getThermalHeadroom(10)` once a second, and the process's PSS (`Debug.getPss()`); it calls `Native.device(h, charging, battery, thermalStatus, headroom, batteryC, currentUa, voltageMv, pssKb)` once a second and on change.
   **Decision:** A2.5's `device` gains `currentUa`, `voltageMv` and `pssKb`, because A15.10's steady phase and A16.4's comparison need them, as B79 read them; A2.5 is updated in this branch.
   Commit `T07d.4: battery, heat and memory counters from Device.kt (PLT-04, A2.5; from pretests/b78-b79-phone)`.

5. `T07d.5` **The Tests screen and the phone benchmark (`PLT-04`, `RES-05`, `TIM-07`, `PRE-40`, A11.11, A12.4, A15.10).**
   `crates/kd-ui/src/views/tests.rs` (A12.4), opened by a long press on Settings' version line (α07b): `Benchmark`, `Frame times` (the last 1,024 frames' CPU time and GPU time per pass, A11.11), `Diagnostics` (panics, exit reasons and catch-up mismatches, α07b) and `Review` (α07e).
   `crates/kd-app/src/bench.rs`, the phone benchmark (A15.10), about 20 minutes, first asking for the phone to be unplugged and left alone: a 3-minute warm-up at full load; for each bench world in the blob (the cloud's seven and `bench-7000`): its open time, 90 s at the world view at top speed (game years a real minute, µs per person per game day by system, worker load), a save, and its state hashes after 1, 5 and 10 game days; drawing (A11.11): each stop in reach (person, close camp, camp and valley) for 10 s while turning, `bench-village-300` at close camp, `bench-forest` at the camp stop turning, a pan along the cliff at the camp stop (also timing how long newly seen ground stays coarse before its area arrives, A11.5), each with its worst frame, late frames (over 1.5 refresh periods) and GPU time per pass; a 5-minute steady phase at the valley stop at top speed for battery (current × voltage) and heat (battery temperature, thermal status, headroom, B79); and the diagnostics; a phase stops early at thermal status "severe" and says so (A16.6).
   Result code (A15.10): compact JSON, gzipped, base64, prefixed `KDB1:`, at most 15.5 KB, shown with Copy in α00's code dialog (`Request::BenchResult { json }`, gzipped by Kotlin, and by `CompressionStream` on the web, as `KDS1:` is); a larger result keeps its summary within the limit, the "Share results file" button coming with `Files.kt` in α53a.
   `tools/decode-bench.py` gains `KDB1:`: it writes `bench/phone/<version>.json`, compares its state hashes with `bench/cloud/<version>.json`'s for the same worlds and spans, and prints `Hashes: EQUAL` or the first difference (A15.9 item 6: a difference blocks the stage until found).
   The web build runs the same code path at `?bench=1` with 2-second phases, for the smoke test only (speeds under SwiftShader mean nothing).
   Commit `T07d.5: the Tests screen and the phone benchmark with its KDB1 code (PLT-04, RES-05, A15.10)`.

6. `T07d.6` **Deliver (`PRC-11`).**
   `kd det repeat` adds `bench-100` (A15.9 item 4's bench world); `versionCode=1074`, `versionName=a07d`; `bench/cloud/a07d.json` is the first full cloud benchmark, and the note gives its game years a minute at 1,000 people against the stage budget of 3, with the three costliest systems; then P0's steps 5 to 8.

- `kd-world` (`WLD-34`): `lands::tests::first_region_unchanged` (the golden hash holds with the new defaults); `lands::tests::bench_islands_differ`; `lands::tests::bench_caves_ten_km_apart`.
- `kd-tools` (`PLT-04`): `bench::tests::json_has_every_field` (A15.10's list); `bench::tests::flags_ten_percent_slower`; `bench::tests::counting_allocator_matches_heap_bytes` (within 10% on the first camp).

**On the phone:**
1. Open Settings and long-press the version line: the Tests screen opens.
2. Tap Frame times, go back to the world and turn the camera at the camp stop for a few seconds, then look again: most frames sit under the line.
3. If you have 20 minutes now (it is asked for again at the stage close, α07e): unplug, tap Benchmark and leave the phone alone; at the end tap Copy and paste the `KDB1:` code in your reply.

**Not in this alpha:** the Review button, the contact sheet, the crawl fixes and the stage report (α07e); the map and globe stops and the pinch from the globe (α19b); generated bench worlds and the world with nobody in it (α27b); old worlds against new ones (`TIM-07`, α43b); "Share results file" (α53a).

**Risks:**
- The phone below the stage budget of 3 game years a minute at 1,000 people: the report names the costliest systems from the probe and the stage wins the time back by the next stage close or brings it to the owner (`PLT-04`, A16.1), never by a cheaper mind (A8.21).
- Phone and cloud hashes differing: the stage stays open until `kd diverge` finds the cause (A15.9 item 6, A17.6).
- Ten bands an island too many for the island's food: the bench measures cost, not survival; the code reports the people alive at each span, and the island's yields stay those tuned in α05.

**Data:** `scenes/review-camp.toml`, `scenes/review-winter.toml`, `scenes/review-model-sheet.toml`; `data/tuning/render.md` (`crawl_fix`); `reports/risks.toml`; `reports/principles.toml`.

**On the phone:**
1. Unplug the phone, open Settings, long-press the version line, tap Benchmark and leave the phone alone for about 20 minutes; then tap Copy and paste the `KDB1:` code in your reply.
2. Tap Review: scroll the sheet (each zoom stop at noon and dusk, the model sheet, three clips), then watch the crawl row and reply with the number of the clip that looks steadiest and nicest.
3. Play for about ten minutes, ending on what Stage 1 makes possible (`SCP-16`): follow a family at the cliff camp through a day and a night, then drag the dial to about `3 years a minute` for a minute and back: the seasons turn in the plants, a newborn is nursed at the cave, and someone has grown old or died (tap them: when and why); open cards and the mind view.

**Not in this alpha:** the 7- or 9-pixel font choice (Stage 2's contact sheet, A12.1); sound in the review (α17's reel, `SND-12`); the writer's trap check (α35a); whole-world confirmation of Stage 1's results (the island nightly from α12, generated worlds from α27b, `RES-21`).

**Risks:**
- The owner's reply taking days: α08 starts meanwhile, and the stage closes when the review is recorded (`RES-22`).
- No crawl fix pleasing the owner: `Base` stays, the report says so, and the slot keeps the choice open for later reviews (A11.10).
- Phone and cloud hashes differing: the stage stays open until `kd diverge` finds the cause; settling for matching ranges needs the owner's OK (A15.9, A17.6).

### Stage 1 notes

- Splits: α00 → α00 (skeleton on the phone) and α00b (the full merge checks and the release key); α01 → α01a, α01b; α02, α03, α04 → a to d; α06 → α06a and α06c around the brief's α06b; α07 → α07a (saving), α07b (history, worlds, settings), α07c (scenes, repeat check, switches), α07d (benchmark), α07e (stage review); 25 alphas, 3–5.5 hours each, about 125 hours (α00's honest size adds 3, the switches half an hour; the region stop's cut saves half an hour).
- Cut as over-reach: the region stop's world-cell tiles (A11.5 and P4's T19b.2 build them at `MIL-04`): Stage 1 zooms from one person to the valley stop, and the speed table's region row waits for α19b with its stop; `kd bench chance` (B02 measured it; the benchmark starts in α07d).
- Names: the package is `dev.kindling.app` (A2.5, A15.3); `versionCode = stage × 1000 + alpha × 10 + split`, split `a` 1 to `e` 5 (α00 1000, α00b 1002, α08 2080, α09b 2092, α12b 2122), A15.3 updated in α00.
- The `MIL-01` stage budget is 3 game years a real minute at 1,000 people (`PLT-04`, A16.3, the owner's decision); A4.15's old sentence ("8, 6, 5, 3, 2, 1.5 and 1") has since been corrected in the frozen architecture to A16.3's 3, 2, 2, 1.7, 1.7, 1.5 and 1.
- The frozen A8.7, A8.10, A8.18 and A12.4 already hold the settled numbers for fertility, ageing, birth bleeding, chat, pairing, the needs' daily rates and the minimal mind view, so P1 follows them with no decision; the one remaining decision is kin weights in `MIL-01` (A8.23 lists them at `MIL-02`; sharing needs them, α06b).
- Built a stage early: A14's journal, segments and crash catch-up come in α07b (A14 puts them at `MIL-02`), since no Stage 2 alpha builds them, P2's α11b reads α07b's event-kind table and P3's α16 extends the catch-up with acts.
- Architecture updates made in Stage 1 branches: `serde_json` and `toml` for `kd-tools` (A2.2, α00b); the version code (A15.3, α00); `smallvec` (A2.2, α03b); `Platform::cores` and `pin` for the view builders (A2.2, α02b); `device` gains three fields (A2.5, α07d); the journal's file name (A14.2, α07b); the switch `talk` (A8.22, α07c); `data/palette.md` as the folder `data/palette/` (A11.3, α01a); A15.12's `kd check file` and `kd check ids` as `tools/filecheck.py file` and `ids` (A15.12 steps 7 and 8, A15.13 step 7, α00 and α00b); catalogue ids unique within their kind, as `data/ids.lock` numbers them (A3.6, α01a).
- Catalogue ids later parts must not re-add: the mockup's ladders `bone`, `hair`, `hair_brown`, `hair_white` (α01a); α03b's `hair_dark`, `hair_auburn`, `hair_fair`, `hair_grey`; the test lands `scenes/lands/barren-dry.toml`, `barren-river.toml` (α04b) and `cold-test.toml` (α05); the biome `barren` (α02a).
## Stage 2: Sharp stone (MIL-02)

This stage brings things and blueprints, and the parts of minds that discovery and teaching need, so a band can find that struck flint gives a sharp edge and the skill can spread or be lost; it also brings wounds and plain care, the book of ages, the story director, the start's 3–4 bands and the first region's animals (`SCP-16`).
Four of the brief's alphas hold well over 5 hours each, so α10 splits into α10a and α10b, α11 into α11a and α11b, the animals into α12b (herds and wolves) and α12c (danger, scavenging and small game), and wounds and plain care move from α12 into a new α09b, right after the blueprints whose hurts need them; a new α12d closes the stage with its review (`RES-06`), as α07e closes Stage 1.
The frozen architecture already places all of this in `MIL-02` (A4.17, A7.6–A7.10, A8.23, A10.10, A11.8, A12.4), save one piece: A12.5 lists ages at `MIL-06`, and the first flake is a step of the arc (`PRE-39`), so α11b begins its age; faces, which A11.8 also lists here, are α28's.
Built in Stage 1 and grown here, never rebuilt: items, states, things, carrying, rotting and the bucket index (α04a's `kd_core::kinds::Chars`, `kd-things/src/carry.rs` with `CarrySlot::HandR` and `HandL`, `things.rs`, `bucket.rs`, `timers.rs`); deposits, boulders and stone patches (α02a, α02c, α02d); kinds known, starting links, `InReach`, the score and habits (α04c); relations, talk, sharing, kin weights in `K` and the `Shared` record (α06b); `Wound`, blood and `Death` (α06c); saving, migrations, the history log and its event-kind table (α07a, α07b); scenes, switches and the repeat check (α07c); the benchmark and the Tests screen (α07d); the findable-records map (α04d).
Every alpha adds its new kinds of record to `kd_sim::World::record_kinds()` and a line for each to α04d's `FINDABLE` naming the card or view that shows it (`PRE-13`), and every alpha that changes a chunk's schema adds its migration and a fixture world in `tests/fixtures/worlds/` (A14.9, `RSK-21`); α08, α10b and α12b change area contents or the kinds of materials, plants and animals, so each raises `data/VERSION.toml`'s `major` and `generator` with `tests/golden/generator.toml`, and older worlds then open read-only, as their notes say (`PLT-09`).
Every alpha delivers as P0 says, with its APK, and adds a demo world for its phone steps: one run of a scene marked `demo`, compiled into the blob, which the phone builds for itself with the Tests screen's Make test world (α08, A15.4) and lists under Worlds as a test world.
Scenes run on the first region (`WLD-34`, A5.6), 20 runs each with run `i` on seed `base_seed + i` (`RES-13`), with `stage = "MIL-02"`, `quick = true` up to 10 game days, and audit that no choice used an unknown blueprint or an unseen fact (A15.7); the `[setting]` keys each alpha adds still choose only the start (`RES-18`); budgets are in session-hours.

### α08 Things (about 5 hours)

**Goal:** stones, bones, wood, meat and hides become things with their 18 characteristics, which people pick up, carry, put down, drop and float, each drawn from the model kit and opening a thing card; and from now on the phone builds each alpha's demo world itself.

**Serves:** `MAT-01` (part: stone, bone, wood, flesh and hide), `MAT-02` (part: flake, strand and paste drawn), `MAT-03` (part: seen and learned values), `MAT-05`, `MAT-10` (part: 24 items and 3 carcasses), `MAT-13` (part), `MAT-16` (part: the stage subset), `MAT-17` (part: complete and the reality rules on items), `MAT-11` (part: carrying, falling, floating), `RCK-01` (part: the scan), `RCK-21`, `WLD-14` (part: the island's loose stones as things), `PRE-46` (part: the flake, strand and paste shapes and the first layouts), `PRE-42` (part: wear and quality on the model), `PRE-35` (part: the thing card), `PRE-13` (part: things findable), `MND-04` (part: seen and learned values on the card), `MND-09` (part: the curiosity worth of a thing of no known use), `PLT-05` (part: test worlds made on the phone), `PLT-09` (part: a big update, marked).

**Architecture:** `A3.6`, `A6.2`, `A6.3`, `A6.4`, `A6.5`, `A6.6`, `A6.14`, `A6.15`, `A7.2`, `A5.3`, `A5.4`, `A11.7`, `A11.8`, `A11.9`, `A12.4`, `A14.9`, `A15.4`, `A15.7`.

**Needs:** α07e (Stage 1 done).

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-core` (`src/kinds.rs`: `Char`), `kd-data` (α04a's kind `Item` in `src/schema/`, kind `Scene`'s `demo` and `place` keys, `src/compile/`), `kd-things` (`src/items.rs`, `src/carry.rs`, `src/physics.rs` new, `src/purposes.rs`, `src/checks/complete.rs`, `src/checks/reality.rs` new), `kd-world` (`src/area/contents.rs`, `src/area/picture.rs`), `kd-people` (`src/choose/worth.rs`), `kd-sim` (pick up and put down, `World::record_kinds`, `src/scene.rs`), `kd-view` (`ThingView`), `kd-render` (`src/models/layouts.rs` new, `src/icons.rs` new, `src/figures/`, `src/rocks.rs`, the ground shader's stone stamps), `kd-ui` (`src/views/thing_card.rs` new, `src/views/tests.rs`, `src/findable.rs`), `kd-app` (`src/demo.rs` new), `kd-tools` (`kd catalog check --stage`, `kd scene demo`), `data/items/` (`stone.md`, `bone.md`, `flesh.md`, `hide.md`, `wood.md`, `plant.md`, `carcasses.md`), `data/world/deposits.md`, `data/world/rocks.md`, `data/plants/`, `data/models/shapes.md`, `data/models/layouts.md` new, `data/tuning/things.md`, `data/VERSION.toml`, `tests/golden/generator.toml`, `tests/fixtures/worlds/`, `scenes/`.

**Tasks:**
1. `T08.1` **The full item schema (`MAT-10`, `MAT-03`, A6.2, A6.3).** α04a's kind `Item` (`kd-data/src/schema/`) gains the A6.2 fields it lacks, still with `deny_unknown_fields`: `[made] parts` (up to 4 `{ role, slot }`), `cover`, `capacity`, `burning`, `[[yields]] { item, share, per = "kg" | "piece", season }` (a carcass's parts, read by α09's butchering) and per-item `[states.<state>]` overrides of a state's shifts (A6.3); α04a's `class`, `form`, `size`, the 18 values, `main`, `[[timers]]`, `[breaks] into`, `mild_taste`, `[look] colour`, `fits` and `tags` stay as they are.
   `kd_core::kinds` gains `pub enum Char`, the 18 in `MAT-03`'s order, and α04a's `Chars(u64)` gains `get(c: Char) -> u8` and `with(c: Char, v: u8) -> Chars` (3 bits each, by shift and mask, A6.2) where it lacks them.
   `kd_things::items::piece_mass_kg(kind, size_mm) -> f32` = density × shape × size³, with A6.2's densities 100, 500, 1,000, 2,000, 2,700 and 9,000 kg/m³ for weight 0–5 and its shape factors (lump 0.5, flake 0.03, blade and point 0.01, rod 0.0015, pole 0.0005, sheet 0.003, strand 0.0002); powders, pastes and liquids count grams.
   `kd catalog tables` writes each item's table with "Seen" (hardness, edge, flexibility, weight, water, fibre, stickiness, plasticity, pigment) and "Learned by use" (the rest), zeros left out (A3.6, `MAT-03`).
2. `T08.2` **Stage subsets (`MAT-16`, A6.14).** `kd catalog check --stage MIL-02` checks only entries whose `stage` is `MIL-02` or earlier, and fails when one of them names an entry of a later stage; the plain `kd catalog check` checks everything.
   `Catalogue::stage_of(kind)` is kept in the blob; `tools/check.sh` runs both forms (A15.12 step 4).
3. `T08.3` **The 24 items and 3 carcasses (`MAT-10`, `MAT-05`, A6.15).** Write the entries listed under Data in hour-sized batches (A6.15), each with `stage = "MIL-02"`, `checks`, all 18 values, `main`, `[look] colour`, and `fits` left empty until α09; values not named below are 0; no `MIL-01` entry is rewritten (`MAT-16`).
   - `data/items/stone.md`: `flint_nodule` (lump, 8–30 cm; A3.6's block as written: hardness 5, edge 1, toughness 2, flaking 5, weight 4, waterproof 5; main flaking; breaks into `flint_chunks`; tags `flaking_stone`); `flint_cobble` (lump, 6–15 cm, rounded river gravel: hardness 5, toughness 2, flaking 5, weight 4, waterproof 5; main flaking; breaks into `flint_chunks`; `flaking_stone`); `flint_chunks` (lump, 3–10 cm: hardness 5, edge 2, toughness 2, flaking 5, weight 4, waterproof 5; main flaking; `flaking_stone`); `chert_nodule` (lump, 8–25 cm, colour within one ladder step of flint: hardness 5, edge 1, toughness 3, flaking 4, weight 4, waterproof 5; main flaking; `flaking_stone`; placed only by scenes until α18c's deposits); `quartzite_cobble` (lump, 6–20 cm, grey-brown close to flint: hardness 5, toughness 5, flaking 2, weight 4, waterproof 5; main toughness; scenes only until α18c); `granite_cobble` (lump, 6–40 cm: hardness 4, toughness 4, weight 4, waterproof 4; main toughness); `granite_boulder` (lump, 30–80 cm, never carried, an anvil: hardness 4, toughness 5, weight 4, waterproof 4; main toughness); `sandstone_cobble` (lump, 6–30 cm: hardness 3, toughness 2, weight 4, waterproof 1; main hardness); `chalk_lump` (lump, 5–20 cm: hardness 1, toughness 1, weight 3, pigment 1; main hardness); `stone_chips` (flake, 0.5–2 cm, a heap counted in grams: hardness 5, edge 2, toughness 1, flaking 3, weight 4; main edge; `flaking_stone`); and the made `sharp_flake` (flake, 3–8 cm), `chopper` (lump, 8–15 cm) and `scraper` (flake, 3–7 cm), whose values come from α09's blueprints (`[made] parts = [{ role = "core", slot = 0 }]`, main edge; breaks into `stone_chips`).
   - `data/items/bone.md`: `long_bone` (rod, 15–40 cm: hardness 3, toughness 3, weight 3; main toughness; tags `marrow_bone`; breaks into `bone_splinters`); `bone_splinters` (flake, 2–8 cm: hardness 3, edge 2, toughness 1, weight 3; main edge); `antler_tine` (rod, 10–30 cm: hardness 3, toughness 4, flexibility 1, weight 3; main toughness).
   - `data/items/flesh.md`: `raw_meat` (lump, a heap in grams: toughness 1, weight 2, food 3, water 3; main toughness; a rotting timer like α04a's foods, about 3 game days in summer and 2 weeks near freezing, stopped when frozen, `MAT-19`); `animal_fat` (paste: weight 2, burn 3, fuel 3, food 5, stickiness 1; main stickiness; rotting about 10 days).
   - `data/items/hide.md`: `fresh_hide` (sheet, 0.3–2.5 m: toughness 3, flexibility 4, weight 2, water 3, warmth 2, fibre 1, waterproof 2; main toughness; rotting about 3 days in summer); `sinew` (strand, 10–40 cm: toughness 4, flexibility 4, weight 2, fibre 4; main fibre; rotting as `fresh_hide`).
   - `data/items/wood.md`: `dead_stick` (rod, 0.3–1.5 m, a stand's dead wood, A5.3: hardness 2, toughness 2, flexibility 1, weight 1, burn 4, fuel 2; main toughness); the made `pointed_stick` (rod, its main input's length: main edge, values from α09).
   - `data/items/plant.md`: `leaf_litter` (sheet, a heap in kg: burn 4, fuel 1, warmth 1; main warmth); the made `leaf_bed` (structure, about 2 × 0.8 m: main warmth, values from α09); α05's `grass_bedding` is the grass, so none is added.
   - `data/items/carcasses.md`: `deer_carcass` (flesh, lump, 60–190 kg), `boar_carcass` (flesh, lump, 40–150 kg), `hare_carcass` (flesh, lump, 2.5–4.5 kg): toughness 2, weight 2, food 2, water 3; main toughness; tags `carcass`; rotting as `raw_meat`; `[[yields]]` by kilogram of carcass: deer `raw_meat` 0.42, `animal_fat` 0.04, `long_bone` 8 pieces, `fresh_hide` 1 piece, `sinew` 0.01, `antler_tine` 0–6 pieces from a stag in autumn and winter; boar `raw_meat` 0.40, `animal_fat` 0.12, `long_bone` 8 pieces, `fresh_hide` 1 piece, `sinew` 0.01; hare `raw_meat` 0.5, `long_bone` 4 pieces, `fresh_hide` 1 piece.
   The carcasses stay outside `MAT-10`'s count (A7.6); until α12b's species name them as their carcasses, only scenes place them.
   The land's yields of the new raw plant and wood items join α02d's species (A7.2, with `scaled_from`, A5.13): `oak`, `birch`, `scots_pine`, `crab_apple` and `hazel` yield `dead_stick` all year (Earth about 2 kg a tree a year) and the four broadleaves `leaf_litter` in autumn (about 3 kg a tree); `meadow_grass` yields α05's `grass_bedding` as stems from summer to autumn (about 200 g/m²).
4. `T08.4` **Loose stones become things (`WLD-14`, A5.3, A5.4).** α02a's `data/world/deposits.md` entries name the items they yield: `flint_in_chalk` gives `flint_nodule` (its richness as the bed sets it); `river_gravel` gives `flint_cobble` (its share falling downstream as α02a set), `granite_cobble` and `sandstone_cobble`.
   α02a's `data/world/rocks.md` gains each rock's `loose` item for its exposures, banks and scree (chalk `chalk_lump`, granite `granite_cobble`, sandstone `sandstone_cobble`) and its `boulder` item (granite `granite_boulder`; chalk and sandstone blocks stay drawn only, too soft to be anvils).
   In `crates/kd-world/src/area/contents.rs`, α02d's stone patches take up to 2 kinds by keyed weight from the loose items and deposits showing there, with a count of 0–12 pieces (richness × 2.4, keyed on the patch's place uid), each piece's size drawn in its item's range when it is taken.
   α02c's keyed boulders on gravel bars and in river beds move from `area/picture.rs` into these seed contents (A5.3 step 4, written into the architecture in this branch), so rules read them exactly where the picture draws them, as `granite_boulder` pieces that are never taken; `kd-render/src/rocks.rs` reads them from there.
   Taking a piece (gather) makes a thing whose quality comes from the patch uid and piece index, a keyed 0–5 centred on 2.5, the same whoever takes it (A6.6); the kept area records the taken count as a Taken mark that never fades for stone (A5.4).
   α02d's `stampStone` draws each patch's pieces in their item's colour ladder.
   This changes every area's contents, so `data/VERSION.toml` takes `major = 2` and `generator = 4`, and `tests/golden/generator.toml` its new hashes (A14.9).
5. `T08.5` **Picking up, carrying, putting down, dropping and floating (`MAT-11`, `RCK-21`, A6.5).** In α04a's `crates/kd-things/src/carry.rs`, gather picks up a piece and stack puts one down (plain uses, A6.9); α04a's `CarrySlot::HandR` and `HandL` take a piece over 1.5 kg in both hands, up to a quarter of the carrier's body mass (`BIO-21`), and the handful rule for small pieces is unchanged until containers come (α23c); `load_kg(being)` keeps feeding the walking speed.
   Putting down at camp merges like things into a heap (kind, material, states, quality, owner) within 0.5 m (α04a's `put`, A6.4).
   `crates/kd-things/src/physics.rs` (new):
   - Dropping: a held thing falls from hand height (1.0 m for an adult, 0.6 m for a child) when its holder's activity is cut by a blow, a fall, death or a flight (A4.4); `fn fall(thing, height_m)` breaks it at chance 0 below its safe height, rising evenly to 0.9 at twice it, safe heights 0.2, 0.5, 1.5, 4 and 10 m for toughness 0–4 and never for toughness 5, stone or metal (`things.fall_break`, system 8, polarity `None`); a broken thing becomes its `breaks.into`.
   - Floating (`RCK-21`): a thing put or dropped into the river with weight 0–1 drifts downstream a keyed 50 m to 2 km as one leg with one event (`things.drift`), weight 2 half that, weight 3–5 sinks where it fell.
   In α04c's `crates/kd-people/src/choose/worth.rs`, a kind never handled is worth only the curiosity of trying it: curiosity relief 8 × (1 − the share of buckets within 30 m holding it), so a curious person sometimes picks up a new kind of stone, takes in its seen values (`MND-04`) and puts it down at camp.
6. `T08.6` **Shapes, layouts and icons (`PRE-46`, `PRE-42`, A11.7).** `data/models/shapes.md` (α04a's `lump`, `sheet`, `rod`, `powder`; α02c's `boulder`, `block`) gains the shared shapes `flake` (the mockup's `flakes`), `strand` (a curled one-voxel `line`) and `paste` (a flat smear), so every raw item of this stage draws from its form's shape in its own colours.
   `data/models/layouts.md` (new) holds the first layouts, so α09's results draw at once: `sharp_flake` (`custom = "flake_outline"`: a thin flake with a bulb), `chopper` (a lump with `custom = "worked_edge"`, chips taken off one side), `scraper` (`flake_outline` with a rounded, stepped edge), `pointed_stick` (`line`, tapering over its last tenth), `leaf_bed` (`heap` of its strands or sheets, 2 × 0.8 m); each made part takes its input's material ladder; `crates/kd-render/src/models/layouts.rs` builds them.
   Wear removes edge voxels by a seeded pattern, and quality 0–1 makes jitter uneven, 4–5 even (A11.7 step 3).
   `crates/kd-render/src/icons.rs`: the CPU voxel splatter (A11.7's decision) draws each model's top and front faces at a fixed three-quarter view into 16 × 16 palette indices, outlined, cached by model key; the card and later the book use it.
   Held things hang on the lower arm (`attach`, A11.8), drawn from their own model.
7. `T08.7` **The thing card (`PRE-35`, `PRE-13`, `MND-04`, A12.4).** `crates/kd-ui/src/views/thing_card.rs`, from `Query::Card(Target::Thing)`: icon and English name; class, form, size and weight ("stone · lump · 14 cm · 2.6 kg"); materials of its parts; "Seen" values; "Learned by use" values, each marked "known to" its band when any member of its owner's band (or, unowned, the nearest band) has learned it in kinds known (A8.13), else "not known to them"; wear in words (new, worn, much worn, nearly broken), quality in words (poor, rough, fair, good, fine, excellent for 0–5); owner, and where and when it was taken.
   `ThingView` (A11.9) carries `wear`, `quality` and `parts`; the card works in portrait and landscape (`PRE-34`).
   α04d's `FINDABLE` line for things on the ground and in hands now names the thing card, and `World::record_kinds()` gains `things.taken_stones` (the Taken marks of stone patches, shown on the place card's ground line).
8. `T08.8` **Catalogue checks on items (`MAT-17`, `RCK-01`, `RCK-21`, A6.14 items 1 and 7).** Complete covers every new field (raw items: 18 values, size, class, look; made items: form, parts, breaks and model).
   Reality rules as scans in `crates/kd-things/src/checks/reality.rs`: `RCK-01`, only items tagged `flaking_stone` reach flaking 3 or more in any state they can take; `RCK-21`, every wood, bark, reed and charcoal item has weight 0–1 and every stone, earth and metal item 3 or more.
   Each rule has a planted-fault fixture in `crates/kd-things/tests/data/` (a granite with flaking 3; a stick with weight 2) that must fail (`MAT-17`).
9. `T08.9` **Demo worlds made on the phone (`PLT-05`, `RES-18`, A15.4, A15.7).** A scene may carry `demo = { name = "a08 · Gravel bar", run = 1, at = "day 2, 10:00" }`: `kd scene run` keeps that run's state hash every game day up to that time in its result, demo scenes are compiled into the catalogue blob as bench and review scenes are (α07c), and `kd scene demo <id>` prints the run's `KDW1:` code (A15.4: seed, versions, compiled setting, switches, end time and the hashes expected on the way).
   The Tests screen (α07d's `crates/kd-ui/src/views/tests.rs`) gains `Make test world`: this version's demo scenes by name, and a field to paste a `KDW1:` code.
   `crates/kd-app/src/demo.rs` builds the world from the compiled setting and seed (`kd_sim::scene::build`, α07c), runs it at top speed to its time, checks every expected hash (a mismatch stops it and shows a code to send, as the self-check does), saves it as a test world under the scene's name (`meta.bin`'s test mark, α07c), and lists it under Worlds; a Stage 2 demo takes at most about two minutes of the phone, and runs longer than that wait for overnight mode's safeguards (α43a).
   A demo world never counts as play (`RES-18`); from now on every alpha's phone steps start from one.
10. `T08.10` **Scenes, the demo world and delivery (`MAT-11`, `WLD-14`, `PRC-11`).** Scene settings gain `place = [{ item, count, at }]`, `at` naming a spot of the land that the scene compiler finds from the band's home (`camp`, `ford`, `gravel_bar`, `river`) beside α07c's `within_m`, and `in_water = true` for things set in the river.
    Write and run the scenes under Tests; `a08-gravel-bar` is the demo.
    The note says that worlds of earlier alphas now open read-only (`major = 2`, `PLT-09`); fixture `tests/fixtures/worlds/a08.kindling` (A14.9).
    Goldens `thing-card-flint` and `gravel-bar` (close camp at the gravel bar at 10:00 on summer day 2); `versionCode=2080`, `versionName=a08`; `bench/cloud/a08.json` adds a pick-up, a drop and a drift (A6.16: at most 1 µs each) and the catalogue's load time (under 10 ms); then P0's steps 5 to 8.
