**On the phone:**
1. Open the alpha link; in Settings long-press the version line, tap Make test world and pick `a08 · Gravel bar` (a few seconds), then open it from Worlds.
2. Pinch in to close camp at the gravel bar: dark flint, speckled pale granite and buff sandstone cobbles lie among the gravel, each in its own colours, and a granite boulder stands among them.
3. Tap a flint cobble: the card reads "Flint cobble · stone · lump", with its size and weight, "Seen: hardness 5, weight 4" and "Learned by use: flaking 5, toughness 2, waterproof 5", each marked "not known to them".
4. Set the dial to about an hour a minute and watch the bar for a minute or two: a curious person picks up a stone, carries it and puts it down at the cave; tap it: its owner and the day it was taken.
5. Follow the river down from the ford: the sticks set in the water lie stranded on a bank downstream, while the flint cobbles set beside them have not moved.

**Not in this alpha:** blueprints, the states crushed and cut, and the values of made things (α09); a back to carry on (α23); containers (α23c, α41); throwing (α12c); trap and spear physics (α23); toppling (α20b); the people's own words for things (α11a); sounds of things (α16b); deposits of chert and quartzite in the land (α18c).

**Risks:** characteristic values out of real order (`MAT-05`): the reviewer agent checks every new entry against a checklist (A6.15) and the reality scans run on every state; curious pick-ups cluttering the camp with stones: the curiosity worth falls with how plentiful a kind is and once a kind has been handled, tuned on the tuning seeds (`RES-16`); the icon splatter looking muddy at 16 × 16: compare with the stored icons and fall back to render-to-texture (A11.7); a demo world's hash differing on the phone: it is a determinism break, never shrugged off, found with `kd diverge` (A15.9).

### α09 Blueprints (about 5.5 hours)

**Goal:** people who know a blueprint choose it and do it with the things in reach, matched on what they believe about them, each strike or cut landing as it ends with its results, failures, wear and quality, and every base action has its own movement.

**Serves:** `MAT-04` (part: known blueprints; unknown ones in α11a), `MAT-06`, `MAT-07` (part: two routes to a pointed stick), `MAT-09`, `MAT-14`, `MAT-17` (part: reachable, discoverable, possible, expected fits, mass, `RCK-01`), `MAT-20`, `MAT-22` (part: the flake and butchering chains; the scraper's use comes with hides, α25a), `MAT-23` (part: the five starting blueprints and seven more), `BIO-20` (part: starting blueprints at skill 3 and starting experience), `RES-23` (part: generated scenes for the blueprints with a use), `RES-24`, `TIM-17` (part: each try lands as it ends; unfinished work stays on the thing), `MND-04` (part: values shown by use, wrong beliefs corrected), `MND-09` (part: known blueprints as options, worth through chains), `PRE-44` (part: the base actions), `PRN-01`, `PRN-07`.

**Architecture:** `A6.3`, `A6.6`, `A6.7`, `A6.8`, `A6.9`, `A6.13`, `A6.14`, `A4.4`, `A8.8`, `A8.13`, `A8.15`, `A8.19`, `A11.7`, `A11.8`, `A3.3`, `A15.7`.

**Needs:** α08.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-core` (`src/kinds.rs`: `BlueprintId`; α04a's `StateSet`), `kd-data` (`src/schema/blueprint.rs` new, kind `Action` new, kind `State`, `src/compile/`), `kd-things` (`src/states.rs`, `src/blueprint.rs` new, `src/matching.rs` new, `src/settle.rs` new, `src/wear.rs` new, `src/purposes.rs`, `src/checks/` (`reach.rs`, `discover.rs`, `fits.rs`, `possible.rs` new; α04a's mass check), `src/trials.rs` new), `kd-people` (`src/store.rs`: blueprints known and `actions_done`, `src/learn/learn.rs` new, `src/mind/kinds.rs`, `src/choose/options.rs`, `src/choose/worth.rs`, `src/choose/score.rs`, `src/setup.rs`, `src/body/blood.rs`), `kd-sim` (`src/activity.rs`, `ThingWorld`, `PeopleWorld::in_reach`, `src/scene.rs`), `kd-render` (`src/figures/`), `kd-ui` (`src/views/thing_card.rs`, `src/views/person.rs`, `src/views/mind.rs`), `kd-tools` (`kd catalog trials`, `kd catalog pairs`, `kd scene gen`), `data/blueprints/` (`stone.md`, `hunting.md`, `gathering.md`, `building.md`, `fire.md`, `cooking.md`, `wood.md`), `data/states.md`, `data/actions.md` new, `data/models/movements.md`, `data/minds/start.md` new, `data/tuning/things.md`, `data/tuning/minds.md`, `tests/fixtures/worlds/`, `scenes/`, `scenes/gen/`.

**Tasks:**
1. `T09.1` **The blueprint schema (`MAT-04`, `PRN-07`, A6.7).** `crates/kd-data/src/schema/blueprint.rs` holds every A6.7 field this stage uses: `action`; `[[inputs]]` with `name`, `role` (worked, tool, binding, fuel, container, body, ground), `use` (used, partly, kept, changed), `class`, `form`, `ranges`, `states` needed or refused, `yields` (true: only items with a `[[yields]]` list; false: only items without), `size`, `amount`, `part`, `wear_per_try` and check-only `meant`; `place` (`fire_min`, `water`, `sheltered`, `season`, `light_min`); `sector`, `difficulty`; `[time]` (`per_try`, `per_mass`, `quicker_with`, `max_repeats`, `on_thing`, `heavy`); `[result]` (`item` with `amount`, `size`, `main`, `material_from`, `set`; or `state`; or `yields` with a `share`); `leftovers`; `failures` (`share`, `gives`: nothing, spoiled, poor or hurt, with `part`, `wound`, `size` and an optional `hint` sign); `hinted_by`; `discovery` (default 1); `named`; `step`.
   `BlueprintId(u16)` in `kd_core::kinds` from `data/ids.lock`; the compiler checks one action, unique role names, failure shares summing to 1, difficulty 1–10, exactly one result kind, valid `set` expressions, and no item named as an input (`PRN-07`, `MAT-13`).
2. `T09.2` **States and actions for this stage (`MAT-06`, `MAT-19`, `MAT-16`, A6.3).** `data/states.md` (α04a's `wet`, `dried`, `rotten`) gains `crushed` (plant and bone: values by the item's override, else food +1 for plant; shown cracked open) and `cut` (flesh: drying × 3, shown as strips), and α04a's `StateSet` gains their bits; α08's `long_bone` gains `[states.crushed] food = 3` for its marrow.
   α04a's `hazelnuts` stay as written: cracked, they take the plant shift to food 5, so cracking is worth doing without rewriting a `MIL-01` entry (`MAT-16`).
   `data/actions.md` (kind `Action`, new) holds the 21 base actions of `MAT-06`, each with `hands` (1 for gather, cut, throw, feed and apply, else 2, `MAT-12`), `plain_use` (true for gather, dig, throw, feed, stack, heat, soak, dry and apply), the `sector` a plain use practises (gather and dig gathering, throw hunting, stack building, the others none, `MND-06`) and its movement id.
3. `T09.3` **The twelve blueprints (`MAT-23`, `MAT-22`, `MAT-07`, A6.7).** The blueprints, all `stage = "MIL-02"` unless said, each with `meant` naming α08's items:
   - `crack_with_stone` (gathering, start; strike, difficulty 1): `worked` (changed; plant or bone, lump or rod, 1–40 cm, water 0–1, refusing `crushed`: nuts, acorns and bones, never fruit); `hammer` (tool, kept; stone, hardness 3–5, toughness 2–5, 5–20 cm, wear 0.0002); `anvil` (tool, kept; stone, hardness 3–5, toughness 3–5, 15+ cm, wear 0.00002), the stone the worked thing rests on; result state `crushed`; 20 s a try, one try per 0.1 kg of nuts or per bone; failures nothing 0.95, spoiled 0.03, hurt 0.02 (bruise 5, holding arm).
     So a flint cobble of 8 cm or more cracking a nut on a granite boulder fits `flake_by_striking` too (core and striker), which α11a's accidents roll (`MAT-04`'s example).
   - `butcher_by_hand` (hunting, start; cut, difficulty 1): `carcass` (worked, partly; flesh, `yields = true`), nothing in the hands; result `yields` share 0.5 (`MAT-23`'s waste); 10 min a try per 100 kg of carcass, 8 tries; failures nothing 1.0.
   - `make_leaf_bed` (building, start; stack, difficulty 1): `bedding` (used; plant, strand or sheet, warmth 1–5, water 0–2, 4–8 kg: α05's `grass_bedding` or α08's `leaf_litter`); `floor` (ground); result `leaf_bed` (`set = { warmth = "+1" }`, main warmth); 15 min, one try; failures nothing 1.0.
   - `bank_fire` and `carry_embers` (fire, start): written with `stage = "MIL-03"` from `MAT-18`'s banking and carrying, so they stay out of this stage's subset and trials until α14a brings fires; `data/minds/start.md` lists them now.
   - `flake_by_striking` (stone; strike, difficulty 2): A6.7's block as written, with `quicker_with = "striker.hardness"`, `max_repeats = 10`, 30 s a try, leftovers `stone_chips` 20 g a try, and the nothing failure's `hint = "sharp_crumbs"`; named, step `flakes`.
   - `chopper_by_striking` (stone; strike, difficulty 3): `core` (partly; stone, hardness 4–5, flaking 2–5, 8–15 cm); `striker` (tool, kept; hardness 3–5, toughness 3–5, 6+ cm, wear 0.001); result `chopper` (`set = { edge = 3, toughness = "core.toughness" }`); 2 min a try, 3 tries; leftovers `stone_chips` 60 g; failures nothing 0.70 (hint `sharp_crumbs`), spoiled 0.29 (core breaks), hurt 0.01 (cut 5); named.
   - `scraper_by_pressing` (stone; press, difficulty 3): `blank` (used; stone, flake, edge 4–5, flaking 3–5, 3–8 cm); `presser` (tool, kept; bone or stone, hardness 3–4, toughness 3–5, 8+ cm, wear 0.0005); result `scraper` (`set = { edge = 4, toughness = 2 }`); 3 min; leftovers `stone_chips` 5 g; failures nothing 0.55 (hint `nibbled_edge`), spoiled 0.44 (snaps into `stone_chips`), hurt 0.01; named.
   - `butcher_with_edge` (hunting; cut, difficulty 2): `carcass` (worked, partly; flesh, `yields = true`); `blade` (tool, kept; edge 3–5, hardness 3–5, 3+ cm, wear 0.06, so a flake of toughness 1 dulls a step over about one deer, `MAT-20`); result `yields` share 0.9; 4 min a try per 100 kg, 8 tries, `quicker_with = "blade.edge"`; failures nothing 0.98, hurt 0.02 (cut 5).
   - `cut_meat_strips` (cooking; cut, difficulty 1): `meat` (changed; flesh, lump, `yields = false`, refusing `cut`); `blade` (tool, edge 3–5, wear 0.002); result state `cut`; 2 min a try per 0.5 kg; failures nothing 0.97, hurt 0.03.
   - `point_by_scraping` (wood; scrape, difficulty 2): `stick` (used; wood, rod, hardness 1–3, flexibility 0–3, 0.3–2 m); `blade` (tool, edge 3–5, hardness 3–5, wear 0.004); result `pointed_stick` (`set = { edge = 2 }`, `material_from = "stick"`); 6 min, `on_thing = true`; failures nothing 0.70, spoiled 0.25 (snaps into two `dead_stick` halves), hurt 0.05; named.
   - `point_by_grinding` (wood; grind, difficulty 2): `stick` as above; `abrader` (tool, kept; stone, hardness 3–4, toughness 2–5, flaking 0–2, 10+ cm, wear 0.001), the stone the stick is rubbed on; result `pointed_stick` as above; 12 min, `on_thing = true`; failures nothing 0.85, spoiled 0.15; named: a second route to one result (`MAT-07`).
4. `T09.4` **Matching on true and believed values (`MAT-04`, `MND-02`, `PRN-07`, A6.8).** `crates/kd-things/src/matching.rs`: `MatchIndex`, built at catalogue load in under 5 ms, holds blueprints by action, roles' masks, ranges, sizes, states, `by_kind` (world side only) and the hints each outcome gives.
   An action's things are what the doer holds, what they work, and what the worked thing rests on: the largest thing within 0.5 m under it, else α08's seed boulder there or the largest piece of the stone patch there, seen as a `ThingView` of its item at its seeded size and quality (A5.3's place uid), else the ground (an addition to A6.8, written into the architecture in this branch).
   `pub fn assign(bp, things: &[ThingView]) -> Option<SmallVec<[u8; 4]>>` fills roles in entry order on true values, each role a different thing, backtracking; a `yields` role takes only items with or without yields as it says.
   `pub fn find_inputs(bp, pool: &InReach) -> Option<InputSet>` does the same on believed values: α04c's `InReach` (believed hidden values and look-alikes from `mind/kinds.rs`, so chert passes for flint) gains the seed boulders and stone patches of the buckets within 30 m, each kind with its nearest piece (an addition to A8.15's `InReach`, written into the architecture in this branch); it prunes by class, form, size, states and seen values only, never by `by_kind` (`MND-02`, `PRN-07`); at most 1 µs a blueprint.
5. `T09.5` **Settling tries (`TIM-17`, `MAT-20`, `MAT-09`, A6.9, A6.6, A6.13).** `crates/kd-things/src/settle.rs`:
   - `pub fn plan(w: &impl ThingWorld, t: &Things, job: &Job, now) -> Result<Plan, NoFit>` checks what the doer could see, the place, hands (`MAT-12`) and strength, marks the inputs busy and sets the try length: `per_try` (× mass ÷ 100 kg where `per_mass`), a tenth shorter per step the `quicker_with` value is above its range's lowest, at most a third, × 4/3 for each slowing condition `Doer` counts (A6.7).
   - `impl ActRules<ThingCx> for Work`: each try is its own End event (A4.4), so each strike lands as it ends; `finish` rolls `things.try` (system 8, keyed on the doer's uid and the try's end second, fortune `Good`) at `chance(level, difficulty, inputs_quality, penalty, factor)` as A6.7 writes it, `level` = (skill + sector experience) ÷ 2, `factor` 1, `penalty` from `ThingWorld::doer`: 0.1 per 20 pain (α09b) and 0.1 each for tiredness (rest below 20), clumsy cold (chill 40 or more, α05), darkness beyond firelight and an arm below half health (α09b), each of those four also counted for `plan`'s slowing (`MAT-04`).
   - A success removes the used-up mass first, then makes the result: the main input's current values (states in, quality and wear out), then each `set` entry in order, clamped 0–5; its size drawn in range (`things.try` slot 1); leftovers take the rest; a `Made` row (maker, blueprint, parts' input kind, material and amount band) and the maker as owner.
   - Quality of a made thing (`MAT-20`, A6.6): ⌊level ÷ 2⌋, +1 for inputs averaging quality 4–5, −1 for 0–1, then +1 or −1 each at 1 in 4 (`things.quality`), clamped 0–5; at 0–1 its main value is a step lower and it wears twice as fast, at 4–5 a step higher and half as fast; a raw thing's quality moves none of its values and counts only as a fine or poor input.
   - Wear (A6.6, `wear.rs`): the kept tool gains `wear_per_try` × 0.5 for toughness 4–5 or × 2 for 0–1, then, for a made tool, × 2 at quality 0–1 or × 0.5 at 4–5, in ten-thousandths; a tool loses a step of its `main` per whole step; at 5 it becomes its `breaks.into` and the work stops.
   - A failure picks its kind by shares (`things.fail_kind`): nothing (time and wear spent), spoiled (the worked input becomes its `breaks.into`), poor (a result of quality 0), hurt (`ThingWorld::body(who, BodyChange::Wound(spec))`; until α09b the wound joins α06c's `wounds` column as a `Cut`, bleeding by α06c's closed form in `body/blood.rs` and healing 7 a day).
   - A wrong belief (A6.9 step 3): a hidden value outside a role's range fails the try as nothing, stops the work and reports `Seen::Wrong { who, kind, role, chars }` with the true values; every try reports the values its action shows (striking: flaking and toughness; cutting and scraping: edge; A8.13), which α04c's `mind/kinds.rs` writes into kinds known, so `find_inputs` never offers that wrong try again (`PRN-01`).
   - `go_on` continues while inputs remain, the tool is whole, nobody was hurt, repeats remain and the aim the choice was made for is not met (A4.4).
   - At the last try, every other known blueprint under the action that the things truly fit rolls once at its chance (`things.side_fit`); unknown ones join in α11a.
   - Unfinished work: a try with `on_thing` cut short leaves `Wip { bp, done }` on the worked thing (A4.4's `OnThing`), and whoever takes it up needs only the rest, rolled at the finisher's level.
   - Mass: test builds sum the mass into and out of each settle and fail on any gain (A6.13).
6. `T09.6` **Base actions move (`MAT-06`, `PRE-44`, A11.8).** α06c's `data/models/movements.md` gains the base actions not yet there (strike, press, cut, scrape, grind, twist, bind, weave, shape, drill, dig, soak, dry, mix, stack, plant, throw, feed, apply; heat and its blowing variant come with α14a), each 2–6 key poses as bone rotations, a posture (standing, kneeling, sitting), a loop length and its marks (contact for strike, press, cut, drill and throw; stroke for scrape, grind and twist; step for stack, plant and dig).
   Repeated work plays one loop per try, its contact mark falling on the try's end (A11.8's clock); the skill variant jitters poses by ±(5 − level) × 2°.
   Knowing an action (`MAT-06`): a person column `actions_done: u32` sets the action's bit at the end of any activity using it, for α11a's experiments.
7. `T09.7` **Starting knowledge and the one way to learn (`BIO-20`, `MND-06`, A8.8, A8.19).** `crates/kd-people/src/learn/learn.rs` (new) holds `pub fn learn(p, bp, how: How, from: Option<Uid>, now)`, the one way in for every new blueprint (A8.19): it adds the record to the person store's blueprints known (A8.2: 150 × 32 bytes: skill, best, tries, successes, last used, learned day, from whom and how), `How` being `Start`, `Taught`, `Watched`, `Discovered(Route)` or `Sudden` (α35b); α11a adds its logged event.
   `data/minds/start.md` lists the five starting blueprints at skill 3 for adults, 1 for children 5–9 and 2 for children 10–13; α06a's `first_band` grants them through `learn(.., How::Start, None, ..)` and sets starting experience, gathering 3, hunting 2 and fire 1, +1 in each for every 15 years over 20, children a share by age (`age ÷ 14`); `bank_fire` and `carry_embers` are granted only once their stage is in the catalogue's subset (α14a).
   Scene settings gain `extra_knowledge = [{ who = "adult:1", bp = "flake_by_striking", skill = 5 }]` and `kinds_known = [{ who, item }]` (hidden values learned), recorded with the world like a switch, so test worlds can hold a knapper before anyone discovers flakes (`RES-10`'s record, `RES-18`), and `clear = { items = [...], within_m }`, a start with no such loose stone within reach.
8. `T09.8` **Choosing known blueprints (`MND-09`, `TIM-17`, A8.15).** In α04c's `crates/kd-people/src/choose/options.rs`, blueprint options: those whose results serve the 3 most pressing needs or a plan step, the 8 best by a quick estimate of their result's worth, `find_inputs` run in that order until 3 fit, on what is in reach or at a known place with its trip.
   α04c's worth table (`choose/worth.rs`) adds the chain: a thing is worth its direct relief or 0.7 a step × the worth of what known blueprints make from it, 3 steps back at most, shared among inputs, × 1 ÷ (1 + have ÷ enough), rebuilt by the wake job after a day with learning; `[worth] enough` in `data/tuning/minds.md`: 2 cutting tools, 1 bed per person.
   `p` = (successes + 1) ÷ (tries + 2) from the person's blueprint record; the aim is the amount that meets the need or `enough`, or about an hour (`TIM-17`).
   The person card's activity line reads "Knapping a sharp flake · try 4 of 10" with its three reasons, such as "wants a cutting edge for the deer".
9. `T09.9` **Catalogue checks, trials and generated scenes (`MAT-17`, `RES-24`, `RES-23`, A6.14, A15.7).** `crates/kd-things/src/checks/`: reachable (a closure from the first region's materials, plain uses and the starting blueprints reaches every named result, no chain needing its own result first); discoverable (each blueprint's first route by accident, experiment or hint, as A6.14 item 3 runs it; a blueprint with no route fails); possible; expected fits (each item's `fits` and each role's `meant`; any other fit fails until named, and `kd catalog pairs` lists a change's new fits); α04a's mass check over blueprints; times (`TIM-18`); and `RCK-01`'s second clause, no blueprint gives edge 4 or more from a stone below flaking 3.
   Worth in reach (A6.14 item 6) reports each result with no use yet (the scraper until α25a, the pointed stick until α24b) and fails only on the launch catalogue (α51).
   `crates/kd-things/src/trials.rs`, run by `kd catalog trials`: each blueprint of the stage tried 200 times at levels 1 and 8 with inputs from `meant`, no mind choosing: successes inside the range where 200 tries of that chance land 99 times in 100 (the exact binomial range, `trials::range99(200, p)`: 100–140 at 60%, 3–19 at 5%, `RES-24`), times within 10%, results and leftovers as written, failure shares over 1,000 failures by `RES-13`'s rule (within a third for shares of 1 in 20 or more, half to double for rarer); a trial that misses reruns once on a second fixed key set before it fails (an addition to A6.14 item 8, written into the architecture in this branch).
   `kd scene gen <bp>` writes `scenes/gen/<bp>.toml` (A15.7): one adult knowing it at skill 5, its `meant` inputs in reach, look-alike decoys whose hidden values miss its ranges beside them; pass `count(made >= 1) >= 10` within 2 game days (`RES-23`'s chain rule); this stage generates the seven blueprints whose results have a use now (`crack_with_stone`, `butcher_by_hand`, `butcher_with_edge`, `make_leaf_bed`, `flake_by_striking`, `chopper_by_striking`, `cut_meat_strips`), and each later alpha generates its own.

1. Open the alpha link; Make test world `a09 · The knapper` (Settings, long-press the version line), then open it from Worlds.
2. Pinch in to person zoom on the knapper at camp (her card says "Knapping a sharp flake", with her reasons): each strike's contact pose and the new flake show on the same frame, and chips gather under her.
3. Tap a new flake: "Sharp flake · made by" her name, "by striking", its quality in words and edge 5; tap the chips heap beside her.
4. Set the dial to about an hour a minute: she cuts up a deer with a flake while others pull a second one apart by hand, slower; the flake's card shows its wear rising.
5. Watch someone crack nuts on the granite boulder with a stone, and someone else stack grass into a bed in the cave.

**Not in this alpha:** unknown blueprints, side fits of unknown ones, accidents, experiments and hints (α11a); skill and experience rising (α11a) and fading (α12); full wounds, bleeding and care (α09b); learning from others (α12); fire blueprints in play (α14a); the people's own words and named discoveries (α11a); sounds of actions (α16b); the scraper's and pointed stick's uses (α25a, α24b); working together on big results (α25b).

**Risks:** trials and the exact 99-in-100 range: a correct blueprint falls outside it once in 100 by chance, so a trial that misses reruns once on the second fixed key set in `data/tuning/things.md` `[trials]` (`RES-13`'s rerun) and fails only if both miss, about once in 10,000, and a failure is read as a wrong field first (`RES-09`); people preferring blueprints over food when hungry: worth through chains loses 0.3 a step and urgent needs dominate the score, checked by `a09-butcher-by-hand` and the stage-1 scenes still passing; 19 hand-made movements taking long: each starts from a shared ground-work or standing-work base pose set and changes 2–3 bones.

### α09b Hurts and plain care (about 4.5 hours)

**Goal:** a knapping slip, a fall or a frozen night wounds a part of the body that bleeds, hurts, slows work and heals or kills, and others, kin first, come to press the wound, stay and bring food and water.

**Serves:** `BIO-13` (part: cuts, bruises, burns and broken bones on people, bleeding, pressing, infection without fever, healing, pain, harm by part, lasting harm), `BIO-23` (part: plain care), `BIO-14` (part: deaths by bleeding and by head or torso, with cause and how), `BIO-11` (part: frostbite), `MAT-12`, `MAT-11` (part: people who fall are hurt), `MND-26` (part: caring, kin first), `TIM-17` (part: a blow ends the activity at once; pain and a call interrupt), `PRE-35` (part: the body on the person card), `PRE-44` (part: lying hurt, the limp and the sling), `PRE-27` (part: body signs and wound marks), `PRE-18` (part: wound marks by content level), `PRE-13` (part: wounds findable).

**Architecture:** `A8.6`, `A7.8` (its decision: wound arithmetic in `kd_life::body`), `A8.3`, `A8.5`, `A8.9`, `A8.15`, `A4.4`, `A4.7`, `A11.8`, `A12.4`, `A12.8`, `A14.9`.

**Needs:** α09.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-life` (`src/body.rs` new), `kd-people` (`src/body/blood.rs`, `src/body/wound.rs` new, `src/body/care.rs` new, `src/body/warmth.rs`, `src/life/death.rs`, `src/choose/options.rs`, `src/choose/score.rs`), `kd-things` (`ThingWorld::doer`'s hands), `kd-sim` (`src/activity.rs`: forced activities; calls for help), `kd-view` (`FigureView` body signs), `kd-render` (`src/figures/`), `kd-ui` (`src/views/person.rs`, `src/findable.rs`), `data/models/movements.md`, `data/tuning/body.md`, `data/minds/thoughts.md` new, `data/text/deaths.md`, `data/text/cards.md`, `tests/fixtures/worlds/`, `scenes/`.

**Tasks:**
1. `T09b.1` **Wound arithmetic in `kd_life::body` (`BIO-13`, `BIO-19`, A8.6, A7.8).** α06c's `Wound` (24 bytes: part, kind, flags, size, heal rate, flow, made and bleed-start minutes) and its closed-form blood loss move from `kd-people/src/body/blood.rs` into `crates/kd-life/src/body.rs` as pure functions, with their layout unchanged, so saved `people.hot` chunks read as before and α06c's `closed_form_matches_steps` still passes; `body/blood.rs` keeps the person's side (crossings in the Body event, blood back 10 a day, slower with age), and α12b's animals call the same functions (A7.8's decision).
   - Kinds grow from α06c's `BirthBleed` and α09's interim `Cut` to cut, bruise, bite, burn and break; flags pressed, washed, dressed, splinted, infected, dirty.
   - `pub fn blood_lost(w: &[Wound], from: u32, to: u32) -> f32`: each cut or bite bleeds a tenth of its size a minute, halving every 10 minutes (1.44 × size if left alone); pressing quarters the flow and stops a wound under 30 within 10 minutes; a dressing (α24a) stops any; several wounds solved by 8 bisection steps.
   - `pub fn next_crossing(..) -> Option<u32>` for blood lost 25 (strength and stamina halved), 35 (collapse) and 50 (death), scheduled in the person's one Body event (A8.3), as α06c's crossings are.
   - `pub fn heal_per_day(w, factors) -> f32`: 7 a day (bruises 15; a break mends in 10 days), × 1.2 resting, × 1.1 fed, × 1.1 warm, × 0.6 condition under 30, × 0.7 chilled, × 0 with scurvy (α15), −2% a year past 45.
   - Infection, for a wound of 10 or more: one draw at its making (`bodies.infection`, system 9, fortune `Bad`), half the size in percent for a cut, the size for a bite or burn, × 2 dirty, × 0.5 washed, × 0.5 again dressed, × 0.8 in a strong body, compared at a moment drawn in its first 2 days so early washing counts; smaller wounds heal clean; an infected wound stops healing for 5 days, then clears (wound fever joins in α17b).
2. `T09b.2` **Wounds on people (`BIO-13`, `BIO-14`, A8.6).** `crates/kd-people/src/body/wound.rs`: `pub fn wound(&mut self, p: PersonId, spec: WoundSpec, now)` (kind, size, part if the event decides it, dirty, cause), the part otherwise drawn by `bodies.wound_part` (torso 40%, each arm 15%, each leg 12%, head 6%); a blow or fall over 25 on an arm or leg breaks it; α09's interim hurt now goes through it.
   Pain = Σ sizes, at most 100: work and walking slower by pain ÷ 2 percent, tries −0.1 per 20 (through `doer()`).
   A head below 50 dazes (half speed, no blueprints) and below 25 knocks out for an hour; a torso below 50 halves strength and stamina; either at 0 kills; a limb at 0 is useless for life; a broken leg hobbles at a quarter speed; a broken arm stops two-handed actions.
   Lasting: a wound over 30 scars (α06a's `lasting` values); a break heals crooked 1 time in 2 (`bodies.crooked`; splints in α24a make it 1 in 10).
   Deaths go through α06c's `Death { cause, how, place, age }` (`life/death.rs`), which gains the causes bleeding, head and torso, with their how patterns in `data/text/deaths.md` ("bleeding, from a knapping cut, while knapping"), never "unknown" (`BIO-14`), logged forever as α07b logs every death.
   `data/minds/thoughts.md` (new, the catalogue α10a's mood reads) begins with `wounded` (−size ÷ 4, while it lasts), `in_pain` (−pain ÷ 10) and `cared_for` (+3, a day).
3. `T09b.3` **Falls and frostbite (`MAT-11`, `BIO-11`, A8.5, A8.6).** `pub fn fall(&mut self, p, metres, now)`: a bruise of 10 for each metre beyond the first to a leg (over 25 breaks it), and from 5 m as much again to the torso and the head; a held thing drops by α08's falling rule; nobody climbs in this stage's play, so falls come from scene settings until α19a's climbing.
   Frostbite (A8.5), in α05's `crates/kd-people/src/body/warmth.rs`: a bare part at a felt −5 °C or below for 2 hours takes a burn of 15, and another each further 2 hours, the hands and feet counting with their limbs (`BIO-13`); α13's cold spells make it likelier.
4. `T09b.4` **What a body can do (`MAT-12`, `BIO-04`, A6.7).** `ThingWorld::doer` reports `hands` (2, or 1 with a broken or useless arm), `strength` (inborn × age × condition × torso and blood-loss factors) and α09's penalty for an arm below half health; `plan` refuses an action needing two hands (`data/actions.md`) with `NoFit::Hands`, and option building skips such blueprints and plain uses for that person.
   Children under 5 get no work options, blueprints or plain uses (`BIO-04`); children 5–13 work at their strength share; a blueprint marked `heavy` takes its time ÷ relative strength (none in this stage).
5. `T09b.5` **Interruptions, calls for help and lying hurt (`TIM-17`, `PRE-44`, `PRE-18`, A4.4, A4.7, A11.8).** A blow, a fall or a wound of 10 or more ends the activity at once (A4.4); a hurt person with a wound of 20 or more calls for help (one of A4.17's `MIL-01` calls), addressed to their nearest kin within hearing (1 km, A8.9), else to the nearest band member, which interrupts the one called (`worth_interrupting`, A4.7); α10a makes it a loud event that everyone within hearing notices.
   Blood lost 35 or a knock-out starts the forced activity `lie_hurt` (reason "collapsed: blood lost"), which ends when blood lost falls below 30 or the hour passes.
   α06c's `data/models/movements.md` gains `lie_hurt` (2 key poses); the variants limp (a leg under 60 health or broken: its swing × 0.4, a one-voxel dip, pace × 0.8) and arm still (an arm under 40 or broken: held in a sling) apply (A11.8).
   Body signs (`PRE-27`): a scar as two darker voxels; at the Show content level (α07b's setting), wound marks as red voxels on the part and drops on the ground under a bleeder, none at Plain or Gentle (A12.8, `PRE-18`).
6. `T09b.6` **Plain care (`BIO-23`, `MND-26`, A8.6, A8.15).** `crates/kd-people/src/body/care.rs`: anyone within 20 m of someone hurt (pain 20 or more, bleeding, collapsed) or called for help gets the option `care(target)`.
   Its score is the hurt person's relief (the blood they would lose and their pain, as need relief) through α06b's `K` (× kin weight, + 0.1 × kind for anyone, A8.15), plus the caring leaning's pull for anyone (`[care] base`: 0.1 of that relief, at least 0.05, tuned, `MND-26`; an addition to A8.15's `K`, written into the architecture in this branch), so kin come first and others still come.
   The care activity walks to them and, by what they need: presses a bleeding wound (`pressed` while the carer stays, at most 2 carers pressing), stays beside them (a shared task: belonging +10 once a day for both, A8.10), gives water or food from what the carer carries or the camp's stores, or carries a collapsed child to camp, an adult with a second carrier (a short way's load, `BIO-21`).
   Each hour of care adds the carer to `carers(who)` for that day (A8.6), which α17b's illness rolls read, and counts as healing work for experience (α11a).
7. `T09b.7` **The body on the person card (`PRE-35`, `PRE-13`).** α04d's person card (`crates/kd-ui/src/views/person.rs`, which already shows each part's health and an empty wounds line) gains each wound as a line ("cut · right arm · 38 · bleeding · pressed by" the carer's name, "healing", "infected", "scar"); pain; "can't use both hands", "hobbling"; for the dead, the cause and how.
   `World::record_kinds()` gains `people.wounds` and `people.carers`, with their `FINDABLE` lines (the person card).

1. Open the alpha link; Make test world `a09b · Cut at the gravel bar`, then open it from Worlds.
2. At close camp a knapper lies on the gravel with a bleeding arm; within moments her partner runs over and kneels beside her.
3. Tap her: the card shows six part bars, "cut · right arm · 38 · bleeding · pressed by" her partner's name, and her pain.
4. Set the dial to about a day every 10 seconds: the wound line changes to "healing", and she works again, slowly at first.

**Not in this alpha:** washing, dressings, splints and herbal medicine as blueprints (α24a); wound fever and the illnesses (α17b); burns from fire (α14a); bites and blows from animals (α23) and from fights (α30b); the sign for someone you follow badly wounded (α11b); healing experience rising with care (α11a); friends caring more than others (α10b).

**Risks:** the closed form drifting from the true loss with several wounds: bisection is tested against integration to 0.1 points; carers crowding round the hurt: at most 2 press, and others' care options fall once someone is pressing; caring pulling people away from urgent needs of their own: urgent needs below 20 outweigh care, which counts only the hurt person's relief times its small weights; moving `Wound` changing saved bytes: its layout is kept and `birth_bleed_reads_as_before` guards it.

   Each awake person takes in their own task's results and talk to them, and at most one more thing: from the 16 nearest new candidates in range (α04c's `sense.rs` ranges: all within 50 m by day, × 0.4 dark; small things within 30 m while searching or gathering, or when new; people and big things to 1 km in the open, 200 m in open woods, 50 m in thick cover, × 0.1 at night), scored by A8.9's salience: (3 never met, 2 not in two days, 1 not in the hour, else 0) + 4 if it breaks an expectation (from α10b) + 1 moving + 2 × the urgency of a need it serves + 1.5 a known arrival (2 a stranger), all ÷ (1 + distance ÷ 20 m) × (1 + 0.15 × curious); ties by uid.
   Taken at chance 0.9 × (0.6 at a blueprint, 0.8 walking) × (0.7 with rest below 20) × (0.5 with fear over 50, from α28) × (1 + 0.1 × curious) (`minds.glance`, system 10, polarity `None`).
   What it gives: a map fact (food, water, stone showing), the kind's seen values (A8.13), the thought `new_thing_seen`, the memory `saw_new_thing` for a kind never met, and a surprise check (T10a.6).
   `MindLists.familiar` (160 × 12 bytes: subject, count, last day): each day a subject is met, count = count × 2^(−days since last ÷ 60) + 1 (A8.14), which salience reads and α10b's beliefs share.
   Walks note what cells hold through A5.2's `CellNotice` (water, stone showing, ripe food, herds), one map fact per cell crossed at most.
2. `T10a.2` **Loud events and calls (`TIM-17`, `BIO-18`, A4.7, A8.9).** `LoudEvent { kind: Shout | Call { to: Uid, why: Warn | Help | Fetch } | Cry, at, second }` gives a Notice at its second to every cluster member within hearing (shout and call 1 km, × 0.5 wind, × 0.6 rain, × 0.3 rushing water; asleep × 0.3), and wakes sleepers within half that.
   A call interrupts the one it names (`worth_interrupting`); α06c's baby's cry and α09b's call for help become `Cry` and `Call { why: Help }`, so all within hearing notice them, and a person who wants someone to come (a plan step or a fetch) may call them by name.
3. `T10a.3` **Memories (`MND-18`, `MND-08`, A8.12).** `crates/kd-people/src/mind/memory.rs`: the 80-byte record of A8.12 (`when`, `renewed`, `kind`, `feeling`, `importance`, `place`, `subject`, `event`, `who: [Uid; 5]`, `others`, `src`, `told`, `teller`) in `MindLists.memories` (200); `who` holds the five who mattered most, kin first, then by opinion.
   `data/minds/memories.md` holds each kind with its base importance and the thought it brings back: `meal` 5, `saw_new_thing` 10, `new_place` 15, `failed_try` 20, `first_success` 25, `hurt` 30 (+ the wound's size), `saw_hurt` 20, `cared_for` 15, `surprise` 40, `dream_kept` 30, `paired` 50, `saw_a_death` 50, `kin_born` 40, `my_child_born` 60, `band_member_died` 40, `kin_died` 80, `my_child_died` 100.
   Kept at importance 5 or more; vividness = importance × 0.5^(days since renewed ÷ H), H = 2 × 2^(importance ÷ 12) days, so a meal goes in about 6 days and a child's death keeps over a quarter after 20 game years; the wake job drops those below 1, and at 200 the least vivid goes.
   Recall: arriving at a place, meeting a person or glancing at a kind brings back each matching memory of vividness 10 or more at chance min(1, vividness ÷ 25) (`minds.recall`), with half its thought for a day, and renews it.
   Hooks make memories at meals (α04b), tries (α09), hurts and care (α09b), births, deaths and pairings (α06b, α06c), new places and new kinds.

   A noticed surprise gives the memory `surprise`, curiosity +15, the thought `surprised`, and for a day an `examine` option (walk there, look and handle it: its seen values, and for a made thing its marks, T10a.7); the link at its place is α10b's, and a hunch from a hint α11a's.

8. `T10a.8` **Their own dreams (`MND-12`, `RES-10`, A8.17).** In the wake job, one dream a night from the last 3 days' memories by vividness and by the needs they bear on, 1 night in 5 an older one (`minds.dream_pick`); its thought lingers half a day (`nightmare` −4 when the memory's thought is −4 or worse, else `sweet_dream` +2), and the dreamt memories renew.
   A hint comes 1 night in 60, 1 in 20 while a need is below 20 (`minds.dream_hint`, A8.17 and `MND-12`): it joins a thing kind and an action from two different memories with the most pressing need's result into a hunch of strength 30, source dream; 1 time in 3 (`minds.dream_real`) the hunch carries a real unknown blueprint whose action is the dream's and whose roles the thing kind truly fits (from `MatchIndex::by_kind`, an engine rule like α16's idea dreams), else none.
   A dream is kept as the memory `dream_kept` only if a nightmare, a hint or of the dead; `dream_slot` stays empty for α16's sent dreams.
   The switch `minds.dreams` (A8.22) stops dreams and their hints when off.

**On the phone:**
1. Open the alpha link; Make test world `a10a · Watching the knapper`, then open it from Worlds.
2. Tap someone who watched the knapper yesterday and open the details of their mind: under Hunches, "strike · flaking stone · a cutting edge · seen made by" the knapper's name.
3. Under Memories: "Saw something new: a sharp flake", with its day, place and who was there; under Dreams, last night's dream.
4. Close it: the card's mood line reads like "Mood 61 · ate well, saw something new".
5. Set the dial to about an hour a minute: now and then someone walks over to the chips heap, picks up a flake and turns it over (examining it).

**Not in this alpha:** feelings and their share in memories (α28); expectations and links at a place (α10b); hints from accidents and failure signs (α11a); watched uses (α12); danger noticed at its second (α12c); sent dreams (α16); inspiration and breakdowns (α28b); retold memories (α30a); dreams of the dead feeding beliefs about the unseen (α31) and ancestors (α32b).

**Risks:** glances costing more than A4.7's 2.3 µs in crowded camps: candidates are capped at 16 from the window's index; mood swinging with every small thought: the 3-hour half-life and half-size repeats damp it, checked by the fed and hungry scenes; dream hints making discovery too easy: their rates are tuned values logged with the sharp-stone runs (`RES-16`); Stage 1's scenes moving as traits start to act: they must still pass unchanged (P0's definition of done, item 3), and a failure is fixed in the traits' numbers, never in a pass rule.

### α10b Causes, kin and who knows what (about 5 hours)

**Goal:** after a strong outcome people link it to something unusual that came before and test the link against what follows, weigh their kin and friends as they believe them in every choice, track who knows which crafts and places, and tell others how things are made.

**Serves:** `MND-05` (part: links formed, tested and weighed in choosing; the unseen, ready fears, shared taboos and told beliefs come in α31, α28, α31b and α30a), `MND-27` (part: beliefs from their own experience, with strength), `MND-04` (part: poison believed from links), `MND-26` (part: kin as believed and friends in every choice), `MND-24` (part: friends and rivals), `MND-23` (part: who knows what; secrets and following in α30b), `MND-13` (part: being told how gives a hunch), `CUL-24` (part: the how-to topic and the listeners who lack it), `BIO-12` (part: a mild wild poison in the land), `PRE-10` (part: the family tree), `PRE-14` (part: beliefs with their reasons or "reason forgotten", relations, who knows what), `PRE-13` (part: links and who knows what findable), `MND-14` (part: 40 links, 3 per outcome), `PLT-09` (part: a big update, marked).

**Architecture:** `A8.14`, `A8.15`, `A8.18`, `A8.17`, `A8.12`, `A8.8`, `A8.4`, `A7.2`, `A12.3`, `A12.4`, `A14.12`, `A14.9`.

**Needs:** α10a.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-people` (`src/mind/belief.rs` new, `src/mind/unseen.rs` new (one stub), `src/mind/recent.rs` new, `src/mind/kinds.rs`, `src/choose/score.rs`, `src/choose/worth.rs`, `src/social/kin.rs` new, `src/social/relations.rs`, `src/social/knows.rs` new, `src/social/talk.rs`), `kd-sim` (`PeopleWorld`, `src/scene.rs`), `kd-save` (the family query), `kd-ui` (`src/views/mind.rs`, `src/views/family.rs` new, `src/views/person.rs`, `src/findable.rs`), `kd-text` (card lines), `data/minds/thoughts.md`, `data/minds/topics.md`, `data/tuning/minds.md`, `data/plants/bushes.md`, `data/items/plant.md`, `data/VERSION.toml`, `tests/golden/generator.toml`, `tests/fixtures/worlds/`, `scenes/`.

**Tasks:**
1. `T10b.1` **The recent log and strong outcomes (`MND-05`, A8.14).** `crates/kd-people/src/mind/recent.rs`: `MindLists.recent` (48 × 12 bytes: when, subject, cause kind, whose), filled by hooks: foods eaten, areas entered at activity starts, activity kinds and actions started with the main thing used ("struck flint"), people met at glances, what kin and friends were seen doing, and the night's dream if kept (`dreamt`, A8.14); α10a's familiarity list counts the same causes.
   `StrongOutcome { kind, good, size, from_sky_or_land, sudden_death, seen_on: Option<Uid> }`: what befalls a person, or kin and friends they see, as big as its worst thought, strong at 8 or more either way; a need falling or their own act is not an outcome (`MND-05`), so α10a's need thoughts (`starving`, `very_thirsty`, `freezing`, `exhausted`) never are, while `sick_from_food`, `hunger_ended`, a hurt, a death, a birth and a find are.
2. `T10b.2` **Forming links on α04c's start links (`MND-05`, `MND-27`, A8.14 rules 1–3).** `crates/kd-people/src/mind/belief.rs` takes over `MindLists.links` (A8.2: 40 × 48 bytes), which until now held only α04c's starting "makes ill" links: `#[repr(C)] pub struct Link { cause: Cause, outcome: u16, good: u8, strength: u8, hits: u16, misses: u16, source: u8, teller: Uid, made: u32, last: u32, memories: [u32; 2] }` (Pod, padded to 48 bytes), `Cause { kind: u8 /* food, place, act with a thing kind, animal kind, person, person's state, weather, sky sign */, id: u32, extra: u16 }`; sources `start` (α04c's, read as before), `own`, and later `told` (α30a) and `shared` (α31b).
   `pub fn on_outcome(p, o: StrongOutcome, cx)` runs the rule as named steps, each its own function, so later stages add theirs without touching the others:
   - `explained`: a held link whose cause is in the last 2 days of the recent log and whose outcome kind matches is tested (T10b.3), and nothing new forms;
   - `link_unusual`: the most unusual cause of the last 2 days (lowest familiarity, latest on ties, foods first for sickness) is linked if its familiarity is below 6 or it was not met in the 10 days before, a first time most, at strength min(50, 3 × |thought size|); a person is a cause of harm only if a stranger or disliked (opinion −20 or less), and someone sick or dying is linked by that state;
   - `link_at_place`: a surprise at a place links at strength 20 to what the person usually does or leaves there (their α04c habits at that place), however long ago, the rule α45 uses for `MOM-08`;
   - `unseen::maybe_form` (`src/mind/unseen.rs`): called when nothing was unusual enough, the outcome came from the sky or the land, or was a sudden death; it forms nothing until α31 gives it A8.14's rule 4.
   Each link keeps the indexes of its outcome's and cause's memories; α28's ready fears (rule 7) and α35b's sudden knowing (rule 11) join as steps of their own.
3. `T10b.3` **Testing and room (`MND-05`, `MND-14`, A8.14 rules 5 and 6).** `MindLists.expect` (8 × 16 bytes): a held link's cause recurring opens a 2-day expectation; the outcome within it adds 15 and a hit, only the stronger of two links explaining it gaining; expiry without it takes 5 and a miss; for an outcome kind that comes on more than 1 day in 10, each is 10 (`MND-05`); below 5 the link is forgotten.
   An expectation broken either way adds α10a's +4 salience and can surprise.
   Room: 40 links, at most 3 per outcome kind, the weakest, new or old, dropped.
4. `T10b.4` **Links in choosing (`MND-05`, `MND-04`, A8.14 rule 8, A8.4).** α04c's harm cost in `choose/score.rs` (strength ÷ 5 × (1 + 0.25 × cautious)) now reads every link whose cause is the option's food, place, act or person; luck adds strength ÷ 10; the reason part `Belief(link)` names it ("believes red berries bring sickness").
   A food with a harm link to sickness is believed poisonous at strength ÷ 20 (0–5) in kinds known, which worth and α04b's taste read; at hunger 10 the relief outweighs a cost of at most 20, so nobody starves beside a feared food (`MND-05`).
5. `T10b.5` **Kin as believed, in every choice (`MND-26`, A8.15).** `crates/kd-people/src/social/kin.rs` (new) is the one kin module: `kin_weight(rel) -> f32` from kinship as believed (α06b's relation record), with α06b's weights moved into `[kin]` of `data/tuning/minds.md` (parent, child, partner 0.5; sibling 0.35; grandparent, grandchild 0.25; other kin 0.12); α06b's `K` (sharing, help) and α09b's care read it, α12's teaching will, and a friend adds 0.2 (`MND-26`'s "more for kin and friends"; an addition to A8.15's `K`, written into the architecture in this branch).
6. `T10b.6` **Friends and rivals (`MND-24`, A8.18).** α06b's relations (`src/social/relations.rs`) already flag a friend after 10 days at opinion 60 or more; a friend now counts in `kin_weight`, and a rival is flagged when two court the same person and hold each other at −20 or less, costing 5 in `B` toward courting the one the rival courts; the enemy flag waits for α30b's harms.
7. `T10b.7` **Who knows what (`MND-23`, `CUL-24`, A8.18).** `crates/kd-people/src/social/knows.rs` fills the who-knows-what bits α06b's relation record keeps: `knows_bp: u128` over the holder's first 128 known blueprints and `knows_place: u64` over their 64 most valued places, set by seeing the other use the blueprint (α10a's glance), arriving within 100 m of them at a place, telling a place, and teaching (α12); kept from age 4.
   α06b's talk score (`social/talk.rs`) now takes `× the listeners who lack it` (A8.18), read from these bits.
8. `T10b.8` **Telling how things are made (`MND-13`, `CUL-24`, A8.17, A8.18).** α06b's plain talk gains the topic `how_to` (`data/minds/topics.md`): a teller with a known blueprint whose bit is clear for some listener, scored by its weight × the listeners who lack it × their believed worth of its result ÷ 5 (worth 5 or more), skipped while it is among the teller's last 10 topics (α06b's rule).
   Hearing it gives a hunch of strength trust ÷ 2, source told, with its blueprint (A8.17), and the line "Ama told Tor how sharp flakes are made" in both cards' recent talk (`PRE-45`'s pattern line); telling sets no blueprint bit, since the listener holds only a hunch, so teaching (α12) still follows; A8.18 gains both rules, telling a place setting its who-knows-what bit and telling how setting none, written into the architecture in this branch.

### α11a Discovery (about 5 hours)

**Goal:** people find blueprints nobody taught them, by accident, by experimenting, by trying a hunch or by copying a found thing, grow in skill as they work, and a people's first sharp flake is a named discovery with its own word; the first-flake runs and the sharp-stone control run.

**Serves:** `MND-11` (part: the routes, their chances, experimenting and hunch tries), `MAT-04` (part: unknown blueprints and side fits), `MND-06` (part: experience and skill rising, everyday work counting; fading in α12), `MND-10` (part: accidents and hints noticed), `MAT-21` (part: named discoveries with who, when, where, route, inputs and word; the book in α11b), `CUL-17` (part: coined words), `CUL-18` (part: named results), `MND-20` (part: the curious experiment more), `MND-07` (part: curiosity drives experiments), `MND-12` (part: dream hints tried), `RES-02` (part: the first flake in the sharp-stone setting, and its control), `RES-03` (part: discovery, routes and control; the whole rule in α12), `RCK-01` (part: the control), `RES-10` (part: the switch `experimenting`), `PRE-13` (part: crafts' routes findable), `PRN-01`.

**Architecture:** `A6.10`, `A6.9`, `A8.17`, `A8.13`, `A8.19`, `A8.15`, `A8.22`, `A9.3`, `A9.5`, `A14.8`, `A15.7`.

**Needs:** α10b.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-things` (`src/discovery.rs` new, `src/settle.rs`), `kd-people` (`src/discover/experiment.rs` new, `src/discover/hunch.rs`, `src/learn/learn.rs`, `src/learn/skill.rs` new, `src/choose/options.rs`, `src/purposes.rs`), `kd-culture` (`src/holders.rs` new, `src/names.rs`), `kd-data` (kind `Scene`'s `stop_after`), `kd-tools` (`kd scene run`'s stop), `kd-ui` (`src/views/thing_card.rs`, `src/views/person.rs`, `src/findable.rs`), `data/history/event_kinds.md`, `data/minds/thoughts.md`, `data/minds/memories.md`, `data/tuning/things.md`, `data/tuning/minds.md`, `data/tuning/culture.md`, `tests/fixtures/worlds/`, `scenes/`.

**Tasks:**
1. `T11a.1` **Rolls for unknown blueprints (`MAT-04`, `MND-11`, A6.10, A6.9).** `crates/kd-things/src/discovery.rs`: an unknown blueprint's level is the doer's sector experience halved (skill 0); its chance is A6.7's `chance` at that level × the mode's factor × the blueprint's `discovery` (1 unless tuned): accident 1/20 (every unknown blueprint under the action that an ended activity's things truly fit, α09's side fits at the last try, A6.9 step 4), experimenting 1/5, a hunch whose blueprint the things fit 1/2, beside a teacher 1 (α12); rolled once per blueprint per activity (`things.side_fit`, keyed on the doer, the activity's end second and the blueprint), the factors in `data/tuning/things.md` `[discovery]`.
   A success makes its result where the things allow, the core role's thing partly used, so a flint cobble cracking a nut on a boulder loses a flake, and reports `Seen::Accident { who, bp, result, route, inputs }`.
   A failure runs its failure kind on the things, and one with a `hint` sign reports `Seen::Hint { at, bp, sign }` (`sharp_crumbs`, `nibbled_edge`).
2. `T11a.2` **Noticing and learning (`MND-10`, `MND-11`, A8.17, A8.19, A14.8).** The doer notices an accident at α10a's surprise chance, 0.5 × (1 + curious ÷ 6), halved when busy at work, tired or frightened (`minds.notice_accident`, system 10, `None`).
   A noticed success calls α09's `learn(p, bp, How::Discovered(route), None, now)`: skill 1, how and when kept on the blueprint record, and now a `learned` event kept forever; it brings the memory `discovery` (importance 50) and the thought `made_a_discovery` (+8, 3 days), a strong outcome (a find) that α10b links to the act.
   A noticed hint gives a hunch of strength 30, source accident, and a surprise; an unnoticed success leaves its flake on the ground for others to find and copy.
   α07b's `data/history/event_kinds.md` gains the kinds this alpha logs: `learned` (each learner's first learning, kept forever), `people_first` and `world_first` (kept forever, first-able), and `hunch_tried` (logged); α11b gives them their patterns.
3. `T11a.3` **Experimenting (`MND-11`, `MND-20`, `MND-07`, `RES-10`, A8.17).** `crates/kd-people/src/discover/experiment.rs` adds the option `Experiment`: score = 10 × the curiosity need's weight × (1 + 0.25 × curious) × 1 in good times (mood above 50, no need below 40) or 0.3 otherwise, + 0.3 × the relief of a need below 20 that has no known answer, the experiment then aimed at it; `[experiment] base` in `data/tuning/minds.md` is tuned so a curious adult (+2) in good times experiments about once a day and an average one about once a week.
   The try: a hunch if they hold one (one thing in reach for each of its kinds or classes, plus the held tool and what the worked thing rests on); else a known action (α09's `actions_done`) on a thing like what it works on; else any base action, a done one twice as likely (`minds.experiment_pick`), on one or two things in reach whose seen values bear on the aimed need (food for hunger, warmth or burn for cold; any when not aimed), where they stand; three tries of that action.
   At its end A6 rolls every unknown blueprint the things fit at × 1/5, or × 1/2 for the hunch's own; every try still teaches the values its action shows (`MND-04`).
   A child's play with things becomes an experiment at chance 0.1 × (1 + 0.1 × playful) (A8.10).
   The switch `minds.experimenting` (A8.22), declared on α07c's `switches!`, removes the option when off.
4. `T11a.4` **Trying hunches (`MND-11`, `MND-12`, A8.17).** A held hunch adds the option `TryHunch`: score = the believed worth of its hinted result × strength ÷ 100 + 5 curiosity; each failure adds a failed try (10 drop it), a success learns it with the hunch's source as its route.
   Each try logs `hunch_tried { who, hunch, count }` (A8.17), and the third try of one hunch in a game day is the one α11b makes the director's sign.
5. `T11a.5` **Experience and skill (`MND-06`, `BIO-08`, A8.13).** `crates/kd-people/src/learn/skill.rs`: after each try of h hours, skill = 10.4 − (10.4 − skill) × e^(−0.0068 × h × m × L × a), m = 1 + 0.5 × the share of successes (× 4 when taught, α12), L the inborn learning speed (`BIO-08`), a = 1.5 under 14 and 0.7 over 45; `best` is kept for α12's fading.
   Sector experience rises the same way at half the rate from any work in the sector: blueprints by their sector, plain uses by α09's `data/actions.md` `sector`, and everyday work by its own (`MND-06`): α09b's care and α06c's attending a birth practise healing, so α06c's birth-helper factor (1 − 0.05 × the helper's healing experience) now acts.
6. `T11a.6` **Named discoveries and words (`MAT-21`, `CUL-17`, `CUL-18`, A9.3, A9.5).** `crates/kd-culture/src/holders.rs`: per people (the first region's one people since α06a, A9.4), the results its members ever made, and per blueprint the count of living holders, +1 at `learn`, −1 at death, from the learned and died events (A9.5).
   A first success at a result the people never made, other than a starting blueprint's, logs `people_first { who, bp, result, route, inputs, place, word }`, kept forever, and `world_first` if no people ever made it.
   Its word is coined in α06a's `src/names.rs` (A9.3): 60% the main input's material word with its main value's or action's word ("bite stone"), else a new two-syllable word in the language's shape (`culture.coin`, system 11, `None`), kept in the people's words; two coinages for one thing in a window resolve at the merge, the earlier winning, then the lower uid; the thing card shows it beside the English name: "Sharp flake · *kesh*, 'bite stone'".
7. `T11a.7` **The route of a discovery (`MND-11`, `MAT-21`, `PRE-13`, A8.17).** A discovery's route is its hunch's source (accident, dream, copying, seen made, told; sent dream from α16), else experimenting; it is kept on `learned` and `people_first`, and the person card's Crafts line reads "Sharp flake · skill 1 · found by accident while cracking nuts, Year 2".
   `World::record_kinds()` gains `cul.holders` and `cul.words`, with their `FINDABLE` lines (the Crafts line and the thing card; α12's craft and band cards take them over).
8. `T11a.8` **The first flake and the control (`RES-02`, `RES-03`, `RCK-01`, `MND-11`, A15.7).** α07c's scene format and `kd scene run` gain `stop_after = { event, result, plus, none_by }`: a run stops `plus` after the first such event, or at `none_by` if none came, never past `until`.
   The sharp-stone setting (`RES-02`), written once here and used unchanged by α12's permanent scene: the first region's river under the chalk escarpment; a band of 25 with the starting kit and knowledge in its cave; granite boulders as anvils at camp and on the gravel bar; hazel stands; 2 deer carcasses at camp at the start; dead wood; flint nodules in the chalk scree and flint cobbles in the gravel among granite, sandstone and quartzite cobbles (12 set at the gravel bar); start Year 1, summer, day 10.
   `scenes/a11a-first-flake.toml` (`base_seed = 2001`, `until = "7y"`, `stop_after = { event = "people_first", result = "sharp_flake", plus = "2y", none_by = "5y" }`; budget 0.5): measures from the log `first_flake_year` and `first_flake_route`; pass `discovery = "count(first_flake_year <= 5) >= 16"`, `routes = "distinct(first_flake_route) >= 2"` and `accident_and_experiment = "count(first_flake_route == accident) >= 2 and count(first_flake_route == experiment) >= 2"` (`MND-11`).
   `scenes/sharp-stone-control.toml` (id `sharp-stone-control`, permanent, `base_seed = 2001`): the same setting with every stone tagged `flaking_stone` replaced by granite and sandstone (`[setting] no_flaking_stone = true`: every deposit, exposure and placed item of those kinds yields `granite_cobble` or `sandstone_cobble` instead), `until = "7y"`; pass `none(flakes_made > 0)`; it runs from now on whenever minds, blueprints or catalogues change, and nightly from α12 (A15.6).
9. `T11a.9` **Scenes, the demo world and delivery (`MND-11`, `MND-06`, `PRC-11`).** Write and run the other scenes under Tests; the demo `a11a · Flint by the river` is the `a11a-first-flake` run whose first flake comes latest within its first two game years, one game day before that flake (the note names who and when; the `demo` key is set after the runs, being no pass rule).
   Holders, words and the blueprint records' routes change `cul.groups` and `people.lists`: migrations and fixture `a11a.kindling` (A14.9).
   Golden `first-flake-card` (the discoverer's flake card with its word); `versionCode=2111`, `versionName=a11a`; `bench/cloud/a11a.json` adds side fits with unknown blueprints (A6.16: at most 4 µs an activity) and experiments a person a day; then P0's steps 5 to 8.

**Tests:**

**On the phone:**
1. Open the alpha link; Make test world `a11a · Flint by the river` (the note says who will find the flake and about when; it takes up to a minute to build), then open it from Worlds.
2. At camp zoom with the dial at about an hour a minute, watch people crack nuts on the boulders with stones.

**Risks:** discovery too fast or slow for `TIM-19`'s Years 1–5: only the factors, the noticing chance, the experimenting rate and the dream rate are tuned, on the 20 tuning seeds, and logged (`RES-16`), never the pass rule; side fits costing more than A6.16's 4 µs an activity: about 7 blueprints an action; experiments making absurd fits: α09's expected-fits check blocks any fit not named; the first-flake runs taking 0.5 session-hours: they run once here and in α11b, and nightly from α12.

### α11b The book of ages and the director (about 5.5 hours)

**Goal:** the first sharp flake becomes a dated entry in the book of ages, written from pattern sentences, and the story director slows time for it within one budget, shows it as a live moment you can tap, and lets you skip to the next one.

**Serves:** `PRE-05` (part: entries by date and by people, each opening what it names), `PRE-37` (part: pattern sentences for the book, moments and card lines), `PRE-39` (part: named discoveries, other firsts, crafts lost and found again, and the age a step of the arc begins), `MAT-21` (part: major and short entries), `PRE-08`, `TIM-02` (part: this stage's moments, the hunch and badly-wounded signs, the one budget; the stalk sign in α12c), `TIM-11`, `TIM-15` (part: skip in the order), `TIM-03`, `PRE-06` (part: followed people's births and deaths as moments, and a death offering their closest), `TIM-09` (part: the last death's entry, moment and choice; α06c keeps the world running), `PRE-40` (part: the live-moment setting), `PRE-19` (part: the documentary voice in patterns), `TIM-14` (part: dates in texts), `RES-25` (part: entries and moments a year recorded), `PRE-13` (part: book entries and waiting moments findable).

**On the phone:**
1. Open the alpha link; Make test world `a11b · Before the first flake`, then open it from Worlds.
2. Zoom out to the valley and tap the skip button: time races, then slows, and a banner reads that the first sharp flake was struck.
3. Tap the banner: the camera flies to close camp, onto the knapper and her flake.
4. Open the views and the book of ages: the entry for the first flake with its date, place and word, and "The age of *kesh*" above it; tap her name to open her card.
5. In settings, set live moments to "fewer", then skip again: it now runs to the next moment past the higher bar, or a game year.

**Not in this alpha:** the writer AI's rewording (α35a); the record of your acts and its marked lines (α16); disasters (α20a, α20b); peoples, villages and wars, and the ages they begin (α36b, α46a, α39b); the stalk sign (α12c), the storm sign (α13) and the hostile-sighting sign (α39a); overnight mode and its summary (α43a); the tabs for graves and old camps (α24b).

**Risks:** too many moments early on, when every kind is new: the score halves for a kind seen in the last game year and the bar rises as you look closer, both tuned with the owner at the stage review (α12d); the director's real-time clock leaking into the world: its state lives outside the world and `kd det` compares runs with it on and off; patterns reading stiffly: 5 phrasings each, judged by the owner at the stage review (`RES-22`).

### α12 Teaching and the bands (about 5.5 hours)

**Goal:** people watch and teach each other, so a craft spreads through a band, skills fade unused, a craft dies with its last holder and is marked lost until found again, every world starts with 3–4 bands living side by side, run in parallel, and from now on the sharp-stone test and the island's whole worlds run every night.

**Tasks:**
1. `T12.1` **Teaching on α06b's shared activity (`MND-13`, `TIM-17`, `RES-10`, A4.4, A8.19).** α06b's `Shared` record (A4.4: kind, host, place, planned end, fewest, members with a part), which help and attending a birth already use, carries teaching, with the parts `teach` and `learn`: each joins and leaves by the usual rules, an interruption taking out only the one interrupted with the share of their own time (`Partial::Share`); below its fewest (2) it ends for all at that second; results land for each as they leave or as it ends, in uid order; a member more than 1.5 km from its place leaves it (A4.4).
   `crates/kd-people/src/learn/teach.rs`: someone who knows a blueprint, believes a person lacks it (α10b's bit) and wants them to (α10b's `kin_weight`, friends included; the kind at +0.15 a level; for a gift from α30a) gets the option `teach(learner, bp)`, scored by the learner's believed worth of its results × those weights; the learner, within 20 m and with no urgent need, gets the option to join, scored by their own worth of it and belonging.
   It lasts up to an hour: the teacher shows (`teach`), the learner tries at the full chance, factor 1 even before knowing it (A6.10's teacher factor), at their own level; each try gains skill × 4 × (1 + 0.05 × (teacher's skill − learner's)); the first success makes it known through `learn(.., How::Taught, Some(teacher), ..)`, and a learner called away keeps the skill reached (`TIM-17`).
   Both set the who-knows-what bit; memories `taught` (15) and `learned_from` (25); thought `taught_someone` (+3, a day); the switch `minds.teaching` (A8.22, on α07c's `switches!`) removes the option when off.
2. `T12.2` **Watching (`MND-13`, `MND-24`, `MND-26`, A8.19).** `crates/kd-people/src/learn/watch.rs`: the option `watch(holder, bp)` toward someone within 20 m using a blueprint the watcher lacks, scored by curiosity relief 6 × (1 + 0.25 × curious) + 0.3 × the result's worth, × (1 + the holder's skill ÷ 10) × (1 + kin weight), × 1.5 for children.
   Each use watched counts 1, a use a kin points out 1.5 (shared attention, `MND-26`), a use seen at a glance while busy 0.25; the first gives α10a's seen-made hunch, and 5 make it known at skill 1 through `learn(.., How::Watched, Some(holder), ..)`; children count 1.5 times; a known blueprint watched in more skilled hands adds 0.02 skill a use, up to that skill − 1.
3. `T12.3` **Fading, lost and found again (`MND-06`, `CUL-02`, A8.13, A9.5).** In the wake job, a blueprint or sector unused for over 30 game days loses 0.01 a day, never below half its best (A8.13).
   When a death takes a people's holder count of a blueprint to 0 (α11a's `holders.rs`), `kd-culture` logs `craft_lost { people, bp, last_holder }`, kept forever; a later `learn` of it in that people by any route logs `craft_regained { route }`, and α11b's recogniser marks the book's entry "found again"; the moment scores 45; things the lost craft made stay and can still be copied (α10a).
4. `T12.4` **The start's 3–4 bands and band routes (`SCP-01`, `BIO-03`, `BIO-20`, `CUL-01`, A8.8, A9.4, A9.5).** `crates/kd-people/src/setup.rs` makes 3 or 4 bands (`setup.bands`, keyed) by calling α06a's `first_band` once for each, 45–120 people in all, then gives 1 adult in 3 a sibling in another band (their made-up parents shared, A8.8) and checks `BIO-03`'s shares over the whole start.
   Each band has its own cave or overhang among the preset's 6 caves and 4 shelters, at least 5 km from the next, so each starts in its own cluster (A4.8's `L` = 4 km), with water within 2 km (`WLD-24`); each adult knows its home range within 10 km as about 40 places (α04a) and where the other bands camp (`BIO-20`); kin across bands are known as kin, with a few acquaintances.
   α06a's `crates/kd-culture/src/groups.rs` holds one band record per band (A9.4), each named from its home's place name (A9.3, "the Hazel band"); all belong to the one people.
   Band routes (`CUL-01`, A9.5): the 03:00 band batch marks, for each result its members made by more than one route in the last game year, the route most used, which `GroupView::band_route` gives, and an option making a result by its band's route scores 10% higher (A8.15, tuned); `pointed_stick`'s two routes are the first.
5. `T12.5` **Parallel clusters (`TIM-16`, `RES-05`, A4.8, A3.4).** α03c's `crates/kd-sim/src/cluster.rs` (positions at the barrier, union-find over 2,048 m squares joining beings within `L = 4.0 km`, ranks as uid lanes, reservations and spills) now runs its clusters in parallel: `cluster/split.rs` (new) builds the owner table at the barrier and lends each cluster its stores, the simulation's only `unsafe` code (the module opens with `#![allow(unsafe_code)]` over α00's crate-wide `deny`, and `tools/layers.toml` already names it in `unsafe_files`), checked on every access in debug and test builds (A4.16's cluster audit); pending events move to their new cluster's heap with keys unchanged; outputs merge in rank order (A4.8 step 1); `Pool::run` uses α07c's `Workers` on the phone and in `kd` and `Serial` on the web and in tests, clusters started largest first by last window's event count (A4.15).
6. `T12.6` **Craft and band cards (`PRE-35`, `PRE-13`, A12.4).** `crates/kd-ui/src/views/craft_card.rs`, from `Query::Craft { kind, people }` (a thing card's "made by" line or a band card's crafts): the result's name and the people's word, its holders with their skill, the line of teaching back to its first maker from the `learned` events (who taught or was watched by whom, by which route), and when it was lost and found again.
   `crates/kd-ui/src/views/band_card.rs`, from a person card or a tap on a camp at camp or valley zoom: name and meaning, home, adults and children, crafts with how many hold each and the band's route, members, and kin in other bands.
   `World::record_kinds()` gains `cul.routes`, and α06a's `cul.groups` and α11a's `cul.holders` and `cul.words` move to these cards in `FINDABLE`.
7. `T12.7` **The permanent sharp-stone test (`RES-02`, `RES-03`, `RCK-01`, `MAT-21`, A15.7).** `scenes/sharp-stone.toml` (id `sharp-stone`; its rules fixed here, before its first run, and run unchanged at every stage after, `RES-09`): α11a's sharp-stone setting, 20 runs from `base_seed = 2001`, `until = "7y"`, `stop_after = { event = "people_first", result = "sharp_flake", plus = "2y", none_by = "5y" }`, budget 1 (A15.7), `checks = ["RES-02", "RES-03", "RCK-01", "MND-11"]`; measures `first_flake_year` and `first_flake_route` from the book (`kind = "named_discovery"`, result `sharp_flake`, `MAT-21`) and `share_of_adults_making_flakes_2y_after_first` from state (adults holding `flake_by_striking`, `MND-06`); pass `discovery = "count(first_flake_year <= 5) >= 16"`, `spread = "count(first_flake_year <= 5 and share_of_adults_making_flakes_2y_after_first >= 0.75) >= 16"` and `routes = "distinct(first_flake_route) >= 2"`; α11a's `sharp-stone-control` is its control (`RCK-01`).
8. `T12.8` **The nightly runs (`RES-02`, `RES-07`, `RES-21`, `RES-12`, `PLT-05`, A15.6, A15.8).** `tools/nightly.sh` runs A15.6's nightly set on the latest `main`: `sharp-stone` and `sharp-stone-control`; every scene outside the quick set, except that `a11a-first-flake`, whose setting, seeds, `until` and `stop_after` are `sharp-stone`'s, is judged on `sharp-stone`'s 20 runs instead of running them a second time (each keeps its own pass rules, `RES-09`); the switch-off runs; `kd det`'s long forms (every quick scene across targets and both profiles, A15.9); and the pace worlds, 20 first-region worlds with their 3–4 bands (`kd world new --land first_region`, A15.8's stand-in until α27b), each run to Year 60 (`kd world run`, about 2 session-hours in all), read for `TIM-19`'s flakes window (Years 1–5) by `RES-07`'s rule (at least half inside it) and for entries and moments a year (`RES-25`).
   α07a's `kd world run` gains A15.8's checks at each checkpoint: the save reopened in another process, `tests/oddities.toml` (`RES-12`'s never-rules so far: starving beside known food, a thing without a source, a flake before Year 1, one activity repeated over 6 times an hour for an hour, a save that will not reopen) and `tests/ranges.toml` (births, deaths and people per game year, from α07e's decade scene), and `progress.json`.
   Runs start detached (`setsid nohup`); the session wakes itself every 30 minutes with `send_later` to restart any stopped world; results and a small `status.json` are committed to the `runs` branch, never to `main` (A15.8).
   The nights are a Routine (`create_trigger`, a fresh session each night on `main`), set up once with the owner's OK, which this alpha's note asks for; until then each alpha's session starts `tools/nightly.sh` in the background as it begins, so the runs cost it no working hours, and the next session reads their results first (A15.12).
9. `T12.9` **Movements, scenes, the demo world and delivery (`MND-13`, `PRE-44`, `PRC-11`).** `data/models/movements.md` gains `teach` (kneeling beside the learner, pointing at the work; 3 key poses) and `watch` (crouched, the head following the work; 2 key poses).
   Scene settings take `bands` with several entries, each at its own cave, and `[[setting.adjust]]` gains `hunch = { bp, source, strength }`; `died_before` of a holder logs the `craft_lost` it brings before the start, as the hooks would.
   Write and run the scenes under Tests; `a12-four-bands` is the demo.
   Bands, routes and the blueprint records' teachers change `cul.groups` and `people.lists`: migrations and fixture `a12.kindling` (A14.9).
   Golden `four-camps` (the valley stop over the escarpment's camps); `versionCode=2120`, `versionName=a12`; `bench/cloud/a12.json` adds the four-band world on 1 and 4 workers, the largest cluster's share and µs a person a game day against A8.21's 1.1 ms; then P0's steps 5 to 8.
