**On the phone:**
1. Open the alpha link; in Settings long-press the version line, tap Make test world and pick `a19a · Generated` (it first generates seed 1, about 20 seconds), then open it from Worlds.
2. The world opens at camp zoom on a band at its cave or overhang in generated land, with its river, cliff and woods.
3. Follow someone to the river: they wade at a ford; set the dial to about a day every 10 seconds and watch walks over hills and along the valley.
4. Drag the camera along the river for a minute: the land keeps coming, the river unbroken, the cliff with its gaps; tap the ground: the place card gives its rock layers, soil, deposits and the season's climate.
5. Worlds → New generated world (test) with seed 2: after the progress line another world opens at its own stand-in start, or says it has none.

**Not in this alpha:** zooming out past the valley to the region, map and globe (α19b); fast saves, dormant blocks and storage warnings for a whole world (α19c); weather, water, plants and herds running beyond the active window (α20a, α20c, α21, α22a); the start region by scoring, the best three worlds and settling (α27a, α27b).

**Risks:** areas by generated cliffs and caves over their 400 ms: buckets nearest the view centre come first and slow pieces are timed in the bench (A5.5); world paths over their 100 µs average: the block grid and the cache, timed in the cloud bench (A5.12); the stub finding no window in some seeds: those seeds say so, the scenes use seed 1, and α27a's must-haves reject such worlds; the blob outgrowing 1 MB with cut lands: cuts are compressed and as small as their scenes need, and only demo, bench and review scenes' lands enter the blob.

### α19b From person to globe (about 5.5 hours)

**Goal:** one pinch takes you from a person chipping flint out through the camp, valley, region and world map to the whole turning globe and back, over generated land you have never visited, with time running faster the further out you look, and the map look can show what a person or band knows of the land and who knows a craft.

### α19c A whole world kept (about 3.5 hours)

**Goal:** a generated world with its people saves without a stutter and opens within a second: only what changed is written, old packs are compacted, kept areas nobody is near sleep on disk until someone comes back, a slim copy remakes the land from its seed, the phone warns before it runs out of space, and a world too big for memory pauses instead of crashing.

**Serves:** `WLD-12` (part: kept areas and dormant blocks at world scale), `WLD-13` (part: dormant kept areas drawn without waking them), `PLT-04` (part: saving and opening a whole world), `PLT-07` (part: saves every 30 s on a whole world), `PLT-10` (part: the storage warning and each world's sizes), `PLT-05` (part: slim test worlds of generated land), `MND-15` (part: the memory-limit pause), `PRE-13` (part: dormant things findable).

**Architecture:** `A14.3`, `A14.4`, `A14.5`, `A14.10`, `A14.11`, `A14.12`, `A5.4`, `A4.11`, `A11.5`, `A16.4`, `A16.5`.

**Needs:** α19b, with α07a's saving, packs, migrations and `KDX1` container, α07b's Worlds list, α04a's kept areas and `kept_view`, α03a's `advance_to` with its `BlockReader` (`NoBlocks` until now), α02b's view builders, and α19a's whole generated worlds.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-save` (`src/dirty.rs` new, `src/compact.rs` new, `src/blocks.rs` new: `Blocks` and the `BlockReader`; α07a's `src/save.rs`, `src/open.rs`, `src/container.rs`), `kd-world` (α04a's `src/area/kept.rs`: packing a dormant area), `kd-sim` (dirty bits on every store; dormant blocks in `advance_to`), `kd-app` (the I/O thread's read-ahead; the memory watch and pause; the storage check), `kd-ui` (α07b's `src/views/worlds.rs`: sizes and the storage sheet; `src/findable.rs`), `kd-tools` (`kd world export --slim` for generated worlds), `data/tuning/save.md`, `tests/fixtures/worlds/`, `scenes/`.

**Tasks:**
1. `T19c.1` **Dirty chunks (`PLT-04`, `PLT-07`, A14.3, A14.4, A16.5).** `kd-save/src/dirty.rs`: one dirty bit per chunk; the clock, queue heads, weather, player and history head are written at every save and the rest only when dirty (A14.3), each store setting its bits as it writes; `world.cells` stays per region (A5.2's 34 bytes a cell, about 68 MB raw and 20 MB compressed for a whole world), each region dirty after its daily slot; the save buffer is sized to the largest dirty save (A14.4).
   Targets for a whole world with about 100 people (A16.5): present state at most 60 MB on disk, an autosave pausing the world at most 50 ms and writing at most 30 MB, opening within 1.0 s from tap to first frame.
2. `T19c.2` **Compaction (`PLT-10`, A14.4).** `kd-save/src/compact.rs`: when packs hold over twice the live bytes plus 64 MB, a save copies the emptiest pack's live chunks, as stored, at most 64 MB a save, and the emptied pack is removed with the manifests that name it (A14.4's step 5).
3. `T19c.3` **Dormant kept-area blocks (`WLD-12`, `WLD-13`, A5.4, A14.12, A11.5).** A game day after the last person leaves (beyond about 1 km), a kept area's things leave their slots (A3.4) and it is packed into its block's chunks (`area.head`, `area.marks`, `area.things`, and `things.area`, which α07a left for this alpha); `kd-save/src/blocks.rs`'s `Blocks` serves A14.12's `BlockReader` to α03a's `advance_to`, read ahead within 2 km of people on the I/O thread, a late read making the world wait, never changing it (A5.4).
   α02b's view builders read dormant blocks through `Blocks` and bring them to `T_d` with α04a's `kept_view` on copies, so old camps show their marks and looking wakes nothing (`WLD-13`).
   `World::record_kinds()` gains `things.area`, with its `FINDABLE` line (the thing card, from the area's picture).
4. `T19c.4` **Slim copies of generated worlds (`PLT-05`, A14.10, A15.8).** α07a's slim export leaves out `world.fixed`, which import now remakes by `gen::generate` from the world's seed at its generator version and checks by hash (an island by `lands::build`, as before; a world of an older generator opens read-only, A14.10); `kd world export --slim` makes the `runs` branch's test worlds of generated land (A15.8).
5. `T19c.5` **Storage warnings and sizes (`PLT-10`, A14.11).** Free space is checked before every save and every 10 minutes: under 5 GB, a notice once a session; under the larger of 1 GB and twice the next save plus 256 MB, the world pauses and the storage sheet (α07b's `views/worlds.rs`) lists what could be deleted, with sizes, deleting nothing without your tap and confirmation (A14.11); Worlds shows each world's present state, kept areas, history and safety copy.
6. `T19c.6` **The memory-limit pause (`MND-15`, A4.11, A16.4).** `kd-app` reads the process's memory each second (`/proc/self/statm`; on the web, `heap_bytes`): under pressure the renderer's caches go first, then held area parts; at 6 GiB everything that can go without changing results goes, with a warning; at 7 GiB the world pauses with a notice offering its book of ages or a new world (A4.11, A16.4); memory never changes what happens (`PRN-11`).
7. `T19c.7` **Scenes, the demo world and delivery (`PLT-04`, `WLD-12`, `PRC-11`, A14.9, A15.10).** The dirty bits and `things.area` change the save: migrations (an older save's chunks all dirty; no dormant blocks) and fixture `a19c.kindling`, an island world with one dormant block (A14.9).
   Write and run the scenes under Tests; `a19c-season-on-generated-land` is the demo.
   Goldens `worlds-sizes` and `storage-sheet`; `versionCode=4193`, `versionName=a19c`; `bench/cloud/a19c.json` adds the whole world's autosave pause and bytes, its opening time and its sizes on disk against A16.5's `MIL-04` column; then P0's steps 5 to 8.

**Data:**
- `data/tuning/save.md`: `[dirty]`, `[compact]` (twice the live bytes plus 64 MB, 64 MB a save), `[dormant]` (a game day, read-ahead 2 km), `[storage]` (5 GB notice, 1 GB and twice the next save plus 256 MB), `[memory]` (6 and 7 GiB).
- `tests/fixtures/worlds/a19c.kindling`.
- Scenes: `a19c-season-on-generated-land` (demo).

**Tests:**
- Unit, `crates/kd-save/tests/whole_world.rs`: `only_dirty_chunks_written`; `compaction_keeps_every_live_chunk`; `dormant_block_read_on_demand_equals_live`; `late_block_makes_the_world_wait_never_differ`; `slim_generated_world_remade_by_hash`; `storage_warning_before_full` (a `Storage` stub whose free space falls); `memory_pause_at_7_gib` (a counting stub).
- `kd det` (A15.9): a camera parked over 100 dormant kept areas of a generated world leaves the state hash unchanged, each view equal to what a person arriving finds (A5.4, `WLD-13`).
- α07a's `kd kill-test --kills 100` on a whole generated world: the newest committed save always opens, undamaged (`PLT-07`).
- Fixture `a19c.kindling` opens through its migrations and runs a game day.
- Scenes:
  - `a19c-season-on-generated-land` (`WLD-12`, `PLT-04`; `base_seed = 19600`; 20 runs; `generated = { seed = 1 }`; until 60 game days; budget 0.3; `quick = false`): each run saved, dropped and reopened every 10 game days; pass `all(state_hash_equals_the_unbroken_run)` and `count(a_dormant_block_was_read_back) >= 10`; demo `a19c · A season on generated land` (run 1, day 60, 18:00).
- Bench (A16.5): a whole generated world with about 100 people: autosave pause within 50 ms and 30 MB written, opening within 1.0 s, present state within 60 MB and kept areas within 20 MB on disk.

**On the phone:**
1. Open the alpha link; in Settings long-press the version line, tap Make test world and pick `a19c · A season on generated land`, then open it from Worlds.
2. Set the dial to about a day every 10 seconds for a minute: the picture never stutters as the world autosaves.
3. Close the app from the app switcher and reopen it: the world opens where it was within about a second.
4. Open Worlds: the world shows its present state, kept areas and history sizes.
5. Pan to a camp the band left days ago: its hearth, heaps and trodden ground show as they were left.

**Not in this alpha:** export and import on the phone (α53a); weather, water, plants and herds beyond the active window (α20a, α20c, α21, α22a).

**Risks:** an autosave over 50 ms at speed when every region is dirty: the save buffer copies raw encodings on the four workers and compression waits for the I/O thread (A14.4), measured in the bench; a dormant block read late every time a band walks fast: read-ahead at 2 km covers a walk's next half hour, and a late read only makes the world wait.

### α20a Weather everywhere (about 5 hours)

**Goal:** every place on the world has hourly weather from its own climate: storms crossing continents, wet windward slopes and dry lees, droughts and cold snaps in bad years, springs and streams that run on or dry up, ice on lakes and rivers, wildfires running across cells, and a moon bright enough to walk by with the odd eclipse, all shown on a weather overlay.

**Serves:** `WLD-16`, `WLD-22` (part: storms, droughts, cold snaps, harsh winters and wildfires from the world's systems), `WLD-28` (part: wildfire on every cell), `WLD-17` (part: soil and ground water, springs, streams and river and lake ice everywhere), `WLD-07` (part: the moon in rules, eclipses, and daylight on generated worlds), `WLD-01` (part: weather ends at the polar ice), `WLD-30` (part: dry spells and cold outbreaks at Earth's yearly rates), `TIM-07` (part: the world alone), `TIM-18` (part: dry spells at six times life's pace), `PRE-07` (part: the weather and seasons overlay), `PRE-39` (part: droughts as disasters), `TIM-02` (part: those disasters touching people), `SND-11` (part: rain by what it falls on, waves, the sea, snow), `PLT-04` (part: the world alone measured), `PRE-13` (part: spells findable).

**Architecture:** `A5.8`, `A5.9`, `A5.10`, `A5.11`, `A3.7`, `A4.9`, `A7.5`, `A8.9`, `A10.7`, `A11.4`, `A12.3`, `A12.5`, `A13.7`, `A15.8`, `A16.3`.

**Needs:** α19c, with α13's hourly weather, storms, anomalies, snow, climate records and `light_at`, α03a's sun and moon (`kd_core::sky`, its `eclipse` 0 until now), α14b's fire in the land and its disaster recogniser, α16c's place slots, α19b's overlay frame, and α12's nightly runs (`tools/nightly.sh`).

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-core` (α03a's `src/sky.rs`: eclipses), `kd-world` (α13's `src/weather/hourly.rs`, `src/weather/storms.rs` and `src/weather/daily.rs`; `src/weather/spells.rs` new; `src/water/ground.rs` new: soil and ground water, springs and streams; α14b's `src/fire.rs`; `src/purposes.rs`), `kd-life` (α14b's `src/fire/front.rs`: fuel by every biome's cover), `kd-sim` (world-wide batches, the weather overlay, `light_at` by moonlight, the `spells` scene key), `kd-people` (α04c's `src/sense.rs`: moonlight), `kd-player` (α14b's disaster recogniser: droughts), `kd-render` (river and lake ice, eclipses), `kd-audio` (α16c's `src/plan/place.rs`), `kd-ui` (the overlay legend, `src/findable.rs`), `kd-tools` (`kd world check --weather`), `tools/nightly.sh`, `data/tuning/world.md`, `data/sounds/ambience.md`, `data/director/moments.md`, `data/text/disasters.md`, `data/history/event_kinds.md`, `tests/earth_climate.toml` new, `tests/fixtures/worlds/`, `scenes/lands/`, `scenes/`.

**Tasks:**
1. `T20a.1` **α13's weather over the whole world (`WLD-16`, `WLD-01`, A5.8, A5.9).** α13's hourly step (`weather::hourly`, A5.8: 4 jobs by rows of weather cells) runs on all 20,000 weather cells of a generated world, sea included, from α18c's climate records, ending α19a's active window for weather; fronts are born only over sea cells and showers anywhere, at α18c's calibrated rates, and storms end on reaching the middle of the polar ice instead of a void cell (`WLD-01`), about 400 at once.
   α13's `local` reads each generated cell's `clim` and `hollow` as it reads the island's, so windward slopes are wetter, lees drier and hollows colder on clear, calm nights (`WLD-16`); island worlds go on as before; budget 4 ms a game hour on a held middle core (A5.9).
2. `T20a.2` **Droughts, cold snaps and stalled rain (`WLD-22`, `WLD-30`, `GOD-05`, A5.8).** α13's anomalies (a warmth and a wetness per region and season, persistence 0.8) are blended between neighbouring regions by distance; a wetness 1.5 spreads below normal starts a drought through `weather::start_drought(s, at, stretch, days)` over the region's driest stretch, kept as `Spell { kind: Drought, stretch, from, until }` (`weather/spells.rs`, A5.8), so no storm rains inside its stretch while it lasts; cold outbreaks come at each climate's cold-outbreak days through `weather::start_cold_snap`, down to the season's record low, with frost only where that season has frost; `weather::end_spell` ends either early; and in calm, moist air a shower stalls over its weather cell for 1–24 hours through `weather::start_rain`, snow if cold (A5.8).
   Harsh winters stay α13's warmth anomalies, logged as `harsh_winter`.
   So droughts, harsh winters, cold snaps and long rains come per game year about as often as on Earth per year (`WLD-22`, `WLD-30`), and α20b's powers call the same functions; new purposes of system 2: `weather.drought_start`, `weather.drought_len`, `weather.cold_snap`, `weather.stall` (fortune `None`).
3. `T20a.3` **Soil water, springs, streams and ice (`WLD-17`, `TIM-18`, A5.10, A5.11, A4.9).** α13's daily cell job (snow and fuel dryness) and α05's degree-days run on every land cell in A4.9's region slots, and the job gains `kd-world/src/water/ground.rs`: soil and ground water by soil kind, rain and melt soaking in up to α02a's intake and capacity in `data/world/soils.md` (less on clay and frozen ground), the rest running off, excess soil water sinking to ground water, evaporation by warmth, wind and dry air (A5.10, A5.11); springs at slope feet and in limestone fed by ground water; each stream's flow (`stream`) from its drainage × the day's runoff and spring water per km² of its catchment, so a small rain-fed stream dries in a dry spell while a spring-fed one runs, ground water and springs falling about six times as fast a day as in life (`TIM-18`); and ice on lakes and rivers thickening with the square root of frost degree-days, melting with warmth and bearing a person from 10 cm, which α19a's ways open and the picture draws in the ice ladder; all within 30 ms a game day (A5.9).
   Rivers keep their rated levels and lakes their generated ones until α20c's routing.
4. `T20a.4` **Wildfire on every cell (`WLD-28`, `WLD-30`, A5.9, A7.5).** α14b's cell fire (the burning list, fronts, embers, lightning far from people and the after) runs on every land cell of a generated world, its fuel load and speed read from each biome's cover through A7.5: desert, ice and bare rock never burn, tundra burns slowly, grassland and savanna fastest; one job in time order within 5 µs a cell-hour.
   α14b's lightning base stays unless the world-alone check below finds a biome outside `WLD-28`'s intervals; then it and the fuel speeds are retuned on tuning seeds and logged (`RES-16`), never to fit a scene.
5. `T20a.5` **The moon in rules, and eclipses (`WLD-07`, A3.7, A8.9, A11.4).** α03a's `kd_core::sky::sun_moon` runs on a generated world's own `Sky` (α18a's tilt of 15–30° and drawn moon); its `eclipse`, 0 until now, becomes A3.7's share of the sun hidden at a new moon, or of the moon at a full one, while the moon lies within the node cycle's window of the sun's path, the node period's range in `[sky]` tuned so each place on any world sees 2–8 eclipses in 70 game years (`WLD-07`); the picture's light dims by it (A11.4).
   The moon in rules: α13's `light_at` gives `Dim`, not `Dark`, at night under a moon at least three-quarters lit and above the horizon with cloud under 0.5, and α04c's night factor on far sight (A8.9's × 0.1) rises to × 0.3 under it (tuned), so a full moon is bright enough to walk and hunt by (`WLD-07`); polar days and nights follow the world's tilt, and the time control's light and moon follow the camera's latitude.
6. `T20a.6` **The weather overlay, sounds and droughts as disasters (`PRE-07`, `SND-11`, `PRE-39`, `TIM-02`, `PRE-13`, A12.3, A13.7, A12.5, A10.7).** `OverlayAsk::Weather { field: Temperature | Rain | Snow | Wind | Drought, normal: bool }` (`PRE-07`): now, or the season's normal from the record, per weather cell, with point marks for storms.
   α16c's place slots (`data/sounds/ambience.md`, `kd-audio/src/plan/place.rs`, its `rain` and `flow` generators) gain the sea and waves on shores and lakes by wind, rain by what it falls on (leaves, ground, water, snow), snow of 10 cm or more damping the world bus above 2 kHz by 6 dB, and a storm's rumble at the valley stop (A13.7; A13.15's `MIL-04` row, wind by cover following with α21).
   α14b's `Disaster` recogniser (A12.5) gains the drought: a death by thirst or hunger, or a camp emptied as α14b counts it, inside a drought's stretch while it lasts or within 5 days after (`PRE-39`); a drought's start over a band's home range logs `drought` (α07b's event-kind table, kept forever when it touches people), with the pattern `drought` in α14b's `data/text/disasters.md` (5 phrasings and a short form) and the director's moment `disaster_drought` (base 60, lasting about a day, A10.7), beside α14b's `disaster_wildfire` and `disaster_winter`, which harsh winters keep using.
   `World::record_kinds()` gains `world.spells`, with its `FINDABLE` line (the weather overlay's drought layer and the place card's weather line); the cells' soil water, ground water, stream flow and ice, kept since α02a, now show on the place card's water line.
7. `T20a.7` **The world alone, scenes, the demo world and delivery (`TIM-07`, `PLT-04`, `RES-13`, `PRC-11`, A16.3, A15.8, A15.10).** The cloud bench gains the world with nobody in it (seed 1): game years a real minute on two cloud cores against `TIM-07`'s 10, each layer's cost against A5.9's lines, and the 1,000-person world read against the stage's 1.7 game years a real minute by A16.3's model with the measured world layers.
   α12's `tools/nightly.sh` gains `--world-alone`: 20 generated worlds on fixed seeds run 100 game years with nobody in them (about 3.5 CPU-hours, in the session's background as A15.8 runs whole worlds), checked at 10, 20 and 100 game years by `kd world check --weather` and the checks later alphas add; this alpha's are under Tests.
   Scene settings gain `spells = [{ kind = "drought" | "cold_snap", around, km, days_left }]`, a spell under way at the start (an addition to A15.7, written into the architecture in this branch, `RES-18`).
   Spells join `world.sparse`: a migration (no spell under way) and fixture `a20a.kindling` (A14.9); no kind of material, plant or animal changes, so this is a small update.
   Write and run the scenes under Tests; `a20a-fire-and-river` is the demo.
   Goldens `ice-on-the-river`, `eclipse-noon` and `overlay-rain`; `versionCode=4201`, `versionName=a20a`; `bench/cloud/a20a.json` adds the hourly step on 20,000 weather cells, the daily cells, the world alone and the stage line's model; then P0's steps 5 to 8.

**On the phone:**
1. Open the alpha link; in Settings long-press the version line, tap Make test world and pick `a20a · Grass fire`, then open it from Worlds.
2. At valley zoom with the dial at about an hour a second: the fire front runs across the grass downwind, smoke leaning, passes round the camp's bare ground and stops at the river.
3. Worlds → New generated world (test) with seed 1; pinch out to the region and open Views → Overlays → Weather → Rain: storms show as patches moving with the wind across the region.
4. Switch the overlay to Season normal → Winter → Snow: snow on the ranges and in the far north; then to Drought: any region in a drought this year shows shaded, often far from the camp.
5. Pinch back in on the band's camp at night under a full moon: the land is lit silver and people still walk about.

**Not in this alpha:** rivers rising, floods, lakes filling, seas and salt water (α20c); quakes, eruptions, and your rain, storm, drought and cold snap powers (α20b); plants of every biome regrowing after fire (α21); herds fleeing fire (α22b).

**Risks:** the hourly step over budget on 20,000 cells: 4 jobs by rows and the day's sun cached per row; storms running in straight tracks: the belts move with the season and each storm takes the wind at its centre; event rates off Earth's: tuned per storm and per spell on tuning seeds, read by the world-alone check; the world-alone set's 3.5 CPU-hours: it runs in the background, and results that land after the merge are flagged in the note and the next alpha's.

### α20b Quakes, eruptions and your weather powers (about 5 hours)

**Goal:** rare quakes shake the land along faults, gusts and quakes topple stacks and drop rocks, volcanoes rumble for days before lava and ash pour out, and from the powers ring you can now bring rain, a storm, a drought or a cold snap, or set off a quake or an eruption, each only where nature could, each with its page of what followed.

**Serves:** `WLD-15`, `GOD-02` (part: rain, storm, drought, cold snap, quake and eruption), `GOD-05` (part: the new powers natural, within each climate's worst year), `GOD-10` (part: drawing a stretch, choosing how long, ending early, faults and volcanoes at region zoom), `GOD-11` (part: the new powers' reasons), `GOD-09` (part: pages for weather and land), `GOD-06` (part: the new powers never known), `GOD-07` (part: marked lines only), `WLD-22` (part: quakes and eruptions), `MAT-11` (part: toppling and falling rocks in gusts and quakes), `BIO-18` (part: eruption warnings noticed), `WLD-27` (part: ash enriching soil), `MAT-08` (part: ash and lava burying things), `SCP-09` (part: no power reshapes land), `PRE-39` (part: quake and eruption disasters), `PRE-13` (part: fresh lava rock findable).

**Architecture:** `A5.8`, `A5.1`, `A5.4`, `A6.5`, `A4.7`, `A4.9`, `A3.3`, `A10.1`, `A10.2`, `A10.5`, `A10.6`, `A10.7`, `A12.2`, `A12.4`, `A12.5`.

**Needs:** α20a, with α16's ring, record of acts, act pages and `crates/kd-sim/tests/never_known.rs`, α11b's `PlayerView`, α08's `kd-things/src/physics.rs`, α18a's faults and volcanoes, α18c's worst years, α13's gusts and α10a's loud events.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-world` (`src/ground.rs` new: quakes, eruptions, lava, ash; α13's `src/weather/hourly.rs`: gusts as timed entries; `src/timed.rs`; `src/purposes.rs`), `kd-things` (α08's `src/physics.rs`: `topple_check`), `kd-people` (α10a's `src/sense/notice.rs`: warning signs), `kd-player` (`src/powers/weather.rs` and `src/powers/land.rs` new; α16's `src/powers/possible.rs`, `src/record/mod.rs` and `src/record/links.rs`; α11b's `src/view.rs`; α14b's disaster recogniser), `kd-sim` (`PlayerView` facts, world dangers, gusts and shaking at their seconds), `kd-ui` (α16's `src/views/powers.rs`: stretch drawing and length picker, and `src/views/act_page.rs`; `src/findable.rs`), `kd-render` (lava, ash, fallen stacks), `kd-audio` (rumble), `data/tuning/world.md`, `data/tuning/powers.md`, `data/text/disasters.md`, `data/text/powers.md`, `data/director/moments.md`, `data/history/event_kinds.md`, `data/minds/memories.md`, `tests/fixtures/worlds/`, `scenes/lands/`, `scenes/`.

**Tasks:**
1. `T20b.1` **Quakes, gusts and toppling (`WLD-15`, `MAT-11`, `BIO-13`, A5.8, A5.1, A6.5).** `kd-world/src/ground.rs`: each fault from α18a draws daily against its yearly chance (`land.quake`, system 3, keyed on the feature and the day, in A4.9's daily row) unless in its quiet time, and breaks through `ground::quake(s, at, fault)` (A5.8), which sizes it by its kind (thrust 6–7.5, strike 5.5–7, normal 5–6.5 on a magnitude scale, tuned; `land.quake_size`) and sets shaking falling with distance (intensity = 1.5 × size − 3 × `m::log10`(km + 10), tuned), a timed entry per cell it reaches.
   Gusts: α13's hourly step puts each gust over about 15 m/s under a storm as a timed entry (`TimedKind::Gust`, A5.1) at a keyed second within the hour (`weather.gust_at`).
   At a gust's or shaking's second, in areas people are in and live kept areas, `topple_check(area)` (A6.5, in α08's `kd-things/src/physics.rs`, reading the gust's speed or the shaking's intensity from the timed entry's `strength`, A5.1) brings down stacks (and structures, once α25b builds them) by quality and wear, poorly made first (in a gust, quality 0 at wear 3 falls at about 15 m/s and quality 5 unworn at about 35; in shaking, intensity 6 topples quality 0 at wear 3 and 8 even quality 5 unworn; in proportion between); things on ledges fall and may break (A6.5's falling); shaking drops rocks from cliffs and cave roofs in the struck buckets at a chance by intensity, a blow of 20–60 to anyone beneath (`BIO-13`); other kept areas take shaking from `land_events` at catch-up, as they take α14b's fire heat (A5.4); the fault then rests its quiet time (`WLD-15`).
2. `T20b.2` **Eruptions (`WLD-15`, `BIO-18`, `WLD-27`, `MAT-08`, A5.8, A4.7).** Each volcano draws daily the same way (`land.eruption`) and erupts through `ground::eruption(s, at, volcano)`: warnings start at once and run 2–10 days as timed entries within 20 km (small quakes, rumbling as α10a's loud events, springs turning warm), each a sign people can notice (`BIO-18`: a glance subject or a loud event, giving the memory `ground_rumbled`, importance 40); then lava runs downhill 5–30 km by steepest descent from the vent (runny far and quick, sticky short and slow), each cell it reaches a timed entry and a world danger (A4.7) that people flee: cover burned, things buried, whoever stays killed, fresh lava rock set in `rock_over`, heights unchanged and no new obsidian (`WLD-15`).
   Ash falls downwind within 10–60 km: cover smothered and water fouled for a season (α17b's `foul`), things buried 1–20 cm (`MAT-08`), and fertility +1 after its first year (`WLD-27`); lava and ash join `land_events` for kept areas' catch-up; then the volcano rests its quiet time; purposes `land.eruption_size`, `land.warning_days`, `land.lava_reach` (system 3).
3. `T20b.3` **Five more powers in the ring (`GOD-02`, `GOD-05`, `GOD-10`, `GOD-11`, A10.2, A10.1).** `kd-player/src/powers/weather.rs` and `land.rs` add A10.2's rows to α16's ring, each calling exactly its function with a natural event's arguments at T + 1 (A10.1), so the world sets size, length and timing (`GOD-05`): rain (`weather::start_rain`, offered with cloud or moist air over the weather cell); storm (`weather::start_storm`, where the place's climate has storms that season and fewer so far than in its stormiest); drought of 1–15 days on a drawn stretch (`weather::start_drought`, where dry spells that long come there that season); cold snap of 1–3 days on a drawn stretch (`weather::start_cold_snap`, where cold outbreaks come that season); quake or eruption (`ground::quake`, `ground::eruption`, a fault or volcano out of its quiet time, marked on the ring's map at the region stop); the flood joins in α20c.
   α16's `Power` gains `Rain`, `Storm`, `Drought { stretch, days }`, `ColdSnap { stretch, days }`, `Quake { fault }` and `Eruption { volcano }`; α11b's `PlayerView` gains A10.2's `moist`, `climate_allows`, `storms_this_season`, `stormiest`, `faults_near` and `quiet_until`, implemented by `kd-sim` over `&World`.
   Rests and caps in α16's `data/tuning/powers.md` `[rests]` (`GOD-02`): one rain of yours at a time and that weather cell not again for a day, never more rain in a place's season than its wettest season gives; one storm at a time, then none within 50 km for 3 game days, never more in a place's season than its stormiest; one drought and one cold snap at a time, a place not again within a game year (drought) or a season (cold snap); one quake or eruption at a time in the world, none within a game year of your last, the feature then resting as after a natural one.
   Each refused power names its reason in a few words from α16's `data/text/powers.md` (`GOD-11`): "no cloud over here", "no storms here in winter", "dry spells here never last 15 days in spring", "resting: ready in 2 days", "this fault is quiet for 40 years".
4. `T20b.4` **Drawing a stretch and choosing how long (`GOD-10`, `TIM-15`, A12.2, A10.2).** α16's `kd-ui/src/views/powers.rs`: for a drought or cold snap, one finger draws a closed stretch of up to 32 points (longer strokes simplified by dropping points) and at most about 50 km across (A12.2's drawing tool, where a drag never pans), then a length picker (1–15 days, or 1–3), then confirm: at most four touches and a drawn shape (`GOD-10`'s Done when); time stays paused while you choose (`TIM-15`); a drought's or cold snap's page has End now, itself an act calling `weather::end_spell` (A5.8); a storm runs its course.
5. `T20b.5` **What came of them (`GOD-09`, `GOD-07`, `BIO-14`, A10.6).** α16's links (`record/links.rs`, A10.6) for the new powers, by time and place, never by a mark on a world record: the storm's path and the rain it dropped, and in the land each covered while it lasted and a day after, the deaths, wounds, fires and fallen shelters whose recorded cause it was (`GOD-09`, `BIO-14`); each act's page (`views/act_page.rs`) lists them, opened from its marked line in the book, the acts tab, a touched person's details, or its mark in the world; the book shows your acts only as separate marked lines when you choose (`GOD-07`).
6. `T20b.6` **Natural and never known (`GOD-05`, `GOD-06`, `SCP-09`, A10.5).** α16's `crates/kd-sim/tests/never_known.rs` gains, for each new power, A10.5's checks: the twins test (an act and the same call made by the world's code at that second leave every store but `PlayerState` with equal hashes 10 game days later, `GOD-06`); the size test (1,000 acted and 1,000 natural events of each kind agree in size, two-sample test p > 0.01); and the worst-year test (a game year of using every power as often as allowed never gives a weather cell more storms or rain, longer dry spells or deeper cold than α18c's worst year for it, `GOD-05`'s Check); no power changes heights, the climate or a species (`SCP-09`).
7. `T20b.7` **Pictures, sounds and disasters (`PRE-39`, `TIM-02`, `PRE-13`, A12.5, A10.7).** Lava glows, then cools to black rock (a surface flag on areas and in the map texture's rock), ash greys cover and roofs for a season, stacks lie fallen; warnings and quakes rumble (a low bed at the valley stop, a thump near); a quake or eruption felt in a band's home range logs `quake` or `eruption` (α07b's event-kind table, kept forever when it touches people), and one that killed someone or emptied a camp is a disaster in α14b's recogniser (A12.5, `PRE-39`), with the patterns `quake` and `eruption` in `data/text/disasters.md` (5 phrasings and a short form each) and the moments `disaster_quake` and `disaster_eruption` (base 60, about a day, A10.7).
   `World::record_kinds()` gains `world.rock_over` and `world.feature_state` (each feature's last event and quiet time), with their `FINDABLE` lines (the place card's land line, "fresh lava rock, 3 years old"; the ring's reasons and the place card's feature line).

**On the phone:**
1. Open the alpha link; in Settings long-press the version line, tap Make test world and pick `a20b · Under the volcano`, then open it from Worlds: at camp zoom the ground rumbles and people stop and look toward the mountain.
2. Set the dial to about a day every 10 seconds: days later it erupts; at valley zoom lava runs down the slope and ash greys the woods downwind.
3. Worlds → New generated world (test) with seed 1; long-press a valley near the camp: the ring offers rain or a storm only where the weather allows, and a refused one says why.
4. Choose Drought, draw a stretch round a valley, pick 10 days and confirm; later open its page from the book's acts tab: what it caused, and End now.
5. At region zoom, long-press near a red fault line: choose Quake, confirm, and watch the shaking reach the camp nearest it, a stack or two falling.

**Not in this alpha:** the flood power and floods (α20c); animal dreams (α22b); fortune and Revelation (Stage 5).

**Risks:** quakes too frequent where segments overlap: rates are per segment and the world-alone check counts them; an act bigger than nature's: each event's strength is drawn inside its function as a natural one's, and the size test compares; the drawing tool read as a pan: an open drawing tool takes one-finger drags only (A12.2); lava killing whole bands: lava is a world danger they notice and flee, and `a20b-eruption-warnings` checks it.

### α20c Rivers, floods and seas (about 4.5 hours)

**Goal:** rivers rise a day after rain upstream and spill over their floodplains, carrying things off and drowning those caught, lakes fill and fall and those of dry lands turn salty, seas warm and freeze by season, sea water makes thirst worse, fouled water runs below camps everywhere, and from the ring you can stall a storm over a river's upper valley to flood it.

**Serves:** `WLD-17` (part: rivers, lakes, floods, sea ice and fouled water everywhere), `WLD-26` (part: sea cells' warmth and ice; salt water), `WLD-27` (part: silt after floods), `WLD-22` (part: floods from the world's systems), `BIO-09` (part: salt water makes thirst worse), `MND-04` (part: a salty mouthful teaches), `MAT-11` (part: floating things carried off), `MAT-08` (part: flood silt burying things), `BIO-21` (part: drowning in floods), `GOD-02` (part: flood), `GOD-05` (part: the flood natural), `GOD-11` (part: the flood's reasons), `GOD-09` (part: a flood's page), `PRE-26` (part: lakes, floods and sea drawn), `PRE-39` (part: floods as disasters), `TIM-02` (part: a flood touching people), `TIM-18` (part: lakes falling at six times life's pace), `PRE-13` (part: the water findable), `PLT-09` (part: a big update, marked).

**Architecture:** `A5.10`, `A5.1`, `A5.4`, `A5.8`, `A5.9`, `A4.7`, `A4.9`, `A6.5`, `A8.13`, `A10.2`, `A10.5`, `A10.6`, `A10.7`, `A11.6`, `A12.5`, `A14.9`.

**Needs:** α20b, with α18b's stretches, lakes and floodplains, α18c's runoff table, α20a's soil water and streams, α17b's fouled water (`kd-world/src/water/foul.rs`), α14b's `land_events`, α04b's drinking, α08's floating, α02b's water drawing, α16's ring with α20b's rows, and α13's `weather` scene key.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-world` (`src/water/routing.rs`, `src/water/floods.rs`, `src/water/lakes.rs` and `src/water/seas.rs`, all new; α17b's `src/water/foul.rs`; `src/timed.rs`; `src/purposes.rs`), `kd-things` (floating things carried off, buried by silt), `kd-people` (α04b's drinking: salt water), `kd-sim` (floods settled in areas, routing's batch), `kd-player` (`src/powers/water.rs` new, α14b's disaster recogniser), `kd-save` (`world.water` new), `kd-render` (α02b's `src/water/`: lakes, floods, sea and ice as a water grid), `kd-ui` (α16's `src/views/powers.rs`, `src/findable.rs`), `data/items/water.md`, `data/tuning/world.md`, `data/tuning/powers.md`, `data/text/disasters.md`, `data/text/powers.md`, `data/director/moments.md`, `data/history/event_kinds.md`, `data/VERSION.toml`, `tests/fixtures/worlds/`, `scenes/lands/`, `scenes/`.

**Tasks:**
1. `T20c.1` **Rivers and lakes routed (`WLD-17`, `TIM-18`, A5.10, A4.9).** Routing (`water/routing.rs`, A5.10) over all the world's stretches in drainage order as one job, daily and hourly in a basin above bankfull (A4.9's rivers row), with quick runoff from the hours' rain through α18c's runoff table and α20a's soil water as it stood, ending the rated levels α02a and α19a held: each stretch a store releasing water by its length (about 0.2 hours a km), widths and depths from its rating, so a storm's water reaches the lower valley about a day per 100 km later; areas read their water surface from it (`PRE-26`).
   Lakes (`water/lakes.rs`) rise with inflow and fall by sill and evaporation, a closed lake in a dry land settling below its sill and turning salty; in a dry spell lakes fall about six times as fast a day as in life (`TIM-18`); glaciers stay as generated and feed rivers in summer; water is conserved within 0.1% over a year (A5.10), within 2 ms a game day (A5.9).
   The island's river joins the routing, its preset's flow as its mean.
2. `T20c.2` **Floods (`WLD-17`, `WLD-27`, `MAT-11`, `MAT-08`, `BIO-21`, A5.10, A5.1, A4.7, A5.4).** Water above bankfull spreads over the stretch's floodplain cells (α18b's flag) as timed entries (A5.1, `water/floods.rs`): in areas people are in it is settled there, water rising over the ground, floating things carried off by `MAT-11`'s rule (α08's drift), rising water within 30 m a world-danger Notice that people flee to higher ground as from α14b's fronts (A4.7), and those caught swept and drowned by `BIO-21`'s rules; in live kept areas at their second; for other kept areas written to the cell's `land_events` (begun by α14b) and applied at catch-up as fire heat is (A5.4); each leaves silt (+0.5 fertility, things buried 1–5 cm by its depth, `WLD-27`, `MAT-08`), and the cover it drowned resets (A7.4).
   Natural stalls come through `water::start_flood(s, at, stretch)` at the climate's rate, a raised chance per storm so floods come per game year as on Earth per year (`WLD-30`; `land.flood_stall`, system 3).
3. `T20c.3` **Seas, salt water and fouled water everywhere (`WLD-26`, `BIO-09`, `MND-04`, `WLD-17`, A5.10, A8.13).** Sea cells every 5 game days (A4.9's 5-day row, `water/seas.rs`) take their warmth by season (climate plus `sea_warm`) and ice where cold, walkable from 10 cm, the polar cap never melting (`WLD-26`).
   Sea and salt-lake water is `salt_water` (`data/items/water.md`, beside α04a's `fresh_water`), which raises thirst instead of meeting it (`BIO-09`, `WLD-26`); α04b's drinking offers it by what the drinker believes of it, so the first salty mouthful teaches them (A8.13, `MND-04`).
   α17b's fouled water (`water/foul.rs`) runs on every stretch of a generated world: within about 1 km below a camp, a herd's crossing or a carcass, and still pools under about 50 m across in warm weather (`WLD-17`).
4. `T20c.4` **Water drawn (`PRE-26`, A11.6).** α02b's water drawing (`kd-render/src/water/`) gains A11.6's lakes, floods and sea as a water grid per 64 m chunk, a vertex every 4 m at the water's level with depth per vertex, ice in the ice ladder, floods raising the level from the cells; lakes drawn at their routed level, replacing α19a's fixed one.
5. `T20c.5` **The flood power (`GOD-02`, `GOD-05`, `GOD-10`, `GOD-11`, `GOD-09`, A10.2, A10.5, A10.6).** `kd-player/src/powers/water.rs` adds A10.2's flood row to α16's ring: `Power::Flood { stretch }` calls `water::start_flood` at T + 1, offered on a river's upper valley with storms that season; it counts as your storm in α20b's `[rests]` (one storm of yours at a time, a flood's included, then none within 50 km for 3 game days, never more in a place's season than its stormiest); refused with reasons such as "no storms reach this valley in summer"; its page lists the river's peak, the cells it flooded and the deaths, wounds and things carried off whose recorded cause it was (A10.6); α16's `never_known.rs` gains its twins, size and worst-year tests.
6. `T20c.6` **Floods as disasters (`PRE-39`, `TIM-02`, `WLD-22`, `PRE-13`, A12.5, A10.7).** Flood water reaching a camp's cell logs `flood` (α07b's event-kind table, kept forever when it touches people); α14b's recogniser gains a flood that killed someone or emptied a camp (`PRE-39`), with the pattern `flood` in `data/text/disasters.md` (5 phrasings and a short form) and the moment `disaster_flood` (base 60, lasting about a day, A10.7), so the director slows to between camp and valley speed for a flood rising over a day (`TIM-02`).
   `World::record_kinds()` gains `world.water` (stretch flows, lake levels and salt, flooding cells, sea warmth and ice), with its `FINDABLE` line (the place card's water line: "river high, 2.4 m; over the plain").
7. `T20c.7` **Scenes, the demo world and delivery (`WLD-17`, `PLT-09`, `PRC-11`, A14.9).** Scene settings: α13's `weather` key gains `held_h`, a front held over its place that many hours from the start (an addition to A15.7, written into the architecture in this branch).
   Write and run the scenes under Tests and add floods to α20a's world-alone set; `a20c-flood-on-the-plain` is the demo.
   The new chunk `world.water` brings a migration (each stretch at its rated mean, each lake at its sill) and fixture `a20c.kindling`; `salt_water`, a new kind of material in the land, makes this a big update: `major = 10`, the generator staying at 10, earlier worlds opening read-only (`PLT-09`).
   Goldens `flood-plain`, `lake-ice` and `sea-shore-waves`; `versionCode=4203`, `versionName=a20c`; `bench/cloud/a20c.json` adds routing (A5.9: 2 ms a game day), a flooding basin's hourly steps and the world alone with water; then P0's steps 5 to 8.

**Not in this alpha:** plants regrowing after floods in every biome (α21); fish in rivers and seas, and herds fleeing floods (α22a, α22b).

### α21 Plants everywhere (about 5.5 hours)

**Goal:** about 36 plant species of every biome grow, fruit, burn and regrow on every cell of the world, each area holds its cell's species in their shares, and a camp people left comes out right, day by day, whenever someone returns to it.

**Serves:** `WLD-31` (part: about 36 species; cover on every cell; plants in areas from their cell), `WLD-12` (part: kept areas brought up to date; plants on the cell), `WLD-13` (part: dormant kept areas seen without waking them), `WLD-18` (part: grazing thins cover), `WLD-30` (part: the new species' scaled yields), `MAT-08` (part: marks fading on their own clocks), `MAT-10` (part: the new yields), `MAT-16`, `PRE-46` (part: the 8 plant forms), `PRE-43` (part: plants vary by their own seed), `PRE-07` (part: plants, water, stone and deposits), `PRE-35` (part: the plant card's cover and seasons), `SND-11` (part: wind by cover, leaves by season), `RCK-23` (part: every food plant's growing season and ground), `PLT-09` (part: a big update).

**Architecture:** `A7.2`, `A7.3`, `A7.4`, `A7.5`, `A5.2`, `A5.3`, `A5.4`, `A5.5`, `A6.12`, `A6.14`, `A6.15`, `A11.3`, `A11.7`, `A12.3`, `A12.4`, `A13.7`, `A3.6`, `A14.9`.

**Needs:** α20c, with α02d's species, their mix and contents, α05's seasons, growth stages and cover step, α04a's foods, kept areas and `kept_view`, α14a's island yields (`dead_wood`, `rotten_wood`, `birch_bark`, `tinder_fungus`), α14b's after-fire and fire catch-up, α10b's `bryony`, α19c's dormant blocks, α20b's and α20c's land events, and α16c's wind and leaves slots.

**Tasks:**
1. `T21.1` **The species (`WLD-31`, `RCK-23`, `WLD-30`, `MAT-16`, A7.2, A6.15, A6.14).** α02d's `data/plants/` (`trees.md`, `bushes.md`, `ground.md`) grows to the 36 species under Data: the island's 13 (α02d's twelve and α10b's `bryony`) keep their ids and island values and gain what they lack for other lands (biomes, needs, sprout), and 23 are new; each entry has every field of A7.2: group, biomes, needs (monthly °C range, wetness, soil kinds, shade), seasons (days 1–60 for bud, leaf, flower, fruit and bare), growth (game years a stage, `TIM-18`), size, yields (item, part, Earth amount a year with `scaled_from`, ripe window; `WLD-30`), spread, fire (killed, resprouts or seeds after fire), graze (grazers, browsers or neither), sprout (season and ground, `RCK-23`) and look (form, colours by season state and growth stage).
   Oaks bear α04a's `acorns` everywhere as they are (food 3, poison 2: bitter raw, `MND-21`), which leaching (`RCK-13`) later in this stage makes sweet.
   Written in two batches of about 12 new entries with their items (A6.15), each run through `kd catalog build --assign`, `check`, `pairs` and `tables`.
   A new catalogue check (`kd-data`'s compiler, A6.14): every land biome but ice has at least 4 plants from `MIL-04` (6 from α50, `WLD-31`'s launch count).
2. `T21.2` **Their yields (`MAT-10`, `BIO-10`, `MAT-03`, A6.2, A7.2).** New raw items (`MAT-10`), shared by species that yield alike, with all 18 characteristics, class, form, size, timers (rotting, drying) and `fits`, the food group following the yielding part (`BIO-10`), as under Data; a species that yields what an existing item already is names that item (α04a's foods, α14a's `dead_wood`, `rotten_wood`, `birch_bark` and `tinder_fungus`).
   `lime_tree` yields both `bast` (its inner bark's fibre) and `lime_bark` (a sheet of waterproof 2), so the bark and cord blueprints later in this stage find both in the land without another big update.
3. `T21.3` **The plant forms (`PRE-46`, `PRE-43`, A11.7, A11.3).** `data/models/plants.md` (new) holds `PRE-46`'s 8 forms (needle tree, broad-leaved tree, bush, grass or grain, herb or flower, reed, root plant, fungus) on α02d's ports (the `Trees` crowns, `Props.shrubMesh`, `Reeds`, `stampTuft`, A11.7), the broad-leaved tree gaining a palm crown for the palms; each species is numbers on its form: height, crown, trunk, and ladders per season state and growth stage made by `kd catalog build` (A11.3), each plant varying in proportions, lean and tone by its own seed (`PRE-43`).
4. `T21.4` **Cover on every cell (`WLD-31`, `WLD-18`, A7.4, A7.5, A4.9).** α05's cover step (`kd-life/src/plants/cover.rs`, A7.4) runs on every land cell of a generated world every 5 game days, a fifth of the land each day in A4.9's region slots, toward each cell's biome shares in α18c's `data/world/biomes.md`, ending α19a's active window for plants; α14b's after-fire (`fire/after.rs`) already resets cover from fire and grows fire-seeding species, and α20c's floods and α20b's lava and ash now reset it the same way (A7.5), while more than 0.8 of a season's graze eaten thins grass by a tenth (`WLD-18`).
   Ripe pools stay pure functions of cover, the species mix, season, `warmth` and climate, times one minus `taken`, reset as each group ripens (A7.4); species mixes are keyed draws when read among species whose needs the cell meets (α02d's `plants::mix`, A5.2), so tundra draws dwarf willow and cotton grass and the map and areas agree; about 75 ns a cell, within 15 ms a game day (A16.3).
5. `T21.5` **Areas hold their cell's plants (`WLD-31`, `WLD-12`, A5.3, A5.5).** α02d's contents (A5.3) read the generated species mix: trees and bushes on the jittered 2 m spots by `plants::density`, species by keyed weight, sizes from `tree_age` and each species' growth; ground-cover patches of up to 2 kinds; season states and ripe yields from α05's date and warmth shift; cliffs, scree and shores their own; at most 5,000 single plants an area.
   The picture's `density` and the simulation's are one function (A5.5), so coarse woods dissolve into the same trees.
6. `T21.6` **Kept areas brought up to date (`WLD-12`, `WLD-13`, `MAT-08`, `TIM-16`, A5.4, A6.12, A7.3).** α04a's kept areas and `kept_view` and α14b's fire catch-up grow into A5.4's catch-up in full: when a person comes within about 1 km of a kept area, or the picture needs a dormant one (α19c's blocks through `kept_view`, which works on copies and wakes nothing, `WLD-13`), its record runs day by day from `updated`: its things' timers on the cell's usual weather for each season (A6.12's rows at the season's normal conditions), a spreading draw a season for each planted plant (A7.3; none until people plant, α45), and the cell's land events since `updated` (α14b's fire heat, α20c's flood depth, α20b's lava, ash and shaking) acting on things and marks by A6's rules, each chance drawn for its day (`TIM-16`); marks fade by their formulas (stumps, taken yields, pits, heaps, trodden ground, burned and spared ground); a record left empty is deleted and its epoch rises (A3.4).
   `land_events` keeps each event (about 16 bytes) until every kept area of its cell has taken it, so a camp brought up to date daily or once after a season ends the same (`WLD-12`).
7. `T21.7` **Seeing plants (`PRE-07`, `PRE-35`, `SND-11`, A12.3, A12.4, A13.7).** α04d's plant card (`views/plant.rs`, A12.4) gains the cell's cover shares and the species' seasons; `OverlayAsk::Land { field: Cover | Plant(SpeciesId) | Water | Stone | Deposit(DepositKind) }` (`PRE-07`): cover shares, a chosen species' share, water (rivers, lakes, springs, marsh, sea ice), stone showing, and deposits; the map texture's cover classes follow cover as it burns and regrows.
   α16c's wind slot takes its shape from the cover at the focus (A13.7): a hiss in grass, a rush in pines, a rustle in leaf, a whistle in bare branches; and its leaves slot rustles by season (`SND-11`), in `data/sounds/ambience.md`.
8. `T21.8` **A big update, scenes, the demo world and delivery (`PLT-09`, `WLD-31`, `PRC-11`, A3.6, A14.9).** New kinds of plants and materials make a big update (A3.6, A14.9): `major = 11`, `generator = 11`, the golden areas and whole world rehashed; α20c's fixture world opens read-only with its book (`PLT-09`'s Done when); no chunk changes its schema, and the plant card's new lines are the `FINDABLE` lines of what it shows.
   Write and run the scenes under Tests; `a21-oak-after-fire` is the demo.

**On the phone:**
1. Open the alpha link; in Settings long-press the version line, tap Make test world and pick `a21 · Regrowth`, then open it from Worlds: woods that burned five years before, young birches and grass on the burn, old oaks beyond.
2. Tap a plant: its card gives the species, its stage, its seasons and what is ripe; pinch out to the valley: the burn shows as a lighter patch in the map look.
3. Views → Overlays → Land → Plant → Hazel: where hazel grows across the region.
4. Worlds → New generated world (test): pinch in on a northern forest, then on a desert's edge: pines, spruce and bilberry in one, date palms and acacia round an oasis in the other.
5. At close camp zoom with sound on in wind: grass hisses in the open and pines rush in the forest.

**Not in this alpha:** herds grazing across the world (α22a); plant cards in the bestiary (α22b); leaching acorns and stripping bark (later in this stage); sowing on purpose (α45); the full 60 species (α50).

**Risks:** the catalogue's two batches outgrowing the alpha: they are its split point if it nears 6 hours (How to use this plan, step 4); the catch-up too slow for a camp left for decades: marks fade by formula and timers jump by their clocks (A6.12), and a dormant area runs nothing until woken; areas not matching the map: both read `plants::density` (A5.5), checked by `a21-species-shares`; new species in the island's woods: the island's scenes, the sharp-stone test and its control among them, must still pass (P0's definition of done, item 3), any failure fixed in tuned numbers on the tuning seeds, never in a pass rule (`RES-09`, `RES-16`).

### α22a Herds that move (about 5.5 hours)

**Goal:** about 17 animal species live across the world: herds of deer, reindeer, aurochs, goats and gazelles graze and migrate between their summer and winter ranges, wolves, bears and big cats hunt them, fish fill rivers and seas and salmon run up the rivers, seals haul out on cold coasts and mussels crowd the rocks, and any herd near a person becomes animals you can watch one by one.

**Serves:** `WLD-32` (part: about 17 species; herds that move and migrate; individuals near people everywhere; eggs and dung), `WLD-18`, `WLD-09` (part: step 8, animals placed), `WLD-26` (part: fish and sea mammals richest where cold water wells up; shellfish beds regrowing), `WLD-31` (part: each biome present has plant eaters, hunters, birds and fish), `WLD-01` (part: nothing crosses the polar ice in 100 years), `WLD-30` (part: animals at a sixth of Earth's numbers), `MND-16` (part: herds choose as one everywhere), `BIO-19` (part: the new body patterns), `PRE-46` (part: the bird and fish patterns), `PRE-44` (part: animal movements), `PRE-07` (part: herds), `PRE-35` (part: the animal and herd card), `SND-01` and `SND-11` (part: animal calls, steps, herds and birdsong everywhere), `MAT-10` (part: the new animal yields), `TIM-07` (part: the world alone with herds), `PRE-13` (part: nests, dung and shellfish findable), `PLT-09` (part: a big update).

**Architecture:** `A7.6`, `A7.7`, `A7.8`, `A7.9`, `A7.10`, `A7.11`, `A7.12`, `A5.3`, `A5.7`, `A4.7`, `A4.9`, `A11.7`, `A11.8`, `A12.4`, `A13.5`, `A13.7`, `A16.3`, `A14.9`.

**Needs:** α21, with α12b's species schema, herds, animals near people, predators, carcasses and kills, α12c's small game and `small` counts, α16c's animal steps, calls, birds and recordings, α08's flesh, hide and bone items, and α21's grazing.

**Crates and files touched:** `kd-data` (α12b's `src/schema/animal.rs`), `kd-life` (α12b's `src/animals/herds.rs`, `near.rs` and `mind.rs`, α12c's `src/animals/small.rs`; `src/animals/place.rs`, `src/animals/moves.rs` and `src/animals/eggs_dung.rs` new), `kd-world` (`src/gen/herds.rs` new: step 11; α02d's `src/area/contents.rs`: mussel beds, nests and dung), `kd-sim` (pending herds and folding back world-wide), `kd-render` (α12b's `src/herds.rs`, body patterns by species), `kd-audio` (α16c's calls, steps, life bed and birds), `kd-ui` (α12b's `src/views/animal_card.rs`, the overlay legend, `src/findable.rs`), `data/animals/first_region.md`, `data/animals/wild.md` new, `data/items/flesh.md`, `data/items/bone.md`, `data/items/earth.md`, `data/models/animals.md`, `data/models/movements.md`, `data/sounds/recordings.md`, `assets/sounds/`, `assets/LICENSES.md`, `data/tuning/animals.md`, `data/VERSION.toml`, `tests/golden/generator.toml`, `tests/fixtures/worlds/`, `scenes/lands/`, `scenes/`.

**Tasks:**
1. `T22a.1` **The species (`WLD-32`, `WLD-30`, `WLD-31`, A7.6).** α12b's `data/animals/first_region.md` keeps `red_deer`, `wild_boar`, `wolf`, `hare`, `small_birds` and `river_fish` under their ids, each given the biomes and habitats of other lands (Data), and `data/animals/wild.md` (new) adds aurochs, reindeer, wild goat, brown bear, lion, leopard, gazelle, seal, salmon, sea fish and mussel, each with every field of A7.6 in α12b's schema (`kd-data/src/schema/animal.rs`): kind, body pattern, mass, group size, lead (`matriarch`, `pair` or `dominant`), diet, food a day, water, speed (walk, run, run length), senses, danger, flight (metres from people at wariness 50), boldness, breeding season and young a year, habitat (biomes, cover, water), density (Earth's per km² with `scaled_from`, held to a sixth, `WLD-30`), migrates (the season's range shift), yields, illnesses (empty until α24a), counted (hare, small birds, river fish, salmon, sea fish and mussel stay counts), calls and look; `domestic` stays empty until α42 and α44 add the domestic kinds of wolf, wild goat, aurochs and wild boar.
   Each species without a hand-written carcass gets a generated one (α12b's rule, A7.6), butchered into its yields by size and condition.
2. `T22a.2` **Body patterns, looks and movements (`PRE-46`, `PRE-44`, `BIO-19`, A11.7, A11.8).** α12b's `data/models/animals.md` keeps its hoofed, padded and small-and-quick patterns (from `Vox.deer`, `Vox.wolf` and the hare) and gains two more of `PRE-46`'s six: bird (small birds, drawn from close camp zoom in) and fish (river fish, salmon and sea fish, seen in clear shallows and when caught); the seal is the padded pattern with flipper proportions, as no pattern fits it better (the legless pattern waits for reptiles); each species is its pattern's proportions, coat ladders (back, belly, pale patch) and antlers, horns or tusks as parametric lines (A11.7).
   α12b's sets in `data/models/movements.md` (stand, walk, run, feed, drink, rest, sleep, lying dead) gain play, fight, call and fall, and the new patterns get theirs with swim or fly, timed by size and speed (`PRE-44`).
3. `T22a.3` **Herds placed at generation, step 11 (`WLD-09`, `WLD-18`, `WLD-30`, `WLD-32`, A5.7, A7.7).** `kd-world/src/gen/herds.rs` asks α18c's `GenLife` for `place_herds`, which `kd-sim`'s `GenLifeImpl` answers with `kd-life`'s placement (`animals/place.rs`, A5.7, A7.7), since `kd-world` never names `kd-life`: per species, each cell whose habitat suits it gets a capacity from its cover and a sixth of Earth's density (`WLD-18`, `WLD-30`); herds of the species' group size are placed on suitable cells in keyed order until capacity is met, each with a summer and a winter range (centre and a radius of 5–15 km; for migrants, centres 20–80 km apart along the season's warmth, tuned), counts by class, condition 70 and wariness 20; hunters at 1 to 50–200 of their prey's numbers; new purposes of system 1 `gen.herd_cell` and `gen.range`.
   On generated worlds this replaces α19a's island herds round the start window; island worlds keep their preset's herds.
4. `T22a.4` **The daily herd step everywhere (`WLD-32`, `WLD-18`, `WLD-01`, `MND-16`, A7.7, A4.9).** α12b's step (A7.7) runs for every herd at its region's slot, never twice in a day (`last_day`), a herd that crossed into a region whose slot had passed stepped first: eat (into `taken`'s graze, so α21's thinning follows), condition, deaths by keyed binomials (hunger below condition 20, old age), births once a game year in season, moving to one of 8 neighbours within the season's range scored by food, water and cover against people's camps and hunters (`animals/moves.rs`: migrants pulled toward the next range as the season turns, `WLD-32`), hunters taking prey by daily chance (young, old and thin first, never more than they and their young eat, each kill a whole animal in α12b's `kills`, `WLD-18`), a herd past twice its group size splitting and one under half joining its kind, and a thriving herd sending a group into an empty suitable neighbour each birth season.
   Herds never enter the middle of the polar ice, nor the sea (seals excepted, on sea and shore cells); about 30 ns a herd a day (A7.7).
5. `T22a.5` **Fish, seals, shellfish, eggs and dung (`WLD-26`, `WLD-32`, A7.10, A7.11, A5.3).** α12c's counts (`kd-life/src/animals/small.rs`, A5.2's `small` column) every 5 game days (A7.10): the water count of each river, lake and sea cell moves toward what it can hold, which is also the kind's usual count there for A7.10's catching rows: river fish by stream size, salmon in cold rivers and seas with a run multiplying a river's fish for 10 days in its autumn, sea fish richest where cold water wells up (`upwelling`, × 3) and on shelves (× 1.5) (`WLD-26`), the count's species a keyed draw when read among those the cell suits (A7.10); seals are herds on cold sea and shore cells, richest by upwelling, hauling out on shores in their breeding season.
   Mussel beds lie per rocky-shore and estuary patch in α02d's contents (A5.3), gathered like plants into `mussels` and regrowing within a season once stripped (a taken-yield mark, `WLD-26`); eggs lie in small birds' nests placed in suitable areas in their season from the seed and the cell's birds, eggs taken lowering that year's young; dung lies gatherable on the cells herds graze, dried to fuel 3 (`animals/eggs_dung.rs`, A7.11).
6. `T22a.6` **Individuals near people everywhere (`WLD-32`, `MND-16`, `BIO-19`, A7.8, A4.7, A11.8).** α12b's out and back (A7.8, A4.7's solve) for every species and every herd: at the first second a person comes within about 1 km, its animals come out as individuals with an age in their class, a sex, a condition near the herd's and an inborn boldness of 0.6–1.4, at `herd_offset` round the herd; a game day after nobody is near they fold back into the counts where their lead is, wounds lowering the herd's condition and frights raising its wariness; followers hold no activity events of their own; a herd chooses as one through its lead by `lead` (`MND-16`, A7.9).
   Drawing (A11.8): α12b's herds kept as counts, drawn as their animals at seeded offsets, instanced per species and age class with 8 shared pose rows, one call a class in view; a herd coming within 1 km of a person shows no jump as its animals become individuals.
7. `T22a.7` **Sounds, the animal card and the herd overlay (`SND-01`, `SND-11`, `MND-16`, `PRE-35`, `PRE-07`, A13.5, A13.7, A12.4).** α16c's animal sounds grow to every species (`MND-16`, A13.7): calls only as part of what they do (an alarm as they flee, a call as a herd gathers or in its breeding season, wolves at dusk), each a recording joining α16c's `data/sounds/recordings.md` and `assets/sounds/` (about 2 per calling species, public domain, CC0 or CC BY 4.0 from Wikimedia Commons, each licence read on its own page and credited in `assets/LICENSES.md`, the nearest code-made sound where none is clearly licensed, `SND-06`), pitched by the animal's size; steps by pattern and ground; herds near a camp in α16c's life bed (`kd-audio/src/plan/beds.rs`); birdsong from the cell's small birds as α16c plays them (`SND-11`).
   α12b's animal and herd card (`views/animal_card.rs`, A12.4): species, age, sex, condition, the herd's count by class, its activity and the lead's reasons (`MND-16`), and its ranges; `OverlayAsk::Land` gains `Herds(Option<SpeciesId>)`: each herd a dot sized by its count (`PRE-07`).
8. `T22a.8` **A big update, the world alone, scenes and delivery (`PLT-09`, `TIM-07`, `WLD-32`, `PRE-13`, `PRC-11`, A14.9, A16.3).** New kinds of animals and herds placed at generation make a big update: `major = 12`, `generator = 12`, the golden world rehashed, α20c's fixture (the newest, as α21 adds none) opening read-only with its book (A14.9); the herds' ranges and the nests, dung and mussel beds change `life.herds` and `world.sparse`: migrations and fixture `a22a.kindling`; `World::record_kinds()` gains `world.nests`, `world.dung` and `world.shellfish`, with their `FINDABLE` lines (the place card's animals line).

**Risks:** too many herds to step in budget: about 300,000 fit A16.3's 10 ms, and group sizes and capacities set the count, measured in the bench; booms and crashes wiping out a species: the 100-year check catches it, and births and hunting chances are tuned on tuning seeds (`RES-16`); migrants piling up at a range's edge: their move scores count graze already eaten.

### α22b Fear, the bestiary and animal dreams (about 4.5 hours)

**Goal:** people see a bear or a pack coming and gather, shout and back toward the fire, hungry bears and big cats stalk the lone as wolves already do, herds learn to fear hunters and lose that fear where nobody hunts, every species has its card in the bestiary, and you can send an animal or a herd a dream toward a place, or to be calmer or bolder.

**Serves:** `MND-16` (part: fear and learned fear of people), `WLD-32` (part: wariness learned and fading; every predator kept off by numbers, noise and fire), `MND-03` (part: danger noticed the moment it is in range, worked out both ways), `TIM-17` (part: danger as an interruption; the same second at every speed), `BIO-18` (part: smell downwind), `BIO-19` (part: animal senses), `PRE-16`, `GOD-12`, `GOD-10` (part: animal dreams on the ring), `GOD-09` (part: where a dreamed herd went), `GOD-06` (part: animal dreams never known), `GOD-11` (part: the animal dreams' reasons), `TIM-02` (part: every predator's stalk signed), `RES-23` (part: a band fleeing a bear), `PRE-13` (part: species findable in the bestiary).

### α23 Hunting (about 5.5 hours)

**Goal:** hunters cut poles, point and fire-harden them or haft pressed stone points onto them with sinew or birch tar, stalk a herd from downwind, throw or thrust, follow a wounded deer's blood to where it fell, butcher it and carry the meat home on their backs; and a predator that catches someone alone charges, and is fought off, or kills.

   - `haft_a_point` (hunting, bind, 4): head: a point (point, edge 4–5, used); shaft: a pole (wood, pole, 1.5–2.5 m, toughness 3–5, used); binding: a strand of fibre 3–5 (α08's `sinew` as it is, used up); about 30 minutes; result `hafted_spear` (`set = { edge = "head.edge", toughness = "min(head.toughness, binding.toughness, shaft.toughness)" }`, `RCK-25`); failures 0.8 nothing, 0.2 poor (quality 0); three inputs, so `hinted_by = ["sign:split_tip"]` (A6.10, `MAT-17`'s discoverable check).
   - `glue_a_point` (hunting, bind, 4): head and shaft as in `haft_a_point`; binding: a glue (paste, stickiness 4–5: α15's `tar`, or α21's `resin`, 5–20 g, used) warmed at a fire (`fire_min = 1`); about 20 minutes; result `hafted_spear` with the same `set`, a second route to it (`MAT-07`, `RCK-25`'s "bound or glued"); failures 0.8 nothing, 0.2 poor; `hinted_by = ["sign:split_tip"]` as well.
   α08's item schema gains `throw = { reach_m, harm }` for things made to be thrown (an A6.2 field, written into the architecture in this branch): `wooden_spear` 10–15 m and a cut of 20–40, `hafted_spear` 15–25 m and 30–60; α12c's stones keep their reach from weight (`MAT-11`).
   `data/items/wood.md` gains `pole` (raw: pole, 2–4 m, green wood: hardness 2, toughness 4, flexibility 3, weight 1, burn 2, fuel 2, water 2; main toughness; drying in a season, `MAT-19`), `wooden_spear` and `hafted_spear` (made: pole; main edge); `data/items/stone.md` gains `stone_point` (made: point; main edge; breaks into `stone_chips`).
2. `T23.2` **Throwing and thrusting (`MAT-11`, `BIO-21`, A6.5, A10.4).** α12c's throw (`kd-things/src/physics.rs`) grows to spears at big animals: reach and harm come from the thrower's strength within the spear's `throw` range (the strongest throw the far end, `MAT-11`); the hit chance is 0.6 at 5 m against a still target, less 0.03 a metre, × 0.5 against a running one, + 0.04 a level of hunting experience (`BIO-21`), at most 0.95, rolled by `things.throw_hit` (a new purpose of system 8, fortune `Good` for the thrower, A10.4; an addition to A6.16's list, written into the architecture in this branch); a hit wounds a part by the animal's body pattern's shares (A7.8) with a cut sized within the spear's harm by the thrower's strength; a miss leaves the spear where it lands, to be fetched; a thrust is T23.5's blow at 2 m, sized by the spear's edge and the thruster's strength.
3. `T23.3` **Animals wounded, and their trail (`BIO-19`, `BIO-13`, A7.8, A8.6, A5.4).** α12b's animals carry α09b's `kd_life::body` wounds (A7.8) and now bleed as people do: a tenth of the wound's size a minute, halving every 10 minutes; pace × (1 − pain ÷ 200); collapse at 35 blood lost and death at 50, so a cut of 40 drops a deer in about a quarter of an hour; a wounded animal flees at its run speed while it can (A7.9), its herd fleeing with it.
   While it bleeds it leaves a drop every 5 m, kept as a `Blood` mark (a new mark kind of α04a's `AreaRecord`, 24 bytes, fading in 2 game days and at once under rain of 2 mm an hour or more; written into A5.4's table in this branch), which the barrier writes into the area the animal crossed; an animal lost with a wound under 25 may live, lowering its herd's condition when it folds back (α22a).
   Tracking is a seconds-long activity (A4.4): a hunter finds the next drop within 10 m, sooner with hunting experience, so a speared deer can be followed to where it fell (`BIO-19`'s Done when).
4. `T23.4` **The hunt, as people choose it (`MND-09`, `MND-06`, `BIO-21`, `WLD-32`, A8.15, A4.4, A6.5).** In α04c's `choose/options.rs`, hunting a big animal of a kind known as food (α12c's kinds known), seen or believed in range by their map's facts of herds by place and season (`MND-28`), is an option when they hold a spear or can make one from what is in reach (α09's `find_inputs`), scored by the worth of its meat, fat and hide (A8.15's worth table), their own record of hunts ((successes + 1) ÷ (tries + 2)), travel, and risk (the kind's known danger × the chance of harm, less for the brave).
   `kd-people/src/act/hunt.rs` runs it as A4.4 activities: stalking from downwind, crouched within 200 m (halving the herd's sight of them, A8.9); waiting for a throw within reach; throwing, or rushing in to thrust; tracking a wounded animal (T23.3); butchering at the kill with the best tool in reach (α09's blueprints); and carrying home what they can bear on the back, a new `CarrySlot::Back` in α04a's `carry.rs` (about a quarter of body weight all day, more for a short way, `BIO-21`, A6.5), the rest left as a carcass for others and for scavengers.
   Each try, kill and carry adds hunting experience (A8.13, `MND-06`); each kill logs α12c's `kill_by_people` (A7.14) and, by α22b's rule, raises its herd's wariness 15.
5. `T23.5` **Chases and fights of seconds (`TIM-17`, `BIO-21`, `BIO-13`, A4.4, A8.3).** `kd-people/src/act/fight.rs`, A4.4's activities of 2–10 seconds: a chase is chosen again every 2 seconds as the quarry turns, from both speeds, run lengths and breath (A8.3: −20 a minute running); a fight is an exchange every 2 seconds, each side's blow landing by chance (`BIO-21`: strength and hunting experience for people, danger and size for animals; `bodies.blow`, a new purpose of system 9, fortune `Good` on a person's hit and `Bad` on a wound to them), wounding a part with its weapon, horn, tusk, bite or claw (`BIO-13`); a fight ends when one side takes a wound of 30 or more, flees, or runs out of breath; a blow cut short does nothing (`TIM-17`).
   Held weapons are read from the hands (a spear, a club, a stone, a burning brand), so Stage 5's fights between people (α30b) grow this activity rather than build another.
6. `T23.6` **Predators attack (`WLD-32`, `BIO-13`, `BIO-14`, A7.9, A4.7).** α12c's stalk, widened by α22b, ends in a charge when the predator reaches its charge distance unseen or with its target still alone (wolf 30 m, bear 40 m, lion 50 m, leopard 15 m, in `[stalk]` of α12b's `data/tuning/animals.md`): a chase, then a fight; the person shouts (α10a's loud event and α12c's warning call, A4.7) and fights back with what they hold, a burning brand within 2 m driving most predators off (0.8 a second, tuned); others within hearing answer at a run and join (α09b's call for help); a bite or swipe wounds by the animal's danger (a wolf's bite about 20, a bear's swipe 40 or more, `BIO-13`); a predator wounded 30 or more breaks off and flees.
   A death names its cause and how it came (α06c's `Death`, its hows in `data/text/deaths.md`: "bleeding, from a bear's swipe, while gathering", `BIO-14`); each attack logs `attacked_by_animal { animal, person, wound }` (α07b's `data/history/event_kinds.md`, kept forever when it kills); survivors keep the memory `attacked_by_animal` (importance 60).
7. `T23.7` **Seeing and hearing hunts (`PRE-44`, `PRE-39`, A11.7, A11.8, A13.5, A12.5).** α06c's `data/models/movements.md` gains `fight` (a two-handed thrust and a swing, by what is held), `stalk` (a crouched walk) and `carry_back` (a load across the shoulders), and α09's `throw` an overarm form with a spear, whose spear leaves the hand on the frame its release mark falls and flies to its landing (A11.8); blood drops show as small decals at the Show level (`PRE-18`); layouts for `wooden_spear`, `hafted_spear` (shaft line, point, binding wraps) and `stone_point` in `data/models/layouts.md` (A11.7); sounds: the thrust and a flesh hit by size from new pairs in α16b's `data/sounds/blueprints.md`, people's cries and the shout from α17's own sounds, and animals' pain and alarm calls from α16c's and α22a's recordings (A13.5).
   A kill of an animal over 200 kg also logs `big_game_kill` (α07b's table, first-able and kept forever), so a people's first is an other first in the book (α11b's recogniser, A12.5, `PRE-39`), with its pattern in α22b's `data/text/life.md` (5 phrasings and a short form); a kill of 50 kg or more gives each hunter there the memory `big_kill` (importance 40).
8. `T23.8` **Trials, scenes, the demo world and delivery (`RES-24`, `RES-23`, `PRE-13`, `PRC-11`, A14.9).** Trials for the 6 blueprints; `kd scene gen` for each (α09); write and run the scenes under Tests; `a23-hunting-chain` is the demo.
   The `Blood` mark changes `area.marks` and the back slot `things.live`: migrations (no blood, nothing on a back) and fixture `a23.kindling` (a speared deer bleeding along its trail and a hunter carrying meat home, A14.9); `World::record_kinds()` gains `area.blood`, with its `FINDABLE` line (the ground card: "blood of a red deer, speared by Tor, an hour ago"); no kind of plant, animal or material in the land changes, so this is a small update.
   Goldens `spear-in-flight`, `blood-trail` and `meat-carried-home`; `versionCode=4230`, `versionName=a23`; `bench/cloud/a23.json` adds a fight's seconds-long activities and the hunt option against A8.21's rows, and the world alone and the 1,000-person world read against 1.7 (the intro's speed line); then P0's steps 5 to 8.
